function aptGeometryAudit(){
 const issues=[],roads=aptRoadRects(),fps=APT_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp);
 const regs=[E0_REGION,F0_REGION,G0_REGION,E1_REGION,F1_REGION,G1_REGION,E2_REGION,F2_REGION,G2_REGION];
 const inReg=(r)=>[[r.x,r.y],[r.x+r.w,r.y],[r.x,r.y+r.h],[r.x+r.w,r.y+r.h]].every(([px,py])=>regs.some(g=>px>=g.x&&px<=g.x+g.w&&py>=g.y&&py<=g.y+g.h));
 for(const f of fps){if(!inReg(f))issues.push(f.id+':outside-regions');for(const r of roads)if(aptOver(f,r))issues.push(f.id+':on-road '+r.id)}
 for(let i=0;i<fps.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<fps.length;j++)if(aptOver(fps[i],fps[j]))issues.push(fps[i].id+'/'+fps[j].id+':overlap');
 for(const L of APT_LOTS){const q={x:L.x,y:L.y,w:L.w,h:L.h};if(!inReg(q))issues.push(L.id+':outside-regions');for(const r of roads)if(aptOver(q,r))issues.push(L.id+':on-road '+r.id);for(const f of fps)if(aptOver(q,f))issues.push(L.id+':under '+f.id)}
 for(const st of APT_STALLS){const L=APT_LOTS.find(l=>l.id===st.lot);if(st.x<L.x||st.y<L.y||st.x+st.w>L.x+L.w||st.y+st.h>L.y+L.h)issues.push(st.id+':outside-lot')}
 const cars=PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-P-/.test(c.id)).length;
 
 const R=APT_RWY,T=APT_TWY;
 if(T.cy-T.w/2-(R.cy+R.w/2)<60)issues.push('runway-taxiway-gap');
 for(const s of APT_STANDS){if(s.cargo)continue;const acn=TurboCity.info(s.aircraft,{scale:APT_GS/(TurboCity.get(s.aircraft).res||1),rot:1}),na=acn.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Nose Gear'),box={x:s.cx-na[1],y:s.ng-na[2],w:acn.w,h:acn.h};
  if(box.y+11<APT_TWY.cy+APT_TWY.w/2-1)issues.push(s.id+':aircraft-on-taxiway');
  const tb=aptFp(aptB(s.term));if(box.y+box.h-11>tb.y+1)issues.push(s.id+':aircraft-into-terminal');
  {const off=(s.gateX-s.cx)*(s.door==='R'?-1:1);if(s.gateX-15<tb.x||s.gateX+15>tb.x+tb.w)issues.push(s.id+':bridge-off-terminal');{const K=G77_K72.st[s.id];if(K?Math.abs(s.gateX-K.rx)>.01:(off<20||off>36))issues.push(s.id+':bridge-not-at-rotunda')}}}   
 for(let i=0;i<APT_STANDS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<APT_STANDS.length;j++){const a=APT_STANDS[i],b=APT_STANDS[j];if(!a.cargo&&!b.cargo&&Math.abs(a.cx-b.cx)<300)issues.push(a.id+'/'+b.id+':stands-too-close')}
 
 for(const id of['APT-TERM','APT-TOWER','APT-CARGO']){const p=APT_INTERACTIONS[id],b=aptB(id==='APT-TERM'?'APT-TERM-2':id),f=aptFp(b);if(!(p.x>=f.x-4&&p.x<=f.x+f.w+4&&p.y>=f.y+f.h-2&&p.y<=APT_ROAD_Y-48))issues.push(id+':poi-not-on-forecourt');if(aptSolidAt(p.x,p.y,10))issues.push(id+':poi-blocked')}
 for(const p of Object.values(APT_INTERACTIONS)){const rg=regs.find(g=>p.x>=g.x&&p.x<=g.x+g.w&&p.y>=g.y&&p.y<=g.y+g.h);if(!rg||rg.id&&false)issues.push(p.id+':poi-outside');}
 
 for(const t of APT_TREES)for(const r of roads)if(aptOver({x:t.x-8,y:t.y-8,w:16,h:16},r))issues.push(t.id+':on-road');
 return{ok:issues.length===0,issues,issueCount:issues.length,buildings:APT_BUILDINGS.length,lots:APT_LOTS.length,stalls:APT_STALLS.length,cars,trees:APT_TREES.length,lights:APT_LIGHTS.length,stands:APT_STANDS.length,pois:Object.keys(APT_INTERACTIONS).length}
}

const APTT_WT=.75;                             
const apttTW=Math.PI*2;
const apttCl=(x,a,b)=>x<a?a:x>b?b:x;
const apttSm=x=>{x=apttCl(x,0,1);return x*x*(3-2*x)};
const apttAng=(a,b,t)=>{const d=(((b-a+Math.PI)%apttTW)+apttTW)%apttTW-Math.PI;return a+d*t};


function apttPath(pts,r,o){
 if(pts.length>2){const q=[pts[0]],rr=Array.isArray(r)?[]:r;for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){if(Math.hypot(pts[i][0]-q[q.length-1][0],pts[i][1]-q[q.length-1][1])<.5){if(Array.isArray(r)&&i-1<r.length&&i>1)rr[q.length-2]=Math.max(rr[q.length-2]||0,r[i-1]||0);continue}q.push(pts[i]);if(Array.isArray(r)&&i<pts.length-1)rr[q.length-2]=r[i-1]}pts=q;if(Array.isArray(r))r=rr}
 const X=[],Y=[],arcIdx=[];
 const push=(x,y)=>{X.push(x);Y.push(y)};
 const line=(x0,y0,x1,y1)=>{const L=Math.hypot(x1-x0,y1-y0),n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(L/2));for(let k=1;k<=n;k++)push(x0+(x1-x0)*k/n,y0+(y1-y0)*k/n)};
 push(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);let cx=pts[0][0],cy=pts[0][1];
 for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){
  const P=pts[i];
  if(i===pts.length-1){line(cx,cy,P[0],P[1]);break}
  const Q=pts[i+1];
  let ux=P[0]-cx,uy=P[1]-cy;const lu=Math.hypot(ux,uy);ux/=lu;uy/=lu;
  let vx=Q[0]-P[0],vy=Q[1]-P[1];const lv=Math.hypot(vx,vy);vx/=lv;vy/=lv;
  const cr=ux*vy-uy*vx,dt=ux*vx+uy*vy,phi=Math.atan2(Math.abs(cr),dt),rr=Array.isArray(r)?r[i-1]:r;
  if(phi<.002){line(cx,cy,P[0],P[1]);cx=P[0];cy=P[1];continue}
  let t=rr*Math.tan(phi/2);t=Math.min(t,o&&o.fullEnds&&i===1?lu:lu*.5,o&&o.fullEnds&&i===pts.length-2?lv:lv*.5);const re=t/Math.tan(phi/2);    
  const ax=P[0]-ux*t,ay=P[1]-uy*t;
  line(cx,cy,ax,ay);
  const sg=cr>0?1:-1,ox=ax+(-uy*sg)*re,oy=ay+(ux*sg)*re,a0=Math.atan2(ay-oy,ax-ox),m=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(re*phi/2)),i0=X.length-1;
  for(let k=1;k<=m;k++){const a=a0+sg*phi*k/m;push(ox+Math.cos(a)*re,oy+Math.sin(a)*re)}
  arcIdx.push([i0,X.length-1]);
  cx=X[X.length-1];cy=Y[Y.length-1];
 }
 const n=X.length,S=new Float64Array(n),TG=new Float64Array(n);
 for(let i=1;i<n;i++)S[i]=S[i-1]+Math.hypot(X[i]-X[i-1],Y[i]-Y[i-1]);
 for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++)TG[i]=Math.atan2(Y[i+1]-Y[i],X[i+1]-X[i]);TG[n-1]=TG[n-2];
 return{X,Y,S,TG,n,len:S[n-1],arcs:arcIdx.map(([a,b])=>({s0:S[a],s1:S[b]}))};
}

function apttAt(P,s){
 if(s<0){const k=P.TG[0];return[P.X[0]+Math.cos(k)*s,P.Y[0]+Math.sin(k)*s,k,0]}
 if(s>P.len)s=P.len;
 let lo=0,hi=P.n-1;while(hi-lo>1){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(P.S[m]<=s)lo=m;else hi=m}
 const f=P.S[hi]>P.S[lo]?(s-P.S[lo])/(P.S[hi]-P.S[lo]):0;
 return[P.X[lo]+(P.X[hi]-P.X[lo])*f,P.Y[lo]+(P.Y[hi]-P.Y[lo])*f,P.TG[lo],lo];
}

function apttTrack(P,d,th0){
 const TH=new Float64Array(P.n);let mx=P.X[0]-d*Math.cos(th0),my=P.Y[0]-d*Math.sin(th0);TH[0]=th0;
 for(let i=1;i<P.n;i++){const nx=P.X[i],ny=P.Y[i];let vx=mx-nx,vy=my-ny;const l=Math.hypot(vx,vy)||1;mx=nx+vx/l*d;my=ny+vy/l*d;TH[i]=Math.atan2(ny-my,nx-mx)}
 return TH;
}


function apttProf(len,fn){
 const n=Math.max(2,Math.ceil(len/3)),d=len/n,v=new Float64Array(n+1),T=new Float64Array(n+1);
 for(let i=0;i<=n;i++)v[i]=Math.max(3,fn(i*d));
 for(let i=1;i<=n;i++)T[i]=T[i-1]+2*d/(v[i-1]+v[i]);
 return{len,n,d,v,T,dur:T[n]};
}
function apttTof(p,s){if(s<=0)return 0;if(s>=p.len)return p.dur;const f=s/p.d,i=Math.min(p.n-1,Math.floor(f));return p.T[i]+(p.T[i+1]-p.T[i])*(f-i)}
function apttSof(p,t){
 if(t<=0)return 0;if(t>=p.dur)return p.len;
 let lo=0,hi=p.n;while(hi-lo>1){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(p.T[m]<=t)lo=m;else hi=m}
 return(lo+(t-p.T[lo])/(p.T[hi]-p.T[lo]))*p.d;
}

function apttVfn(len,o){
 const vmax=o.vmax,v0=o.v0??6,v1=o.v1??6,acc=o.acc??25,dec=o.dec??25,zones=o.zones||[],zacc=o.zacc??30;
 return s=>{let v=Math.min(vmax,Math.sqrt(v0*v0+2*acc*s),Math.sqrt(v1*v1+2*dec*Math.max(0,len-s)));
  for(const z of zones){const d=s<z[0]?z[0]-s:s>z[1]?s-z[1]:0;v=Math.min(v,Math.sqrt(z[2]*z[2]+2*zacc*d))}
  return v};
}
const apttArcZones=(P,v,pad=0)=>P.arcs.map(a=>[a.s0-pad,a.s1+pad,v]);



function apttMove(o){
 const P=o.path,pr=o.prof,TH=o.mode==='trk'?apttTrack(P,o.d,o.th0):null;
 return{kind:o.kind||'move',dur:pr.dur,len:P.len,path:P,prof:pr,meta:o.meta||{},
  pose(t){
   const s0=apttSof(pr,t),s=o.rev?P.len-s0:s0,a=apttAt(P,s),x=a[0],y=a[1];let th;
   if(o.mode==='trk'){th=TH[a[3]];if(o.endTh!=null)th=apttAng(th,o.endTh,apttSm((s-(P.len-o.endBlend))/o.endBlend))}
   else if(o.mode==='push')th=apttAng(o.th0,o.th1,apttSm((s-o.sa)/(o.sb-o.sa)));
   else if(o.mode==='fn')th=o.hdg(s,a[2]);
   else th=o.blend?apttAng(o.th0,a[2],apttSm(s/o.blend)):a[2];
   return[x,y,th,o.z?o.z(s,x,y):0,o.al?o.al(s,x,y):1];
  },
  endPose(){return this.pose(pr.dur)}};
}
const apttHold=(pose,dur,kind='hold')=>({kind,dur,pose:()=>pose});
const apttGap=dur=>({kind:'absent',dur,pose:()=>null});
function apttSeq(legs){
 let acc=0;const st=[];for(const l of legs){st.push(acc);acc+=l.dur}
 return{legs,st,dur:acc,
  at(t){if(t<0||t>=acc)return null;let i=legs.length-1;while(st[i]>t)i--;return legs[i].pose(t-st[i])},
  legAt(t){if(t<0||t>=acc)return null;let i=legs.length-1;while(st[i]>t)i--;return{i,leg:legs[i],t:t-st[i],start:st[i]}}};
}


function apttAcGeom(id){
 if(apttAcGeom.c&&apttAcGeom.c[id])return apttAcGeom.c[id];
 const S=APTT_SPEC.ac[id],a=S.an,ng=a['Nose Gear']||[S.w/2,S.h/2],fp=S.fp;
 const g={ng,w:S.w,h:S.h,fp};
 g.F=[fp[0]-ng[0],fp[0]+fp[2]-ng[0],fp[1]-ng[1],fp[1]+fp[3]-ng[1]];
 if(a['Left Wing']&&a['Main Gear']&&a['Tail']&&!/AC-HL/.test(id)){
  const tL=a['Left Wing'],tR=a['Right Wing'],mg=a['Main Gear'],tl=a['Tail'],nose=a['Nose'],cy=(tL[1]+tR[1])/2,half=(tR[1]-tL[1])/2;
  g.W=[tL[0]-12-ng[0],mg[0]+24-ng[0],cy-half*APTT_WT-ng[1],cy+half*APTT_WT-ng[1]];
  g.T=[tl[0]-ng[0],tl[0]+36-ng[0],cy-half*.3-ng[1],cy+half*.3-ng[1]];
  g.nose=nose[0]-ng[0];g.tail=tl[0]-ng[0];g.mgx=mg[0]-ng[0];
 }else{g.nose=fp[0]+fp[2]-ng[0];g.tail=fp[0]-ng[0]}
 (apttAcGeom.c=apttAcGeom.c||{})[id]=g;return g;
}
function apttObb(x,y,th,box,layer,tag){
 const c=Math.cos(th),s=Math.sin(th),lx=(box[0]+box[1])/2,ly=(box[2]+box[3])/2,hx=(box[1]-box[0])/2,hy=(box[3]-box[2])/2;
 const wx=x+lx*c-ly*s,wy=y+lx*s+ly*c,ex=Math.abs(c)*hx+Math.abs(s)*hy,ey=Math.abs(s)*hx+Math.abs(c)*hy;
 return{x:wx,y:wy,hx,hy,c,s,L:layer,t:tag,x0:wx-ex,x1:wx+ex,y0:wy-ey,y1:wy+ey};
}
function apttObbHit(A,B,m){
 const dx=B.x-A.x,dy=B.y-A.y;
 for(let k=0;k<4;k++){let ux,uy;if(k===0){ux=A.c;uy=A.s}else if(k===1){ux=-A.s;uy=A.c}else if(k===2){ux=B.c;uy=B.s}else{ux=-B.s;uy=B.c}
  const rA=A.hx*Math.abs(ux*A.c+uy*A.s)+A.hy*Math.abs(-ux*A.s+uy*A.c),rB=B.hx*Math.abs(ux*B.c+uy*B.s)+B.hy*Math.abs(-ux*B.s+uy*B.c);
  if(Math.abs(dx*ux+dy*uy)>rA+rB+m)return false}
 return true;
}

const APTT_OK=new Set(['WT','TW','VW','WV','VT','TV']);
function apttConflict(a,b,m=6){
 const la=a.L,lb=b.L;
 if(la==='P'||lb==='P'){if(la===lb)return false;const p=la==='P'?a:b,o=la==='P'?b:a;if(o.L!=='V'&&o.L!=='F'&&o.L!=='W'&&o.L!=='T')return false;if(o.t===p.own)return false;return o.x0<=p.x1+3&&o.x1>=p.x0-3&&o.y0<=p.y1+3&&o.y1>=p.y0-3&&apttObbHit(o,p,3)}
 if(la==='R'||lb==='R')return la==='R'&&lb==='R'&&a.x0<=b.x1&&a.x1>=b.x0&&a.y0<=b.y1&&a.y1>=b.y0&&apttObbHit(a,b,0);
 if(la==='A'||lb==='A')return la==='A'&&lb==='A'&&a.x0<=b.x1+m&&a.x1>=b.x0-m&&a.y0<=b.y1+m&&a.y1>=b.y0-m&&apttObbHit(a,b,m);
 if(la==='EW'||lb==='EW')return e1WingConflict(a,b,m);
 if(la==='B'||lb==='B'){const o=la==='B'?b:a,bb=la==='B'?a:b,m=o.L==='V'?0:2;if(o.L!=='F'&&o.L!=='V')return false;return o.x0<=bb.x1+m&&o.x1>=bb.x0-m&&o.y0<=bb.y1+m&&o.y1>=bb.y0-m&&apttObbHit(o,bb,m)}
 if(typeof la==='string'&&typeof lb==='string'?(la.length+lb.length===2&&(la.length===1?((la==='W'&&(lb==='T'||lb==='V'))||(la==='T'&&(lb==='W'||lb==='V'))||(la==='V'&&(lb==='W'||lb==='T'))):APTT_OK.has(la.length===2?la:lb))):APTT_OK.has(la+lb))return false;
 return a.x0<=b.x1+m&&a.x1>=b.x0-m&&a.y0<=b.y1+m&&a.y1>=b.y0-m&&apttObbHit(a,b,m);
}

const APTT_RWY_BOX=()=>{const R=APTT_C.RWY;return[4000,8500,R.cy-R.w/2-20,R.cy+R.w/2+20]};
function apttShapes(tr,pose,out,lt){
 if(!pose)return out;
 const [x,y,th,z,al]=pose;
 if(tr.kind==='ac'){
  const g=apttAcGeom(tr.id);
  if(z>8){out.push(apttObb(x,y,th,g.F,'A',tr.nm),apttObb(x,y,th,g.W||g.F,'A',tr.nm));return out}
  out.push(apttObb(x,y,th,g.F,'F',tr.nm));if(G77_DKZ.on)g77DkTag(out[out.length-1],tr,x,y,th);    
  if(g.W){out.push(apttObb(x,y,th,g.W,'W',tr.nm));const full=aptFullWingEnvelope(g,x,y,th,tr.nm);if(full)out.push(full)}
  if(g.T)out.push(apttObb(x,y,th,g.T,'T',tr.nm));
 }else{
  if(al<.99)return out;                       
  const hx=tr.hx,hy=tr.hy;
  out.push(apttObb(x,y,th,[-hx,hx,-hy,hy],'V',tr.nm));if(G77_DKZ.on)g77DkTag(out[out.length-1],tr,x,y,th);    
  if(tr.carts)for(let i=0;i<tr.carts.length;i++){const c=tr.carts[i],q=tr.cartAt(pose,i,lt,tr);out.push(apttObb(q[0],q[1],q[2],[-c.hx,c.hx,-c.hy,c.hy],'V',tr.nm));if(G77_DKZ.on)g77DkTag(out[out.length-1],tr,q[0],q[1],q[2])}    
 }
 return out;
}

const apttD=ac=>{const a=APTT_SPEC.ac[ac].an;return a['Nose Gear'][0]-a['Main Gear'][0]};

function apttArrive(ac,pts,radii,endTh){
 const K=APTT_CLS[ac],P=apttPath(pts,radii),sTd=APTT_X.TD-APTT_X.APP0,ex=P.arcs[0],len=P.len;
 const zones=P.arcs.map((a,i)=>[a.s0,a.s1,i?38:45]);
 const fn=s=>{
  let v;
  if(s<sTd-300)v=K.vApp;else if(s<sTd)v=K.vApp+(K.vTd-K.vApp)*(s-(sTd-300))/300;
  else{const a=(K.vTd*K.vTd-70*70)/(2*(ex.s0-sTd));v=Math.sqrt(Math.max(70*70,K.vTd*K.vTd-2*a*(s-sTd)))}
  if(s>ex.s1)v=Math.min(v,K.vTaxi);
  for(const z of zones){const d=s<z[0]?z[0]-s:s>z[1]?s-z[1]:0;v=Math.min(v,Math.sqrt(z[2]*z[2]+2*30*d))}
  return Math.min(v,Math.sqrt(36+2*22*Math.max(0,len-s)));
 };
 return apttMove({kind:'arrive',path:P,prof:apttProf(len,fn),mode:'trk',th0:0,d:apttD(ac),endTh,endBlend:70,
  z:s=>s<sTd?80*(1-s/sTd):0,al:()=>1,meta:{sTd,sOut0:ex.s0}});
}
function apttTaxi(ac,pts,radii,th0,kind='taxi',vmax){
 const K=APTT_CLS[ac],P=apttPath(pts,radii),len=P.len;
 const fn=apttVfn(len,{vmax:vmax||K.vTaxi,v0:6,v1:6,acc:20,dec:22,zones:apttArcZones(P,34,0)});
 return apttMove({kind,path:P,prof:apttProf(len,fn),mode:'trk',th0,d:apttD(ac)});
}


const CAM_ZOOM_MIN=.45,VIEW_REF_W=2560;   
function g77EdgeE(){return WORLD.x+WORLD.w+Math.ceil(VIEW_REF_W/2/CAM_ZOOM_MIN)}


const VIEW_REF_H=1600;
function g77ViewR(){const mx=Math.ceil(VIEW_REF_W/2/CAM_ZOOM_MIN),my=Math.ceil(VIEW_REF_H/2/CAM_ZOOM_MIN);return{x0:WORLD.x-mx,x1:WORLD.x+WORLD.w+mx,y0:WORLD.y-my,y1:WORLD.y+WORLD.h+my}}

function g77AcReach(ac){const g=apttAcGeom(ac);if(!g||!g.F)return 260;const W=g.W||g.F;return Math.ceil(Math.max(-g.F[0],g.F[1],Math.abs(W[2]),Math.abs(W[3]),Math.abs(g.F[2]),Math.abs(g.F[3]))*(1+130/420)*1.25+130*.42+40)}

function g77OutLeg(ac,to){if(!to||!(to.dur>0))return null;const e=to.endPose();if(!e||!((e[3]||0)>8))return null;
 const q=to.pose(Math.max(0,to.dur-.25)),v=Math.max(80,Math.hypot(e[0]-q[0],e[1]-q[1])/.25),c=Math.cos(e[2]),sn=Math.sin(e[2]);if(c<.2)return null;
 const L=(g77ViewR().x1+g77AcReach(ac)-e[0])/c;if(!(L>0))return null;
 return{kind:'outbound',dur:L/v,len:L,pose:t=>{const s=v*Math.max(0,t);return[e[0]+s*c,e[1]+s*sn,e[2],Math.min(130,e[3]+s*.16),1]}}}

function g77InLeg(ac,arr){const K=APTT_CLS[ac];if(!K||!arr)return null;const a=arr.pose(0);if(!a)return null;
 const R=500,Lf=400,X0=a[0]-R-Lf,Ys=g77ViewR().y0-g77AcReach(ac);if(!(Ys<a[1]-R-10))return null;
 const P=apttPath([[X0,Ys],[X0,a[1]],[a[0],a[1]]],[R]),v=K.vApp,z0=a[3]||80;
 return apttMove({kind:'inbound',path:P,prof:apttProf(P.len,()=>v),th0:Math.PI/2,z:s=>z0+50*(1-s/P.len),al:()=>1})}
function apttTakeoff(ac,pts,radii,th0,xLo){
 
 const K=APTT_CLS[ac],P=apttPath(pts,radii),len=P.len,na=P.arcs.length,last=P.arcs[na-1],sAE=last.s1,xAE=apttAt(P,sAE)[0],sLo=sAE+((xLo||K.xLo)-xAE),vArc=30;
 const acc=(K.vLift*K.vLift-vArc*vArc)/(2*(sLo-sAE)),cap=Math.min(595,K.vLift*1.25);
 const zones=P.arcs.map((a,i)=>[a.s0,a.s1,i===na-1?vArc:34]);
 const pre=apttVfn(sAE,{vmax:K.vTaxi,v0:6,v1:vArc,acc:20,dec:30,zones});
 const fn=s=>s<sAE?pre(s):Math.min(cap,Math.sqrt(vArc*vArc+2*acc*(s-sAE)));
 return apttMove({kind:'takeoff',path:P,prof:apttProf(len,fn),mode:'trk',th0,d:apttD(ac),
  z:s=>s<sLo?0:Math.min(130,(s-sLo)*.16),al:()=>1,meta:{sAE,sLo}});   
}
function apttPush(ac,cx,ngy,o={}){
 const K=APTT_CLS[ac],dir=o.dir||-1,yE=o.yE||APTT_X.LY,dx=o.dx||80,yMid=o.yMid??Math.max(yE+30,ngy-146);
 const P=apttPath([[cx,ngy],[cx,yMid],[cx+dir*dx,yE]],60),len=P.len;
 const fn=apttVfn(len,{vmax:K.vPush,v0:3,v1:3,acc:6,dec:6});
 return apttMove({kind:'push',path:P,prof:apttProf(len,fn),mode:'push',th0:Math.PI/2,th1:dir<0?Math.PI:0,sa:len*(o.sa??.2),sb:len*.95});
}


function apttVehTrack(id,nm,t0,legs,extra){
 const g=APTT_SPEC.veh[id],fp=g.fp;
 return Object.assign({kind:'veh',id,nm,t0,seq:apttSeq(legs),hx:fp[2]/2,hy:fp[3]/2},extra||{});
}
function apttVehMove(pts,radii,vmax,o={}){
 const P=apttPath(pts,radii,o.fullEnds?o:null),len=P.len;
 const fn=apttVfn(len,{vmax,v0:o.v0??8,v1:o.v1??6,acc:18,dec:20,zacc:25,zones:apttArcZones(P,Math.min(vmax,22),0)});

function aplAudit(A){
 A=A||APL;const issues=[],C=APTT_C,Z=A.zones;
 const bld=C.bld.map(b=>({id:b.id,x0:b.x,x1:b.x+b.w,y0:b.y,y1:b.y+b.h}));
 const paved=[{x0:G77_STRIP.x,x1:G77_STRIP.x+G77_STRIP.w,y0:G77_STRIP.y,y1:G77_STRIP.y+G77_STRIP.h},{x0:5400,x1:6020,y0:394,y1:845},{x0:6020,x1:7236,y0:394,y1:772},{x0:G73_WEST_EXT.x,x1:G73_WEST_EXT.x+G73_WEST_EXT.w,y0:G73_WEST_EXT.y,y1:G73_WEST_EXT.y+G73_WEST_EXT.h},Z.wApron,Z.eBlock,Z.hard,Z.ne].map(r=>r.x0!==undefined?r:{x0:r.x,x1:r.x+r.w,y0:r.y,y1:r.y+r.h});
 const envOf=(s,ac)=>{const v=g77StandView(s,ac);return aplEnv(ac,v.ngx,v.ngy,v.th).map(aplBox)};
 const merge=a=>{let m={x0:1e9,x1:-1e9,y0:1e9,y1:-1e9};for(const b of a){m.x0=Math.min(m.x0,b.x0);m.x1=Math.max(m.x1,b.x1);m.y0=Math.min(m.y0,b.y0);m.y1=Math.max(m.y1,b.y1)}return m};
 const info=[];
 for(const s of A.stands){
  for(const ac of s.accepts){
   const env=envOf(s,ac),bb=merge(env);
   if(s.indoor){const h=bld.find(b=>b.id===s.hangar);if(!(bb.x0>=h.x0+4&&bb.x1<=h.x1-4&&bb.y0>=h.y0+4&&bb.y1<=h.y1-4))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': not inside '+s.hangar);continue}
   for(const e of env){
    for(const b of bld)if(aplHit(e,b,2))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': ✕ building '+b.id);
    for(const d of A.doors)if(aplHit(e,d,0))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': ✕ door envelope '+d.id);
    for(const d of A.alleys)if(aplHit(e,d,0))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': ✕ service alley '+d.id);
    if(aplHit(e,{x0:Z.perim.x,x1:Z.perim.x+Z.perim.w,y0:Z.perim.y,y1:Z.perim.y+Z.perim.h},0))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': ✕ perimeter road');
    if(e.y0<APT_Y.TS-4)issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': over the taxiway edge (y '+e.y0.toFixed(0)+')');
   }
   
   if(!paved.some(p=>bb.x0>=p.x0-1&&bb.x1<=p.x1+1&&bb.y0>=p.y0-1&&bb.y1<=p.y1+1)){
    
    const u={x0:4805,x1:7236,y0:604,y1:845};const u2={x0:5400,x1:7236,y0:394,y1:772};
    const lg=s.large&&(ac==='AC-LG-01'||ac==='AC-MW-01')&&bb.x0>=6700&&bb.x1<=7316&&bb.y1<=772&&bb.y0>=G77_LG_EXT.y&&env.every(e=>e.y0>=APT_Y.LN||(e.x0>=G77_LG_EXT.x&&e.x1<=G77_LG_EXT.x+G77_LG_EXT.w));   
    if(!lg&&!((bb.x0>=u.x0&&bb.x1<=u.x1&&bb.y0>=u.y0&&bb.y1<=u.y1)||(bb.x0>=u2.x0&&bb.x1<=u2.x1&&bb.y0>=u2.y0&&bb.y1<=u2.y1)))issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+': not on paving ['+bb.x0.toFixed(0)+'..'+bb.x1.toFixed(0)+' × '+bb.y0.toFixed(0)+'..'+bb.y1.toFixed(0)+']')}
   info.push({id:s.id,ac,x0:+bb.x0.toFixed(0),x1:+bb.x1.toFixed(0),y0:+bb.y0.toFixed(0),y1:+bb.y1.toFixed(0)});
  }
 }
 
 for(const a of A.stands){if(a.indoor)continue;
  for(const b of A.stands){if(b===a||b.indoor||a.id>=b.id)continue;
   for(const ac of a.accepts)for(const bc of b.accepts){if(g77Mars(a,ac,b)||g77Mars(b,bc,a))continue;
    const ea=envOf(a,ac),eb=envOf(b,bc);
    let hit=false;for(const p of ea)for(const q of eb)if(aplHit(p,q,3))hit=true;
    if(hit)issues.push('stands '+a.id+'('+ac.slice(3,5)+')/'+b.id+'('+bc.slice(3,5)+') overlap');
   }}}
 
 for(const r of g77MaintRoute()){for(const b of bld)if(aplHit(r,b,0))issues.push('maint-route '+r.id+' ✕ building '+b.id);
  for(const b of A.bays)if(b.x0!=null&&b.y0!=null&&aplHit(r,b,0))issues.push('maint-route '+r.id+' ✕ bay '+b.id);
  for(const s of A.stands){if(s.id==='P6'||s.indoor)continue;for(const ac of s.accepts)for(const e of envOf(s,ac))if(aplHit(r,e,0))issues.push('maint-route '+r.id+' ✕ stand '+s.id+'/'+ac.slice(3,5))}}
 return{ok:issues.length===0,issues,stands:A.stands.length,helis:A.helis.length,bays:A.bays.length,fleet:A.fleet.length,info};
}

function afCum(tr){
 if(tr._cum)return tr._cum;
 const dur=tr.seq.dur,dt=.1,n=Math.ceil(dur/dt)+1,C=new Float32Array(n);let p0=tr.seq.at(0)||tr.seq.at(1e-6);
 for(let i=1;i<n;i++){const p=tr.seq.at(Math.min(i*dt,dur-1e-6));C[i]=C[i-1]+(p&&p0?Math.hypot(p[0]-p0[0],p[1]-p0[1]):0);if(p)p0=p}
 return tr._cum=C;
}
function afCartAt(pose,i,lt,tr){
 const d=(tr&&tr.cd||AF_CD)[i];
 if(lt==null||!tr||!tr.seq||!tr.seq.legs.length){const c=Math.cos(pose[2]),s=Math.sin(pose[2]);return[pose[0]-c*d,pose[1]-s*d,pose[2]]}
 const C=afCum(tr),dt=.1,n=C.length,f=Math.min(Math.max(lt,0)/dt,n-1),a=Math.floor(f),b=Math.min(n-1,a+1),cur=C[a]+(C[b]-C[a])*(f-a),D=cur-d;
 if(D<=0){const p=tr.seq.at(0),c=Math.cos(p[2]),s=Math.sin(p[2]);return[p[0]+c*D,p[1]+s*D,p[2]]}
 let lo=0,hi=n-1;while(hi-lo>1){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(C[m]<=D)lo=m;else hi=m}
 const tt=(lo+(C[hi]>C[lo]?(D-C[lo])/(C[hi]-C[lo]):0))*dt,p=tr.seq.at(Math.min(tt,tr.seq.dur-1e-6));
 return[p[0],p[1],p[2]];
}

}

function g77RouteClear(sd,ac,role,D){

 const F=[];const vw=g77BeltView(sd,ac,role);    apttShapes({kind:'ac',id:ac,nm:'G77-OWN'},[vw.ngx??sd.ngx,vw.ngy,vw.th,0,1],F);const own=F.filter(q=>q.L==='F');

  return true}

 const fin=b=>b.x0<=b.x1&&b.y0<=b.y1;

    for(const e of SG.all)if(hit(a,e)){RC.ms+=performance.now()-T0;return false}for(const e of IG.all)if(e[3]!==vid&&hit(a,e)){RC.ms+=performance.now()-T0;return false}

function g77GseDest(role,sd,ac){

function g77SvcPlan(sd,ac,code,q,phase,dwell){

 if(phase==='early'){add('gpu',4,Math.max(60,dwell-50));add('belt',6,Math.max(80,dwell-16));add('highloader',8,Math.max(90,dwell-40));return out}
 add('cleaning',12+walk(q.paxA),Math.min(110,Math.max(40,30+seats*.3)));
 add('water',24,30);add('lavatory',34,30);
 add('catering',20+q.paxA*.25,typeof s6rCatHold==='function'?s6rCatHold(sd,ac,code):Math.min(95,35+seats*.25));   
 return out}

function g77StandLoop(sd,ac){const g=apttAcGeom(ac),P=g77Prof(sd,ac),side=g77CargoSide(sd),hw=g.F[3],hl=!!(P&&P.svc.includes('highloader')),S=APTT_SPEC.ac[ac];

 return{inX,outX,yT,hl,side,door:[sd.cx+side*hw,sd.ngy+(dr?dr[0]-ng[0]:-10)]}}

function g77TrainBuild(v,sd,ac,kind,n){
 const vm=AF.VMAX.CU,LN=CARGO_W.lane,K=G77_DK,S=g77StandLoop(sd,ac),h=v.bay.x,cd=K.cd,O=K.outX,legs=[],ev=[];let pose=v.home,t=0;
 const go=(pts,kd)=>{const m=afMv(pts,vm,{th0:pose[2],blend:28,v0:4,v1:3});m.kind=kd||'mid';legs.push(m);pose=m.endPose();t+=m.dur;return m};
 const hold=(dur,tag)=>{const m=apttHold(pose,dur,'svc');m.cg=tag;legs.push(m);const a=t;t+=dur;return a};
 const U=(x0,y,x1)=>{const r=Math.abs(x1-x0)/2,top=y-12-r;return[[x0,y,0],[x0,top,r],[x1,top,r]]};
 const yS=k=>S.yT-cd[k],tx=S.hl?10:6,dk=4.5,out={kind,n,ev:[],stand:null,deck:null};
 const atStand=dir=>{const t0=t;for(let k=0;k<n;k++){const a=hold(tx,{at:'stand',k,dir});out.ev.push({k,t0:a,t1:a+tx,where:'stand',dir});if(k<n-1)go([[S.inX,yS(k),0],[S.inX,yS(k+1),0]],'svc')}out.stand={t0,t1:t}};
 const atDeck=dir=>{const t0=t;hold(n*dk+1,{at:'deck',dir});for(let k=0;k<n;k++)out.ev.push({k,t0:t0+.5+k*dk,t1:t0+.5+(k+1)*dk,where:'deck',dir});out.deck={t0,t1:t}};
 if(kind==='in'){
  go([...U(h,K.stopY,O),[O,LN,16],[S.inX,LN,16],[S.inX,yS(0),0]],'out');atStand('on');
  go([...U(S.inX,yS(n-1),S.outX),[S.outX,LN,16],[K.inX,LN,16],[K.inX,K.stopY,0]],'mid');atDeck('off');
  go([...U(K.inX,K.stopY,O),[O,LN,14],[h,LN,14],[h,K.stopY,0]],'back');
 }else{
  go([...U(h,K.stopY,O),[O,LN,14],[K.inX,LN,16],[K.inX,K.stopY,0]],'out');atDeck('on');
  go([...U(K.inX,K.stopY,O),[O,LN,16],[S.inX,LN,16],[S.inX,yS(0),0]],'mid');atStand('off');
  go([...U(S.inX,yS(n-1),S.outX),[S.outX,LN,16],[h,LN,14],[h,K.stopY,0]],'back');
 }
 const trk=afTrackOf(v,legs);trk.cg=out;return{trk,dur:trk.seq.dur,dStand:out.stand.t0,dStandEnd:out.stand.t1,deck:out.deck,cg:out}}

function* g77TrainG(sd,ac,kind,ulds,tStand,maxD,meta,xh){
 const n=ulds.length;let best=null;
 for(const v of afCands('CU',2)){
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;
  const B=g77TrainBuild(v,sd,ac,kind,n),sm=(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)));
  const sNom=Math.max(aoSlUp(tStand-B.dStand),afSEarliest()),lim=sNom+aoSl(maxD);let s0=sNom,s=-1;
  while(s0<=lim){s=(yield* afSearchG(v,B.trk,sm,s0,best?Math.min(best.s-1,lim):lim,xh,sm.K));if(s<0)break;if(g77DeckFree(g77DeckIv(B,s,kind,n)))break;s0=s+4;s=-1}
  if(s<0)continue;if(!best||s<best.s)best={v,B,sm,s};if(s-sNom<=aoSl(6))break}
 if(!best)return null;
 best.B.cg.ulds=ulds.slice();best.B.cg.code=meta.code;
 const t0=aoT(best.s),task=afCommit(best.v,best.B.trk,best.sm,best.s,'cgo',Object.assign({kind,ulds:ulds.slice(),at:t0+best.B.dStand,done:t0+best.B.dStandEnd},meta));
 {const iv=g77DeckIv(best.B,best.s,kind,n);g77DeckAdd(iv);task.deck=g77DeckRec(best.B,best.s,kind,ulds,iv,task)}task.cg=best.B.cg;task.v=best.v;return task}

function g77CargoUnits(code,q){const u=q&&q.cargoU||0,A=[],D=[];for(let k=0;k<u;k++){A.push(code+'/I'+(k+1));D.push(code+'/O'+(k+1))}return{in:A,out:D}}
function g77Chunks(a,n){const o=[];for(let i=0;i<a.length;i+=n)o.push(a.slice(i,i+n));return o}

function* g77CargoTripsG(sd,ac,code,q,hl,tOB,xh,P){
 const C=g77CargoUnits(code,q),S=g77StandLoop(sd,ac),trips=[];if(!C.in.length&&!C.out.length)return{trips,end:0};
 let tA=hl?hl.at+6:tOB+G77_CHOCK+24,end=0,left=Math.ceil(C.in.length/3)+Math.ceil(C.out.length/3);const tMax=hl?hl.done-4:Infinity;
 for(const [kind,list] of [['in',C.in],['out',C.out]])for(const ul of g77Chunks(list,3)){
  const r=yield* g77TrainG(sd,ac,kind,ul,tA,420,{code,svc:'cargo'},xh);if(!r||r.done>tMax)return null;
  trips.push(r);P.vt.push(r);tA=r.done+2;end=Math.max(end,r.done+4);left--;if(tA+left*36>tMax)return null}   
 P.cgo={in:C.in,out:C.out,trips,loop:S,hl:hl||null};return{trips,end}}

function g77DeckState(t){const out=[];for(const R of AO.g77DeckR||[]){if(t<R.iv[0]||t>R.iv[1])continue;

function g77CargoLedger(P){

 for(const T of P.cgo.trips){const R=T.deck,cg=T.cg||T.tr&&T.tr.cg;if(!R||!cg)continue;const S=P.cgo.loop,n=T.ulds.length,t0=T.t0;
  const pcs=T.ulds.map(g77UldPieces),tot=pcs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0),h=g77Hash(code+'#c'+j),rail=false,dock=G77_DOCKS[(T.kind==='out'?0:2)+h%2];
  const st=k=>cg.ev.find(e=>e.k===k&&e.where==='stand'),dk=k=>cg.ev.find(e=>e.k===k&&e.where==='deck');
  if(T.kind==='out'){const C={id:'CT-'+code+'-'+(++j),dir:'in',src:rail?'rail–air (FRT)':'truck '+dock.id,dock:rail?null:dock.id,pieces:tot,ulds:T.ulds.slice(),tArr:R.iv[0]-70-h%90,tOpen:R.iv[0]-24,tOpen1:R.iv[0]-1};L.containers.push(C);
   T.ulds.forEach((u,k)=>{const b0=R.iv[0]+G77_CONV_T+k*G77_ULD_BUILD,e1=dk(k),e2=st(k);L.ulds[u]={id:u,dir:'out',pieces:pcs[k],container:C.id,trip:T.v&&T.v.id,dolly:k,
    ev:[{t:C.tArr,at:'AP-05 · '+C.src},{t:C.tOpen,t1:C.tOpen1,at:'opened · forklift'},{t:b0-G77_CONV_T,t1:b0+G77_ULD_BUILD,at:'AP-05 → conveyor → deck slot '+k+' (built)'},
     {t:t0+e1.t0,t1:t0+e1.t1,at:'deck → dolly '+k,mover:T.v&&T.v.id},{t:t0+e1.t1,t1:t0+e2.t0,at:'dolly '+k+' · train',mover:T.v&&T.v.id},{t:t0+e2.t0,t1:t0+e2.t1,at:S.hl?'dolly → high loader → door':'dolly → door',mover:S.hl?(P.cgo.hl&&P.cgo.hl.v&&P.cgo.hl.v.id):T.v&&T.v.id},{t:t0+e2.t1,at:'aboard '+code}]}})}
  else{const C={id:'CX-'+code+'-'+(++j),dir:'out',dst:rail?'rail–air (FRT)':'truck '+dock.id,dock:rail?null:dock.id,pieces:tot,ulds:T.ulds.slice(),tFull:R.iv[1]+G77_CONV_T+1};L.containers.push(C);

    ev:[{t:P.tOB,at:'aboard '+code},{t:t0+e2.t0,t1:t0+e2.t1,at:S.hl?'door → high loader → dolly':'door → dolly',mover:S.hl?(P.cgo.hl&&P.cgo.hl.v&&P.cgo.hl.v.id):T.v&&T.v.id},{t:t0+e2.t1,t1:t0+e1.t0,at:'dolly '+k+' · train',mover:T.v&&T.v.id},

function g77CargoAudit(fl){
 fl=fl||AO.hist.concat(AO.flights);const r={visits:0,ulds:0,trips:0,containers:0,pieces:0,issues:[]},bad=m=>{if(r.issues.length<16)r.issues.push(m)};
 const conv=[];
 for(const P of fl){if(!P.cgo)continue;r.visits++;const L=g77CargoLedger(P),S=P.cgo.loop,hl=P.cgo.hl;
  const nIn=Math.ceil(P.cgo.in.length/3),nOut=Math.ceil(P.cgo.out.length/3),ti=P.cgo.trips.filter(t=>t.kind==='in').length,to=P.cgo.trips.filter(t=>t.kind==='out').length;
  if(ti!==nIn||to!==nOut)bad('TRIPS '+P.code+' '+ti+'/'+nIn+' '+to+'/'+nOut);
  const all=P.cgo.in.concat(P.cgo.out);for(const u of all){if(!L.ulds[u]){bad('NO-TRACE '+u);continue}r.ulds++;const ev=L.ulds[u].ev;for(let i=1;i<ev.length;i++){const a=ev[i-1],b=ev[i];if(b.t<(a.t1!=null?a.t1:a.t)-1e-6)bad('ORDER '+u+' '+a.at+' → '+b.at)}}
  for(const C of L.containers){r.containers++;let s=0;for(const u of C.ulds)s+=L.ulds[u]?L.ulds[u].pieces:0;if(s!==C.pieces)bad('PIECES '+C.id);r.pieces+=C.pieces}
  for(const T of P.cgo.trips){r.trips++;const cg=T.cg,tr=T.tr,t0=T.t0;if(!cg||!T.deck){bad('NO-TRIP-DATA '+P.code);continue}conv.push([T.kind==='out'?T.deck.iv[0]:T.deck.stop[1],T.kind==='out'?T.deck.iv[0]+G77_CONV_T+T.ulds.length*G77_ULD_BUILD:T.deck.stop[1]+T.ulds.length*G77_ULD_BUILD+G77_CONV_T,P.code]);
   for(const e of cg.ev){const tm=(e.t0+e.t1)/2,p=tr.seq.at(tm),q=tr.cartAt(p,e.k,tm,tr);
    if(e.where==='stand'){if(Math.abs(q[1]-S.yT)>2.5||Math.abs(q[0]-S.inX)>2.5)bad('NOT-ALONGSIDE '+P.code+' dolly '+e.k+' @'+(t0+tm).toFixed(1));
     if(S.hl){if(!hl||t0+e.t0<hl.at-1e-6||t0+e.t1>hl.done+1e-6)bad('NO-LOADER '+P.code+' @'+(t0+e.t0).toFixed(1))}}
    else{const sy=G77_DK.stopY+G77_DK.cd[e.k];if(Math.abs(q[1]-sy)>2.5||Math.abs(q[0]-G77_DK.inX)>2.5)bad('NOT-AT-DECK '+P.code+' dolly '+e.k)}}}}
 conv.sort((a,b)=>a[0]-b[0]);for(let i=1;i<conv.length;i++)if(conv[i][0]<conv[i-1][1]-1e-6)bad('CONVEYOR '+conv[i-1][2]+' / '+conv[i][2]);
 r.ok=!r.issues.length;return r}

function g77SlotY(k){return G77_DK.stopY+G77_DK.cd[k]}

function g77Decks(all){const c=all?-1e9:APT_OPS.clk,K=g77Decks;if(!all&&K.at===c&&K.n===(AO.g77DeckR||[]).length&&K.f===AO.flights.length)return K.v;const S=new Set();
 for(const P of AO.flights.concat(AO.hist)){if(!P.cgo||(P.t1!=null&&P.t1<c-600))continue;for(const T of P.cgo.trips)if(T.deck)S.add(T.deck)}
 const v=(AO.g77DeckR||[]).filter(R=>S.has(R));if(all)return v;K.at=c;K.n=(AO.g77DeckR||[]).length;K.f=AO.flights.length;return K.v=v}
function g77PathLen(P){let l=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++)l+=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);return l}
function g77PathAt(P,s){for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const a=P[i-1],b=P[i],d=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);if(s<=d){const u=d?s/d:0;return[a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*u,a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*u]}s-=d}const z=P[P.length-1];return[z[0],z[1]]}

function g77Lane(k){const C=g77Lane.c||(g77Lane.c=[]);if(C[k])return C[k];const y=g77SlotY(k),P=[[5212,680],[G77V.lane,672],[G77V.lane,y],[5216,y]],L=g77PathLen(P);return C[k]={P,L,dt:L/G77V.laneV}}


function g77Parcels(R){if(R.pp)return R.pp;const pp=[],B=G77_ULD_BUILD,CT=G77_CONV_T;
 for(let k=0;k<R.n;k++){const id=R.ulds[k],m=g77UldPieces(id),dt=g77Lane(k).dt;
  if(R.kind==='out'){const b0=R.iv[0]+CT+k*B;for(let j=0;j<m;j++){const a=b0+(j+.5)*B/m;pp.push({k,j,id,out:1,t0:a-CT,c1:a,t1:a+dt})}}
  else{const d0=R.stop[1]+k*B;for(let j=0;j<m;j++){const l=d0+(j+.5)*B/m;pp.push({k,j,id,out:0,t0:l,c0:l+dt,t1:l+dt+CT})}}}
 return R.pp=pp}

function g77ParcelAt(p,t){if(t<p.t0||t>p.t1)return null;const L=g77ConvLen();
 if(p.out){if(t<p.c1){const q=g77ConvAt((t-p.t0)/G77_CONV_T*L);return[q[0],q[1],q[2],1]}const ln=g77Lane(p.k),q=g77PathAt(ln.P,(t-p.c1)*G77V.laneV);return[q[0],q[1],0,0]}
 if(t<p.c0){const ln=g77Lane(p.k),q=g77PathAt(ln.P,ln.L-(t-p.t0)*G77V.laneV);return[q[0],q[1],0,0]}
 const q=g77ConvAt(L-(t-p.c0)/G77_CONV_T*L);return[q[0],q[1],q[2],1]}

function g77DeckView(t){const out=[];for(const R of g77Decks()){if(t<R.iv[0]-3||t>R.iv[1]+3)continue;const pp=g77Parcels(R);
 for(let k=0;k<R.n;k++){const id=R.ulds[k],m=g77UldPieces(id),tx=R.stop[0]+.5+k*4.5;
  if(R.kind==='out'){const first=R.iv[0]+G77_CONV_T+k*G77_ULD_BUILD;if(t<first-2||t>=tx)continue;let c=0,last=0;for(const p of pp)if(p.k===k){if(p.t1<=t)c++;if(p.t1>last)last=p.t1}
   out.push({k,id,m,c,full:c===m&&t>=last,base:Math.min(1,Math.max(0,t-(first-2)))})}
  else{const ta=tx+4.5,d0=R.stop[1]+k*G77_ULD_BUILD,d1=d0+G77_ULD_BUILD;if(t<ta||t>=d1+1)continue;let c=m;for(const p of pp)if(p.k===k&&p.t0<=t)c--;
   out.push({k,id,m,c,full:t<d0,base:t<d1?1:1-(t-d1)})}}}
 return out}

function g77Pool(t){let n=G77V.pool0+(AO.g77PoolOfs||0);for(const R of g77Decks())for(let k=0;k<R.n;k++){if(R.kind==='out'){if(t>=R.iv[0]+G77_CONV_T+k*G77_ULD_BUILD-2)n--}else if(t>=R.stop[1]+(k+1)*G77_ULD_BUILD+1)n++}return n}
function g77PoolNet(R){return R.kind==='out'?-R.n:R.n}
function g77Smooth(u){u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,u));return u*u*(3-2*u)}


function g77DockJobs(t0,t1,fl){const out=[];for(const P of fl||AO.flights.concat(AO.hist)){if(!P.cgo||(P.t1!=null&&P.t1<t0-400))continue;const L=g77CargoLedger(P);if(!L)continue;
 for(const C of L.containers){if(!C.dock)continue;const n=C.ulds.length,dur=n*G77V.fkT,ta=C.dir==='in'?C.tOpen1-dur:C.tFull,tb=ta+dur;
  if(tb+G77V.doors<t0||ta-G77V.doors>t1)continue;out.push({P,C,ta,tb,n,unload:C.dir==='in',fk:C.dir==='in'?'FL-U':'FL-L',dock:G77_DOCKS.find(d=>d.id===C.dock),pcs:C.ulds.map(u=>L.ulds[u]?L.ulds[u].pieces:0)})}}
 return out}

function g77FkAt(J,t){const T=(J.tb-J.ta)/J.n,i=Math.min(J.n-1,Math.max(0,Math.floor((t-J.ta)/T))),u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(t-J.ta-i*T)/T)),slot=J.unload?i:J.n-1-i,yAt=G77V.pal[slot]-10,yIn=G77V.yIn;
 
 let y,lift,carry;if(u<.45){const w=u/.45;y=yIn+(yAt-yIn)*(1-(1-w)*(1-w));lift=J.unload?0:1;carry=!J.unload}else if(u<.55){y=yAt;const v=(u-.45)/.1;lift=J.unload?v:1-v;carry=J.unload?v>.5:v<.5}else{const w=(u-.55)/.45;y=yAt+(yIn-yAt)*w*w;lift=J.unload?1:0;carry=J.unload}
 const inBox=[];for(let q=0;q<J.n;q++){const sl=J.unload?q:J.n-1-q;let there;if(J.unload)there=q>i||(q===i&&u<.5);else there=q<i||(q===i&&u>=.5);if(t<J.ta)there=J.unload;if(t>=J.tb)there=!J.unload;if(there)inBox.push([sl,q])}
 return{x:J.dock.x,y,lift,carry:carry&&t>=J.ta&&t<J.tb?i:-1,inBox,slot}}
function g77DoorOpen(J,t){const d=G77V.doors;return t<J.ta-d||t>J.tb+d?0:t<J.ta?(t-(J.ta-d))/d:t>J.tb?1-(t-J.tb)/d:1}
function g77Pallet(g,x,y,m,al){g.save();g.globalAlpha=al==null?1:al;g.fillStyle='#a77a45';g.fillRect(x-5,y-5,10,10);   
 g.fillStyle='#c99a5e';g.beginPath();for(let j=0;j<Math.min(m,12);j++)g.rect(x-3.6+(j%3)*2.9,y-3.8+Math.floor(j/3)*2.4,2.5,2.1);g.fill();if(m>12){g.fillStyle='#e1c08f';g.beginPath();for(let j=12;j<m;j++){const jj=j-12;g.rect(x-3+(jj%3)*2.9,y-4.4+Math.floor(jj/3)*2.4,2.5,2.1)}g.fill()}g.restore()}
function g77DrawDocks(now,v){if(WTC_LP===1||G77_STAGE<4||!portVis(v,5480,930,200,80))return;const t=APT_OPS.clk;
 for(const J of g77DockJobs(t-2,t+2)){const op=g77DoorOpen(J,t);if(op<=0)continue;const F=g77FkAt(J,t),x=J.dock.x,[b0,b1]=G77V.box;
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,op*1.4);ctx.fillStyle='#d9dde0';ctx.fillRect(x-13.4,b0-1.8,26.8,b1-b0+3.6);ctx.fillStyle='#3b4147';ctx.fillRect(x-11,b0,22,b1-b0);ctx.strokeStyle='#596168';ctx.lineWidth=.5;ctx.beginPath();for(let y=b0+3;y<b1;y+=4){ctx.moveTo(x-11,y);ctx.lineTo(x+11,y)}ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();   
  for(const [sl,q] of F.inBox)g77Pallet(ctx,x,G77V.pal[sl],J.pcs[q],Math.min(1,op*1.4));
  
  const a=op*Math.PI*.92;ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle='#e9ecee';ctx.lineWidth=1.6;ctx.beginPath();for(const s of[-1,1]){const hx=x+s*13.2,hy=b0-1.6;ctx.moveTo(hx,hy);ctx.lineTo(hx-s*12.6*Math.cos(a),hy+12.6*Math.sin(a))}ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
  
  if(t>=J.ta&&t<J.tb){ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(x-30,944,60,90);ctx.clip();const S=G77V.fkS,I=TurboCity.info('LV-FK-01',{scale:S}),cx=(I.fp[0]+I.fp[2]/2),cy=(I.fp[1]+I.fp[3]/2);
   ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,F.y);ctx.rotate(Math.PI/2);TurboCity.draw(ctx,'LV-FK-01',-cx,-cy,{mode:'runtime',scale:S,state:{c:9},time:now/1000});ctx.restore();
   ctx.fillStyle='#2b2f34';ctx.beginPath();ctx.rect(x-3.2,F.y+8,1.4,6);ctx.rect(x+1.8,F.y+8,1.4,6);ctx.rect(x-4,F.y+7.2-F.lift*1.6,8,1);ctx.fill();   
   if(F.carry>=0)g77Pallet(ctx,x,F.y+10.5-F.lift*1.2,J.pcs[F.carry],1);ctx.restore()}}}

 ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='#4b5157';ctx.fillRect(G77V.lane-3,604,6,76);if(Camera.zoom>=.55){ctx.strokeStyle='#7f878e';ctx.lineWidth=.4;ctx.beginPath();for(let y=606;y<679;y+=2.2){ctx.moveTo(G77V.lane-3,y);ctx.lineTo(G77V.lane+3,y)}ctx.stroke()}   
 const pool=Math.max(0,g77Pool(t));if(pool){ctx.fillStyle='#8e969d';ctx.strokeStyle='#4f565c';ctx.lineWidth=.6;ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<Math.min(pool,8);i++)ctx.rect(x-8,G77V.stackY-5.5-i*.9,16,11);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke()}ctx.restore();

function g77ConvParcels(t){const out=[];for(const R of g77Decks()){if(t<R.iv[0]-1||t>R.iv[1]+1)continue;for(const p of g77Parcels(R)){const q=g77ParcelAt(p,t);if(q&&q[3])out.push([q[0],q[1],q[2],p.out])}}return out}

function g77LookAt(kind){const t=APT_OPS.clk+3;let best=null;const take=(at,x,y,z,lab)=>{if(at>=t&&(!best||at<best.at))best={at,x,y,z,lab}};
 if(kind==='dock')for(const J of g77DockJobs(t,t+3600))take(J.ta-1.5,J.dock.x,975,2.8,(J.unload?'פריקת מכולה ב-':'העמסת מכולה ב-')+J.dock.id);
 if(kind==='build')for(const R of g77Decks())if(R.kind==='out')take(R.iv[0]+G77_CONV_T-4,5300,690,1.7,'הסוע ובניית ULD במשטח');
 if(kind==='train')for(const R of g77Decks())take(R.stop[0]-2,5236,630,2.6,'רכבת מטען במשטח');
 if(kind==='stand')for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.type!=='CU')continue;for(const k of v.tasks.concat(v.hist||[])){const cg=k.cg||k.tr&&k.tr.cg;if(!cg||!cg.stand)continue;const at=k.t0+cg.stand.t0,p=k.tr.seq.at(cg.stand.t0);if(p)take(at-2,p[0],p[1]-20,2.4,'רכבת מטען ומעמיס ליד המטוס')}}
 if(kind==='cat')for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.type!=='CT')continue;for(const k of v.tasks.concat(v.hist||[])){if(!k.tr||!k.tr.seq)continue;let tt=0;for(const l of k.tr.seq.legs){if(l.kind==='svc'){const p=l.pose?l.pose(0):k.tr.seq.at(tt);if(p)take(k.t0+tt+S6R_CAT.ramp+S6R_CAT.ext-1,p[0],p[1],3.4,'קייטרינג: העובד נכנס למטוס עם העגלות');break}tt+=l.dur}}}   
 if(kind&&String(kind).startsWith('bag:'))g77BwLookAt(String(kind).slice(4),take);if(kind&&String(kind).startsWith('door:'))g77DdLookAt(String(kind).slice(5),take);       
 if(kind==='breakdown')for(const R of g77Decks())if(R.kind==='in')take(R.stop[1]-1,5260,660,2.2,'פירוק ULD והחבילות למחסן');
 if(kind==='crew')g77LookCrew(t,take);if(kind==='fill')g77LookFill(t,take);    
 return best}

function g77VisibleWork(fl,t0,t1){fl=fl||AO.hist.concat(AO.flights);const r={records:0,parcels:0,jobs:0,pallets:0,samples:0,poolMin:1e9,beltMax:0,idleHolds:0,issues:[]},bad=m=>{if(r.issues.length<16)r.issues.push(m)};
 const RS=g77Decks(true).filter(R=>R.iv[1]>=t0&&R.iv[0]<=t1),belt=[];
 for(const R of RS){r.records++;const pp=g77Parcels(R);
  for(let k=0;k<R.n;k++){const m=g77UldPieces(R.ulds[k]),mine=pp.filter(p=>p.k===k);if(mine.length!==m)bad('PARCELS '+R.ulds[k]+' '+mine.length+'/'+m);
   if(R.kind==='out'){const tx=R.stop[0]+.5+k*4.5;if(Math.max(...mine.map(p=>p.t1))>tx-1e-6)bad('ULD-NOT-BUILT '+R.ulds[k])}}
  let a=1e9,b=-1e9;for(const p of pp){r.parcels++;let prev=null;for(let s=p.t0;s<=p.t1+1e-9;s+=.1){const q=g77ParcelAt(p,Math.min(s,p.t1));if(!q){bad('GAP '+p.id+'#'+p.j);break}if(prev&&Math.hypot(q[0]-prev[0],q[1]-prev[1])>6)bad('JUMP '+p.id+'#'+p.j+' @'+s.toFixed(1));prev=q}
   const s0=g77ParcelAt(p,p.t0),s1=g77ParcelAt(p,p.t1),W=G77_CONV[0],D=[5216,g77SlotY(p.k)],near=(q,z)=>q&&Math.hypot(q[0]-z[0],q[1]-z[1])<1.5;
   if(p.out?!(near(s0,W)&&near(s1,D)):!(near(s0,D)&&near(s1,W)))bad('ENDS '+p.id+'#'+p.j);const c0=p.out?p.t0:p.c0,c1=p.out?p.c1:p.t1;a=Math.min(a,c0);b=Math.max(b,c1)}
  belt.push([a,b,R.kind,R.code])}
 belt.sort((x,y)=>x[0]-y[0]);for(let i=1;i<belt.length;i++)if(belt[i][0]<belt[i-1][1]-1e-6&&belt[i][2]!==belt[i-1][2])bad('BELT-BOTH-WAYS '+belt[i-1][3]+' / '+belt[i][3]);
 
 const J=g77DockJobs(t0,t1,fl),by={};for(const j of J){r.jobs++;r.pallets+=j.n;const s=j.pcs.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0);if(s!==j.C.pieces)bad('PALLET-PIECES '+j.C.id);
  for(const key of [j.fk,j.dock.id])(by[key]||(by[key]=[])).push(j);
  const R=RS.filter(q=>q.ulds.join()===j.C.ulds.join()&&q.kind===(j.unload?'out':'in')).sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(a.iv[0]-j.ta)-Math.abs(b.iv[0]-j.ta))[0];if(R){const pp=g77Parcels(R);if(j.unload){if(j.tb>Math.min(...pp.map(p=>p.t0))-1+1e-6)bad('FORKLIFT-LATE '+j.C.id)}else if(j.ta<Math.max(...pp.map(p=>p.t1))-1e-6)bad('FORKLIFT-EARLY '+j.C.id)}}
 for(const [k,L] of Object.entries(by)){L.sort((x,y)=>x.ta-y.ta);for(let i=1;i<L.length;i++)if(L[i].ta-G77V.doors<L[i-1].tb+G77V.doors)bad('OVERLAP '+k+' '+L[i-1].C.id+' / '+L[i].C.id)}
 
 const trains=[];for(const v of AO.fleet)if(v.type==='CU')for(const k of v.tasks.concat(v.hist||[]))if(k.cg||k.tr&&k.tr.cg)trains.push(k);
 for(let t=t0;t<=t1;t+=.5){r.samples++;const pool=g77Pool(t);if(pool<r.poolMin)r.poolMin=pool;
  for(const j of J){if(t<j.ta||t>=j.tb)continue;const A=g77FkAt(j,t),B=g77FkAt(j,Math.min(j.tb-1e-3,t+.25)),C=g77FkAt(j,Math.max(j.ta,t-.25)),still=(P,Q)=>Math.abs(P.y-Q.y)<.05&&Math.abs(P.lift-Q.lift)<.01;if(still(A,B)&&still(C,A))bad('FORKLIFT-STILL '+j.C.id+' @'+t.toFixed(1))}    
  const bp=g77ConvParcels(t).length;r.beltMax=Math.max(r.beltMax,bp);
  for(const k of trains){const lt=t-k.t0;if(lt<0||lt>k.tr.seq.dur)continue;const cg=k.cg||k.tr.cg;const at=w=>w&&lt>=w.t0+1&&lt<=w.t1-1;if(!at(cg.stand)&&!at(cg.deck))continue;
   const p=k.tr.seq.at(lt),q=k.tr.seq.at(lt+.25),moving=p&&q&&Math.hypot(p[0]-q[0],p[1]-q[1])>.02,st=g77TrainUld(k.tr,lt);if(!moving&&!(st&&st.fly)){r.idleHolds++;if(r.idleHolds<=3)bad('TRAIN-IDLE '+(k.code||'')+' @'+t.toFixed(1))}}}
 if(r.poolMin<0)bad('ULD-BASE-POOL '+r.poolMin);
 
 const s6={};for(const v of AO.fleet){if(['CU','HL','BT','BL','PT','PW'].includes(v.type))continue;for(const k of v.tasks.concat(v.hist||[])){if(k.t0>t1||k.t0+k.tr.seq.dur<t0)continue;const o=s6[v.type]||(s6[v.type]={tasks:0});o.tasks++}}
 r.s6Pending=s6;r.ok=!r.issues.length;return r}

function g77AcInfo(id){const C=g77AcInfo.c||(g77AcInfo.c={});if(C[id])return C[id];const a=TurboCity.get(id);if(!a)return null;const sc=APT_GS/(a.res||1),I=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:sc,rot:0}),an={};for(const q of I.an)if(an[q[0]]===undefined)an[q[0]]=[q[1],q[2]];return C[id]={sc,w:I.w,h:I.h,fp:I.fp,an}}

function g77Anchors(id){const C=g77Anchors.c||(g77Anchors.c={});if(C[id])return C[id];const S=g77AcInfo(id),D=G77_ANCH_DEF[id];if(!S||!D)return null;
 const fp=S.fp,L=fp[2],fw=fp[3],nx=fp[0]+L,cy=fp[1]+fw/2,an=S.an,ng=an['Nose Gear']||[fp[0]+L*.83,cy],rel=(x,y)=>[+(x-ng[0]).toFixed(1),+(y-ng[1]).toFixed(1)],at=(u,s,k=1)=>rel(nx-u*L,cy+s*k*fw/2),out={};
 for(const [n,u,s] of D.doors)out[n]=at(u,s,s?1:0);
 for(const [n,u,s] of D.belly)out[n]=at(u,s,.92);
 if(D.gpu!==false)out['Ground Power']=at(D.gpu,1,.35);if(D.water!==false)out['Water']=at(D.water,1,.45);if(D.waste!==false)out['Waste']=at(D.waste,1,.45);
 const tL=an['Left Wing'],tR=an['Right Wing'],mg=an['Main Gear'];
 if(tL&&tR&&mg&&!/AC-HL/.test(id)){out['Fuel L']=rel(mg[0]+(tL[0]-mg[0])*D.fuel,cy+(tL[1]-cy)*D.fuel);out['Fuel R']=rel(mg[0]+(tR[0]-mg[0])*D.fuel,cy+(tR[1]-cy)*D.fuel)}
 else out['Fuel']=at(D.fuel,1,1);
 out['Nose Gear']=[0,0];out._L=+L.toFixed(1);out._fw=+fw.toFixed(1);out._span=tL&&tR?+(tR[1]-tL[1]).toFixed(1):null;out._nose=+(nx-ng[0]).toFixed(1);out._tail=+(fp[0]-ng[0]).toFixed(1);
 return C[id]=out}

function g77AnchorAudit(){const issues=[];let n=0;for(const id of Object.keys(G77_ANCH_DEF)){const A=g77Anchors(id),S=g77AcInfo(id);if(!A||!S){issues.push(id+' missing');continue}
  const hw=A._fw/2,ng=S.an['Nose Gear'];
  for(const [k,p] of Object.entries(A)){if(k[0]==='_')continue;n++;if(p[0]>A._nose+.5||p[0]<A._tail-.5)issues.push(id+' '+k+' off the fuselage length');
   if(/^Door|Cargo Door|Crew Door/.test(k)&&k!=='Nose Cargo Door'&&Math.abs(Math.abs(p[1])-hw)>.6)issues.push(id+' '+k+' not on the skin');
   if(/Fuel/.test(k)&&A._span&&Math.abs(p[1])>A._span/2)issues.push(id+' '+k+' outside the wing')}
  for(const [k,p] of Object.entries(A)){const m=k.match(/^Door L(\d)$/);if(m){const q=A['Door R'+m[1]];if(q&&Math.abs(q[0]-p[0])>A._L*.06)issues.push(id+' Door L/R'+m[1]+' not abreast')}}
  const d=S.an['Door'];if(d&&ng){const L1=A['Door L1']||A['Main Deck Cargo Door'];if(L1&&Math.hypot(L1[0]-(d[0]-ng[0]),L1[1]-(d[1]-ng[1]))>1.2)issues.push(id+' L1 ≠ the sim Door')}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,types:Object.keys(G77_ANCH_DEF).length,anchors:n,issues:issues.slice(0,12)}}

function g77GeomAny(id){const S=g77AcInfo(id);if(!S)return null;const a=S.an,ng=a['Nose Gear'],fp=S.fp,tL=a['Left Wing'],tR=a['Right Wing'],tl=a['Tail'],nose=a['Nose'];
 return{F:[fp[0]-ng[0],fp[0]+fp[2]-ng[0],fp[1]-ng[1],fp[1]+fp[3]-ng[1]],half:tL&&tR?(tR[1]-tL[1])/2:fp[3]/2,wx:tL?tL[0]-ng[0]:0,nose:nose?nose[0]-ng[0]:fp[0]+fp[2]-ng[0],tail:tl?tl[0]-ng[0]:fp[0]-ng[0],L:fp[2],fw:fp[3]}}

function g77ParkBoxes(id,cx,ngy){const g=g77GeomAny(id);if(!g)return null;const hwW=g.half,wy=ngy+g.wx;

function g77S5Clearance(){if(!APTT_SPEC){APTT_SPEC=aptBuildSpec();APTT_C=aptBuildC()}const A=aptReady(),st=id=>A.stands.find(s=>s.id===id),rows=[],r1=v=>Math.round(v),M=v=>+(v/7.47).toFixed(1);
 const nbHalf=g77GeomAny('AC-NB-01').half,road=AF.L-12,neRoad=[G73_NE.road-12,G73_NE.road+12],bld=APTT_C.bld.map(b=>({id:b.id,x0:b.x,x1:b.x+b.w,y0:b.y,y1:b.y+b.h})),gap=(a,b)=>Math.max(b.x0-a.x1,a.x0-b.x1,b.y0-a.y1,a.y0-b.y1);
 const near=(B,lim=60)=>bld.map(b=>({id:b.id,g:Math.min(gap(B.fus,b),gap(B.wing,b))})).filter(q=>q.g<lim).sort((a,b)=>a.g-b.g).slice(0,2).map(q=>q.id+' '+r1(q.g));
 
 {const P1=st('P1'),P2=st('P2'),g=g77GeomAny('AC-LG-01'),stops=[{lab:'G73 stop (y 640)',ng:G73_MW.stopNg},{lab:'nose 10 px off the service road',ng:Math.floor(road-10-g.nose)}];
  for(const s of stops){const B=g77ParkBoxes('AC-LG-01',P1.cx,s.ng),gP2=Object.fromEntries(P2.accepts.map(a=>{const h=g77GeomAny(a).half;return[a.slice(3,5),r1((P2.cx-h)-(P1.cx+g.half))]}));
   rows.push({case:'AC-LG-01 @ P1 · '+s.lab,ng:s.ng,len_m:M(g.L),span_m:M(g.half*2),noseToServiceRoad:r1(road-B.noseY),tailY:r1(B.tailY),tailIntoLSweep:r1(APT_Y.LY+nbHalf-B.tailY),gapP2:gP2,gapPocketA:r1(Math.min(...F2_POCKETS.A.bays)-10-(P1.cx+g.fw/2)),buildings:near(B)})}}
 
 {const P6=st('P6'),P5=st('P5'),g=g77GeomAny('AC-NB-01'),B=g77ParkBoxes('AC-NB-01',P6.cx,P6.ngy),gP5=Object.fromEntries(P5.accepts.map(a=>{const h=g77GeomAny(a).half;return[a.slice(3,5),r1((P6.cx-g.half)-(P5.cx+h))]}));
  rows.push({case:'AC-NB-01 @ P6 (remote)',ng:P6.ngy,tailY:r1(B.tailY),tailToRoad:r1(B.tailY-neRoad[1]),noseY:r1(B.noseY),hangarGap:r1(Math.min(...bld.filter(b=>/HGR-S/.test(b.id)).map(b=>gap(B.fus,b)))),gapP5:gP5,buildings:near(B)})}
 
 for(const id of ['C1','C3']){const C=st(id),C2=st('C2'),g=g77GeomAny('AC-HC-01'),B=g77ParkBoxes('AC-HC-01',C.cx,C.ngy),h2=g77GeomAny('AC-TP-01').half;
  rows.push({case:'AC-HC-01 @ '+id+' (information)',ng:C.ngy,len_m:M(g.L),span_m:M(g.half*2),tailY:r1(B.tailY),gapC2:r1(id==='C1'?(C2.cx-h2)-(C.cx+g.half):(C.cx-g.half)-(C2.cx+h2)),buildings:near(B)})}
 
 const live=A.stands.filter(s=>s.live!==false&&s.th>1&&s.th<2),pairs=[];for(let i=0;i<live.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<live.length;j++){const a=live[i],b=live[j];if(Math.abs(a.ngy-b.ngy)>140||Math.abs(a.cx-b.cx)>700)continue;
  let worst=null;for(const ta of a.accepts)for(const tb of b.accepts){const ha=g77GeomAny(ta).half,hb=g77GeomAny(tb).half,gg=Math.abs(b.cx-a.cx)-ha-hb;if(!worst||gg<worst.g)worst={g:r1(gg),ta,tb}}pairs.push({pair:a.id+'–'+b.id,worst})}
 return{rows,pairs,decision:g77S5Decision(rows)}}
function g77S5Decision(rows){const lg=rows.filter(r=>/LG-01 @ P1/.test(r.case)),best=lg.find(r=>r.noseToServiceRoad>=10),nb=rows.find(r=>/NB-01 @ P6/.test(r.case));
 return{lgAtP1:best?{stopNg:best.ng,p2:Object.values(best.gapP2).every(v=>v>=15)?'open':'SAFETY BLOCK while the LG is at P1',L1:best.tailIntoLSweep>0?'closed while the LG is parked (tail '+best.tailIntoLSweep+' px inside the L sweep)':'open'}:'no stop keeps the nose off the service road',

  const d1=afMv([[b.x,APL.lanes.xTop,0],[P.x,APL.lanes.xTop,16],[P.x,P.y,0]],vm,{th0:b.th,blend:30,v1:3});d1.kind='out';

  out=afMv([[P.x+22,AF.HW,0],[node.inX,AF.HW,30],...D.inn],vm,{th0:r1.endPose()[2],blend:20,v1:5});out.kind='out';fiPre=[d1,f1,r1];xo=d1.dur+f1.dur+r1.dur}
 else if(o.fi&&o.fi.pre&&(v.type==='WT'||v.type==='LV')&&b.row==='Y'&&node&&S6B_WS.on){const W=S6B_WS,L=APL.lanes,D0=s6aDimOf(v.type)||[44,17],sx=(v.type==='WT'?W.water[0]:W.dump[0])-D0[0]*.12;   
  const ob=afBayOutList(b).slice(0,-1),d1=afMv([...ob,[L.wOut,AF.HE,24],[L.spineIn,AF.HE,24],[L.spineIn,L.O2,20],[W.lay.x1+20,L.O2,14],[W.lay.x1-24,W.lay.y,14],[sx,W.lay.y,0]],vm,{th0:b.th,blend:30,v1:3});d1.kind='out';
  const f1=apttHold(d1.endPose(),g77FiFill(o.fi.fillPre,v.type),'fill');f1.kind='fill';
  out=afMv([[sx,W.lay.y,0],[W.lay.x0+10,W.lay.y,14],[W.lay.x0-28,L.O2,14],[L.wOut,L.O2,40],[L.wOut,AF.HW,30],[node.inX,AF.HW,30],...D.inn],vm,{th0:Math.PI,blend:20,v1:5});out.kind='out';fiPre=[d1,f1];xo=d1.dur+f1.dur}
 else if(g77FwPre(v,b,o)){const P=S6B_DEPOT,CL=CARGO_W.lane,pe=pre?pre.endPose():[b.x,CL,0];    
  const d1=afMv(g77FwToDepot(pe[0],CL),vm,{th0:pe[2],blend:30,v1:3,fullEnds:true});d1.kind='out';

  const r1=apttVehMove([[P.x+22,AF.HW],[P.x,AF.HW-16],[P.x,P.y]],[12],vm*.4,{th0:d1.endPose()[2],rev:true,v0:3,v1:6});r1.kind='out';
  out=afMv([...g77FwFromDepot(CL),...D.inn],vm,{th0:r1.endPose()[2],blend:20,v1:5,fullEnds:true});out.kind='out';fiPre=[d1,f1,r1];xo=d1.dur+f1.dur+r1.dur}
 const e0=out.endPose(),legs=fiPre?[...(pre?[pre]:[]),...fiPre,out]:pre?[pre,out]:[out];
 let th0=e0[2],blend=30,hd=null;
 const retTailF=q=>b.row==='W'||b.row==='WR'?g77WTail(b,q):nb?[...(node?[[node.outX,NB.yE,30]]:[]),[b.x,NB.yE,16],[b.x,b.yc,0]]:east?afBayInEast(b):[...(node?[[node.outX,AF.HE,30]]:[]),...afBayIn(b)];
 if(D.mode==='lead'){ 
  hd=apttHold(e0,hold,'wait');hd.kind='wait';legs.push(hd);const L=o.lead,ld={kind:'lead',dur:L.dur,pose:L.pose};legs.push(ld);const le=L.pose(L.dur);
  const back=afMv([[le[0],le[1],0],...D.back,...retTailF(D.back)],vm,{th0:le[2],blend:24,v0:Math.min(vm,L.v1)});back.kind='back';legs.push(back);
 }else if(D.mode==='tug'){ 
  hd=apttHold(e0,o.hold0,'svc');if(o.off)hd.towOff=o.off;legs.push(hd);
  const push=o.push,off=o.off;

  legs.push(tp);const tpe=tp.pose(push.dur);
  th0=tpe[2];blend=40;
  let bp=tpe;if(D.backRev){const c=Math.cos(tpe[2]),s=Math.sin(tpe[2]),q=[tpe[0]-c*D.backRev,tpe[1]-s*D.backRev],rv=apttVehMove([q,[tpe[0],tpe[1]]],[],vm*.35,{th0:tpe[2],rev:true,v0:2,v1:3});rv.kind='back';legs.push(rv);bp=rv.endPose();th0=bp[2];blend=20}   
  const bq=D.backFrom(bp),back=afMv([...bq,...retTailF(bq)],vm,{th0,blend,v0:6});back.kind='back';legs.push(back);
 }else{
  hd=apttHold(e0,hold,'svc');if(o.fi)hd.fiPump=1;legs.push(hd);
  let from;
  if(D.mode==='rev'){
   const A=D.inn[D.inn.length-2],B=D.inn[D.inn.length-1];
   const RP=D.revPath&&g77FwPost(v,b,o)?g77FwRev(D.revPath):D.revPath,r=RP?apttVehMove(RP,D.revRad||[],vm*.45,{th0:e0[2],rev:true,v0:5,v1:6,fullEnds:!!D.fullEnds}):apttVehMove([[A[0],A[1]],[B[0],B[1]]],[],vm*.45,{th0:e0[2],rev:true,v0:5,v1:6});r.kind='svc';legs.push(r);
   th0=D.revPath?r.endPose()[2]:e0[2];blend=D.revPath?20:46;
  }else if(D.mode==='pivot'){
   const dir=D.dir||1;
   legs.push({kind:'turn',dur:AF.PIV,pose:t=>[e0[0],e0[1],e0[2]+Math.PI*dir*apttSm(t/AF.PIV),0,1]});
   th0=e0[2]+Math.PI*dir;blend=24;
  }else{th0=e0[2];blend=34}
  if(v.type==='FT'&&S6B_DEPOT.on&&b.row==='X'&&node&&(!o.fi||o.fi.post)){const P=S6B_DEPOT;   
   const back=afMv([...D.back,[node.outX,AF.HE,30],[P.x,AF.HE,26],[P.x,P.y,0]],vm,{th0,blend,v0:6,v1:3});back.kind='back';legs.push(back);
   const fl=apttHold(back.endPose(),o.fi?g77FiFill(o.fi.fillPost):s6bFillDur(hold),'fill');fl.kind='fill';legs.push(fl);
   const rv=apttVehMove([[P.x+22,AF.HW],[P.x,AF.HW-16],[P.x,P.y]],[12],vm*.4,{th0:back.endPose()[2],rev:true,v0:3,v1:6});rv.kind='back';legs.push(rv);
   const home=afMv([[P.x+22,AF.HW,0],[b.x,AF.HW,20],[b.x,b.yc,0]],vm,{th0:rv.endPose()[2],blend:20,v0:5});home.kind='back';legs.push(home);
  }else if((v.type==='WT'||v.type==='LV')&&S6B_WS.on&&b.row==='Y'&&node&&(!o.fi||o.fi.post)){const W=S6B_WS,L=APL.lanes,D0=s6aDimOf(v.type)||[44,17],sx=(v.type==='WT'?W.water[0]:W.dump[0])-D0[0]*.12;   
   const back=afMv([...D.back,[node.outX,AF.HE,30],[L.spineIn,AF.HE,24],[L.spineIn,L.O2,20],[W.lay.x1+20,L.O2,14],[W.lay.x1-24,W.lay.y,14],[sx,W.lay.y,0]],vm,{th0,blend,v0:6,v1:3});back.kind='back';legs.push(back);
   const fl=apttHold(back.endPose(),o.fi?g77FiFill(o.fi.fillPost,v.type):s6bWsDur(hold),'fill');fl.kind='fill';legs.push(fl);
   const on=afMv([[sx,W.lay.y,0],[W.lay.x0+10,W.lay.y,14],[W.lay.x0-28,L.O2,14],[b.x-34,L.O2,0]],vm,{th0:Math.PI,blend:20,v0:3,v1:3});on.kind='back';legs.push(on);
   const rv=apttVehMove([[b.x,b.yc],[b.x,L.O2],[b.x-34,L.O2]],[14],vm*.4,{th0:on.endPose()[2],rev:true,v0:3,v1:3});rv.kind='back';legs.push(rv);
  }else if(g77FwPost(v,b,o)&&D.revPath){const P=S6B_DEPOT,CL=CARGO_W.lane,s0=g77FwEnd(legs);    
   const back=afMv(g77FwToDepot(s0[0],CL),vm,{th0,blend,v0:6,v1:3,fullEnds:true});back.kind='back';legs.push(back);
   const fl=apttHold(back.endPose(),g77FiFill(o.fi.fillPost,'FW'),'fill');fl.kind='fill';legs.push(fl);
   const rv=apttVehMove([[P.x+22,AF.HW],[P.x,AF.HW-16],[P.x,P.y]],[12],vm*.4,{th0:back.endPose()[2],rev:true,v0:3,v1:6});rv.kind='back';legs.push(rv);
   const home=afMv([...g77FwFromDepot(CL),...g77WTail(b,null)],vm,{th0:rv.endPose()[2],blend:20,v0:5,fullEnds:true});home.kind='back';legs.push(home);
  }else {const back=afMv([...D.back,...retTailF(D.back)],vm,{th0,blend,v0:6,fullEnds:b.row==='WR'});back.kind='back';legs.push(back)}
 }
 if(b.row==='W')g77WIn(legs,b,vm);if(b.row==='EM')g77AmbIn(legs,b,vm);   
 const trk=afTrackOf(v,legs);
 return{trk,dOut:out.dur+(pre?pre.dur:0)+xo,hold:hd.dur,dur:trk.seq.dur};
}



function afExtraOk(sm,s,extra,kEnd){
 if(!extra)return true;
 const k0=Math.max(0,extra.from-s),k1=Math.min(sm.K-1,kEnd);
 for(let k=k0;k<=k1;k++){const A=sm.S[k];for(let i=0;i<A.length;i++)for(const b of extra.sh)if(aoC(A[i],b))return false}
 return true;
}
function afSearch(v,trk,sm,sMin,sMax,extra,kEnd){
 let s=sMin;const dur=trk.seq.dur;
 for(let it=0;it<80&&s<=sMax;it++){
  
  let moved=true;
  while(moved){moved=false;const t0=aoT(s);for(const k of v.tasks)if(t0<k.t1+AF.GAP&&t0+dur>k.t0-AF.GAP){s=Math.max(s+1,aoSlUp(k.t1+AF.GAP));moved=true;break}}
  if(s>sMax)return -1;
  
  const s2=aoSearch(sm,s,sMax);if(s2<0)return -1;
  if(s2!==s){s=s2;continue}                       
  
  return afExtraOk(sm,s,extra,kEnd)?s:-1;
 }
 return -1;
}function* afSearchG(v,trk,sm,sMin,sMax,extra,kEnd){
 let s=sMin;const dur=trk.seq.dur;
 for(let it=0;it<80&&s<=sMax;it++){
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;
  
  let moved=true;
  while(moved){moved=false;const t0=aoT(s);for(const k of v.tasks)if(t0<k.t1+AF.GAP&&t0+dur>k.t0-AF.GAP){s=Math.max(s+1,aoSlUp(k.t1+AF.GAP));moved=true;break}}
  if(s>sMax)return -1;
  
  const s2=yield* aoSearchG(sm,s,sMax);if(s2<0)return -1;
  if(s2!==s){s=s2;continue}                       
  
  return afExtraOk(sm,s,extra,kEnd)?s:-1;
 }
 return -1;
}
function afCommit(v,trk,sm,s,role,meta){
 aoCommit(sm,s);
 const t0=aoT(s),task=Object.assign({t0,t1:t0+trk.seq.dur,tr:trk,role},meta||{});
 v.tasks.push(task);v.tasks.sort((a,b)=>a.t0-b.t0);
 AO.LOG.push(()=>{const i=v.tasks.indexOf(task);if(i>=0)v.tasks.splice(i,1)});
 AF.stats.tasks++;
 return task;
}
const afSEarliest=()=>aoSlUp(AO.t+.6);



G77_FI.gaps=true;G77_FI.brk=true;   
function* g77FiTryG(v,D,ac,hold,tNom,maxD,bestS,extra){const F=G77_FI,C=F.T[v.type],cap=C.cap,up=g77FiUp(ac,v.type),lim=Math.max(F.min*cap,C.keep||0);
 const T=v.tasks.filter(k=>k.fi).sort((a,b)=>a.t0-b.t0);let res=null;
 for(let g=0;g<=T.length;g++){
  const L0=g===0?(v.fiL!=null?v.fiL:cap):T[g-1].fi.after,w0=g===0?-Infinity:T[g-1].t1+AF.GAP,w1=g<T.length?T[g].t0-AF.GAP:Infinity;
  for(const lm of (lim>F.min*cap+1e-6?[lim,F.min*cap]:[lim])){    
  const pre=L0<up-1e-6,before=pre?cap:L0,left=before-up,post=left<lm-1e-6,after=post?cap:left;
  const fi={up,L0,before,left,after,pre,post,fillPre:pre?cap-L0:0,fillPost:post?cap-left:0,free:w0};
  let ok=true,Lc=after;const upd=[];
  for(let j=g;j<T.length;j++){const q=T[j].fi,b2=q.pre?cap:Lc,l2=b2-q.up;if(b2<q.up-1e-6||(!q.post&&l2<F.min*cap-1e-6)){ok=false;break}
   const a2=q.post?cap:l2;upd.push([q,{L0:Lc,before:b2,left:l2,after:a2}]);Lc=a2}
  if(!ok)continue;
  const B=afBuild(v,D,hold,{fi}),sm=(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)));
  const sNom=Math.max(aoSlUp(tNom-B.dOut),afSEarliest(),w0>-1e9?aoSlUp(w0):0);
  let sMax=(G77_FI.brk?Math.max(aoSlUp(tNom-B.dOut),afSEarliest()):sNom)+aoSl(maxD);if(bestS!=null)sMax=Math.min(sMax,bestS-1);if(res)sMax=Math.min(sMax,res.s-1);if(w1<Infinity)sMax=Math.min(sMax,aoSl(w1-B.trk.seq.dur));
  if(sMax<sNom)continue;
  const s=(yield* afSearchG(v,B.trk,sm,sNom,sMax,extra,Math.round((B.dOut+B.hold+16)/AO.DT)));
  if(s<0)continue;res={s,sNom,sReq:Math.max(aoSlUp(tNom-B.dOut),afSEarliest()),B,sm,fi,upd};break}}
 return res}
function g77FiApply(upd){if(!upd)return;for(const [q,val] of upd){const old={L0:q.L0,before:q.before,left:q.left,after:q.after};Object.assign(q,val);AO.LOG.push(()=>{Object.assign(q,old)})}}
function* afServeG(role,sd,ac,tNom,hold,maxD,meta,extra){
 const D=afDest(role,sd,ac);if(!D){AF.last='nodest '+role+' '+sd.id+' '+ac;return null}
 let best=null;
 for(const v of (role==='bag'?f2BagCandidates(sd,6):g77Cands(role,sd,5))){
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;                      
  if(G77_FI.on&&G77_FI.gaps&&(role==='fuel'||role==='wat'||role==='lav')&&G77_FI.T&&G77_FI.T[v.type]){   
   const r=(yield* g77FiTryG(v,D,ac,hold,tNom,maxD,best?best.s:null,extra));
   if(!r){const key=role+':fi-none';AF.fails[key]=(AF.fails[key]||0)+1;continue}
   if(!best||r.s<best.s)best={v,B:r.B,sm:r.sm,s:r.s,fi:r.fi,upd:r.upd};
   if(r.s-(G77_FI.brk?r.sReq:r.sNom)<=aoSl(6))break;   
   continue}
  const fi=(role==='fuel'||role==='wat'||role==='lav')?g77FiPlan(v,ac):null;   
  const B=role==='bag'?f2BagBuild(v,sd,ac,hold,(meta&&meta.kind)||'arr',meta&&meta.code):afBuild(v,D,hold,fi?{fi}:{}),sm=(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)));
  const sNom=Math.max(aoSlUp(tNom-B.dOut),afSEarliest(),fi&&fi.free>-1e9?aoSlUp(fi.free):0);
  const W_=meta&&meta.win;let sLo=sNom,sHi=best?best.s-1:sNom+aoSl(maxD);if(W_){const sMax=aoSl(W_[1]-B.hold-B.dOut);sLo=Math.max(aoSlUp(W_[0]-B.dOut),afSEarliest(),Math.min(sNom,sMax-aoSl(W_[2]||0)));sHi=Math.min(best?best.s-1:sMax,sMax);if(sHi<sLo){const key=role+':win';AF.fails[key]=(AF.fails[key]||0)+1;continue}}    
  const s=(yield* afSearchG(v,B.trk,sm,sLo,sHi,extra,Math.round((B.dOut+B.hold+16)/AO.DT)));
  if(s<0){const w=aoWhy(sm,sNom);const key=role+':'+(w?w.b.replace(/\d+/g,'#'):'busy/none');AF.fails[key]=(AF.fails[key]||0)+1;
   if(AO.diagF){AF.fd=AF.fd||[];if(AF.fd.length<400)AF.fd.push({role,sd:sd.id,ac,v:v.id,sNom,t:+aoT(sNom).toFixed(1),w,k:w?w.k:null,leg:w&&B.trk.seq.legAt(w.k*.25)?B.trk.seq.legAt(w.k*.25).leg.kind:null,at:w&&B.trk.seq.at(w.k*.25)?B.trk.seq.at(w.k*.25).slice(0,2).map(Math.round):null})}continue}
  if(!best||s<best.s)best={v,B,sm,s,fi};
  if(s-(G77_FI.brk&&fi?Math.max(aoSlUp(tNom-B.dOut),afSEarliest()):sNom)<=aoSl(6))break;   
 }
 if(!best){AF.stats.fail++;return null}
 const task=afCommit(best.v,best.B.trk,best.sm,best.s,role,Object.assign({code:meta&&meta.code,at:aoT(best.s)+best.B.dOut},meta));
 if(best.upd)g77FiApply(best.upd);   
 if(best.fi){task.fi=best.fi;G77_FI.stats.tasks++;if(best.fi.pre)G77_FI.stats.pre++;if(best.fi.post)G77_FI.stats.post++}   
 return{t0:task.t0,end:task.t1,at:task.at,done:task.at+best.B.hold,v:best.v,task};
}
function afServe(...a){const sl=AO.sliced;AO.sliced=false;const g=afServeG(...a);let r;do{r=g.next()}while(!r.done);AO.sliced=sl;return r.value}



function afCouple(role,sd,ac,opts){
 const D=afDest(role,sd,ac);if(!D)return null;
 const cands=[],bfs=opts.befores||[opts.before];
 for(const v of (role==='bag'?f2BagCandidates(sd,6):g77Cands(role,sd,role==='tug'&&G77_NB.on?6:3))){

function afBusyShift(v,t0,dur){let m=1;for(const k of v.tasks)if(t0<k.t1+AF.GAP&&t0+dur>k.t0-AF.GAP)m=Math.max(m,aoSlUp(k.t1+AF.GAP-t0));return m}


function afChores(now){
 for(const v of AO.fleet){
  if(!RSP_E.bays.length||(v.type!=='SH'&&v.type!=='MX'))continue;   
  if(v.nextChore==null){v.nextChore=now+aoR(20,150);continue}
  if(now+AO.H<v.nextChore)continue;
  const k=Math.floor(AO.rng()*3),D=afChoreDest(v,k),hold=aoR(...D.hold),tReq=Math.max(v.nextChore,now+2);
  const B=afBuild(v,D,hold),sm=aoSamp(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq));
  const s0=Math.max(aoSlUp(tReq),afSEarliest()),s=afSearch(v,B.trk,sm,s0,s0+aoSl(120));
  if(s>=0){afCommit(v,B.trk,sm,s,'chore',{code:v.id});v.nextChore=aoT(s)+B.dur+aoR(150,420)}
  else v.nextChore=now+aoR(30,90);
 }
}function* afChoresG(now){

}
function afPrune(now){
 for(const v of AO.fleet){
  while(v.tasks.length&&v.tasks[0].t1<now-2){const k=v.tasks.shift();if(k.fi)v.fiL=k.fi.after;if(AO.keep)v.hist.push(k)}
 }
}

function afPose(v,t){
 for(const k of v.tasks)if(t>=k.t0&&t<k.t1){const p=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0);if(p)return{pose:p,tr:k.tr,task:k}}
 return{pose:v.home,tr:v.tr0,task:null};
}
function afState(v,t){
 const r=afPose(v,t);if(!r.task)return'IDLE';
 const l=r.task.tr.seq.legAt(t-r.task.t0);const kd=l?l.leg.kind:'';
 return kd==='out'||kd==='mid'?'DISPATCHED':kd==='back'?'RETURNING':kd==='push'?'ATTACHED':kd==='mu'?'BAG_MAKEUP':'SERVICING';
}
function afActors(now,out){
 for(const v of AO.fleet){const r=afPose(v,now);out.push({kind:'veh',id:v.asset,nm:v.id,pose:r.pose,tr:r.tr,f:null,v,lt:r.task?now-r.task.t0:null})}
 return out;
}

function afCheck(add,t0,t1){
 for(const v of AO.fleet){
  const all=v.hist.concat(v.tasks).filter(k=>k.t1>=t0&&k.t0<=t1);
  for(let i=0;i<all.length;i++){
   const k=all[i],L=k.tr.seq.legs;
   if(i&&all[i-1].t1+AF.GAP-1e-6>k.t0)add('FLEET overlap '+v.id,k.t0);
   for(let j=0;j+1<L.length;j++){
    const a=L[j].pose(L[j].dur),b=L[j+1].pose(0);
    if(!a||!b)continue;
    if(Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])>1.5||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(a[2]-b[2]),Math.cos(a[2]-b[2])))>.05)add('TELEPORT '+v.id+' leg '+j+'→'+(j+1)+' ('+L[j].kind+'→'+L[j+1].kind+')',k.t0);
   }
   const p0=L[0].pose(0),pe=L[L.length-1].pose(L[L.length-1].dur),h=v.home;
   if(Math.hypot(p0[0]-h[0],p0[1]-h[1])>1.5||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(p0[2]-h[2]),Math.cos(p0[2]-h[2])))>.05)add('FLEET '+v.id+' does not start in its bay',k.t0);
   if(Math.hypot(pe[0]-h[0],pe[1]-h[1])>1.5||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(pe[2]-h[2]),Math.cos(pe[2]-h[2])))>.05)add('FLEET '+v.id+' does not end in its bay',k.t1);
   
   const n=Math.ceil(k.tr.seq.dur/.5);for(let q=0;q<=n;q++){const p=k.tr.seq.at(Math.min(q*.5,k.tr.seq.dur-1e-6));if(p&&p[4]!==1){add('FLEET alpha<1 '+v.id,k.t0+q*.5);break}}
  }
 }
}

function aoSearch(sm,sMin,sMax,hold,after){

  const k=aoFreeK(sm,s);
  if(k<0){
   if(after){const e=s+sm.K-1,c=aoHoldLimit(after.sh,e,e+after.len);
    if(c<e+after.len){
     if(AO._hperm)return -1;                      
     const h=AO._hs;let c2=c+1;while(c2<c+4000&&aoBlocked(h,c2))c2++;
     s=Math.max(s+1,c2-(sm.K-1));continue}}
   return s}
  
  const a=AO._ca,base=s+k;let d=1;if(G77_IH&&G77_IH.last&&G77_IH.w===AO.work){G77_IH.last=false;G77_IH.jump++;d=Math.max(1,Math.min(4000,G77_IH.until-base))}else while(d<4000&&aoBlocked(a,base+d))d++;
  s+=d;
 }
 return -1;
}function* aoSearchG(sm,sMin,sMax,hold,after){

function g77Match(sd,ac){
 const P=g77Prof(sd,ac),r={stand:sd.id,ac,role:g77Role(sd,ac),accepts:(sd.accepts||[]).includes(ac),cls:P?P.cls:0,standCls:g77StandCls(sd),svc:{},missing:[],later:[],ok:false};

 for(const k of P.svc){const q=S[k]||{reach:false,now:false},st=q.st||G77_SVC[k].st;r.svc[k]=!q.reach?'no':q.now?'ok':'S'+Math.max(2,st);if(!q.reach)r.missing.push(k);else if(!q.now)r.later.push(k)}
 r.ok=r.accepts&&!r.missing.length;r.why=!r.accepts?'stand-does-not-accept':r.missing.length?'service-cannot-reach:'+r.missing.join(','):'ok';
 if(r.missing.length){const bl=[];for(const k of r.missing){const b=k==='push'?g77StaticBlock(sd,ac,'tug'):k==='fuel'?g77StaticBlock(sd,ac,'fuel'):null;if(b)bl.push(k+'→'+g77StaticStand(b))}if(bl.length){r.blocked=bl;r.why+=' (static parking: '+bl.join(', ')+')'}}
 return r}

function g77BestFitAudit(fl){
 fl=fl||AO.hist.concat(AO.flights);const byCode=new Map();for(const f of fl){const l=byCode.get(f.code);if(l)l.push(f);else byCode.set(f.code,[f])}

 for(const f of fl){if(!f.bfC||f.heli||f.never)continue;r.n++;const c=g77StandCls(f.sd),pc=(g77Prof(f.sd,f.ac)||{}).cls||0;if(pc<c)r.over++;
  for(const [id,s] of f.bfC){
   if(s==='free'){r.free++;r.issues.push('WASTE '+f.code+' '+f.ac.slice(3,5)+'@'+f.stand+' while '+id+' free');continue}
   if(s==='busy'){r.busy++;continue}
   if(s==='not-live'||s==='indoor'){r.off++;continue}
   if(s.startsWith('occupied:')){r.occ++;const L=byCode.get(s.slice(9));if(!L){r.occUnk++;continue}
    if(!L.some(g=>g.stand===id&&g.t1>f.bfAt))r.issues.push('CLAIM '+f.code+': '+id+' '+s+' not true at '+(+f.bfAt).toFixed(1));else r.occOk++}}}
 r.ok=!r.issues.length;return r}

const G77_VROLE=x=>x.role||(x.task&&x.task.role)||(x.v&&x.v.role)||'?';
function g77Turn(id,ac,seed,xo){
 if(!APTT_SPEC){APTT_SPEC=aptBuildSpec();APTT_C=aptBuildC()}
 return aoSandbox(()=>{
  AO.keep=true;aoInit(0,seed||777);for(const s of AO.stands){s.init=null;s.next=Infinity}
  const sd=AO.stands.find(s=>s.id===id),t0w=performance.now();let P=null;
  if(sd.kind==='heli')P=AO.flights.find(f=>f.stand===id&&!f.never&&f.heli)||null;
  let tries=0;const whys=[];
  if(sd.kind!=='heli'){for(;tries<4&&!P;tries++){const w0=Object.assign({},AO.stats.why);P=aoPlanVisit(sd,AO.lead+5+tries*AO.H,Object.assign({ac,bfC:[],bfAt:0},xo||{}));
   if(!P){let why='?';for(const k in AO.stats.why)if((AO.stats.why[k]||0)>(w0[k]||0))why=k;whys.push(why)}}
   if(!P)return{ok:false,why:'plan-failed:'+whys.join(','),tries,issues:['PLAN '+whys.join(',')]}}
  if(!P)return{ok:false,why:'no-heli-plan',issues:['PLAN heli']};
  const seq=P.states.map(s=>s[1]),issues=[];
  const need=sd.kind==='heli'?['ON_BLOCK','TAXI_OUT','DEPARTED']:['INBOUND','TAXI_IN','ON_BLOCK','TURNAROUND_READY','DEPARTED'];
  let last=-1,lt=-Infinity;for(const n of need){const i=seq.indexOf(n);if(i<0){issues.push('SEQ missing '+n);continue}if(i<last)issues.push('SEQ order '+n);last=i}
  for(const s of P.states){if(s[0]<lt-1e-6)issues.push('SEQ time');lt=s[0]}
  const roles={};for(const x of P.vt||[]){const k=G77_VROLE(x);roles[k]=(roles[k]||0)+1}
  const m=g77Match(sd,ac),prof=g77Prof(sd,ac)||{svc:[]},q=P.q||g77Quant(sd,ac,P.code),bridge=sd.tpl==='bridge'&&!P.nb,remote=g2Remote(sd,ac);
  
  for(const k of prof.svc){if(m.svc[k]!=='ok')continue;
   if(k==='bags'){const want=Math.max(1,q.bagsA.trips)+Math.max(1,q.bagsD.trips);if((roles.bag||0)<want)issues.push('MISSING bags '+(roles.bag||0)+'/'+want)}
   else if(k==='fuel'){if(!roles.fuel)issues.push('MISSING fuel')}
   else if(k==='push'){if(AO_PUSH[sd.tpl]&&aoNeedTug(sd,ac)&&!roles.tug)issues.push('MISSING tug')}
   else if(k==='pax'){if(bridge&&!(P.pax&&P.pax.count>0))issues.push('MISSING bridge passengers');if(P.nb&&!(P.nb.arr&&P.nb.dep))issues.push('MISSING bus passengers');if(remote&&!P.g2)issues.push('MISSING bus')}
   else if(k==='cargo'&&G77_STAGE>=4){const n=Math.ceil((q.cargoU||0)/3)*2;if((roles.cgo||0)<n)issues.push('MISSING cargo trips '+(roles.cgo||0)+'/'+n)}
   else if(k==='marshal'){if(!P.crew||!P.crew.walkers.length)issues.push('MISSING marshal')}
   else if(k==='chocks'){if(!P.crew||!P.crew.items.some(i=>i.k==='chock'))issues.push('MISSING chocks')}
   else if(G77_ROLE_OF[k]&&!(k==='gpu'&&sd.tpl==='bridge')&&g77Need(P.code,k,ac)&&!roles[G77_ROLE_OF[k]]&&!(k==='catering'&&roles.cats))issues.push('MISSING '+k)}   

  
  const role=prof.role;
  if((role==='cargo'||role==='ga'||role==='heli'||role==='maint')&&(roles.bag||P.g2||(P.pax&&P.pax.count)))issues.push('WRONG passenger/baggage service for '+role);
  if(role==='heli'&&(P.vt||[]).length)issues.push('WRONG vehicle at a helipad');
  if(role==='pax'&&q.paxA<1)issues.push('QTY no passengers');
  if(G77_FX.on)for(const h of g77FixedHits(P))issues.push(h);   
  const v=aoVerify(P.t0,Math.min(P.t1,P.t0+3600));for(const i of v.issues)issues.push('CONFLICT '+i);
  if(G77_STAGE>=3&&P.crew){const ca=g77CrewAudit([P],P.t0,Math.min(P.t1,P.t0+3600));for(const i of ca.issues)issues.push('CREW '+i)}
  return{ok:!issues.length,code:P.code,mode:P.nb?'bus':P.g2?'remote':(P.bridgeAt?'bridge':'own'),catQ:typeof s6rCatQa==='function'?s6rCatQa([P]):null,seq:seq.join('>'),roles,pax:q.paxA+'/'+q.paxD,bags:q.bagsA.trips+'/'+q.bagsD.trips,carts:q.bagsA.carts+'/'+q.bagsD.carts,
   dwell:P.tOB!=null&&P.tPush!=null?Math.round(P.tPush-P.tOB):null,dur:Math.round(Math.min(P.t1,P.t0+3600)-P.t0),tries:tries||1,retryWhy:whys,paxDrawn:P.pax?P.pax.count:(P.g2?'bus':null),issues:issues.slice(0,8),ms:Math.round(performance.now()-t0w)}
 })}

function g77LiveTypes(st){const s=new Set();for(const sd of st)for(const a of sd.accepts||[])if(G77_AC[a])s.add(a);return Object.keys(G77_AC).filter(a=>s.has(a))}
function g77Matrix(o={}){

function g77Qa87(rows){const out={tested:0,total:0,pass:0,fails:[],pits:{}};
 for(const r of rows){if(!r.turn)continue;const sdx=APL.stands.find(s=>s.id===r.stand)||{id:r.stand},nb=typeof s6rNoBridge==='function'&&s6rNoBridge(sdx,r.ac),bo=nb&&typeof s6rBusOnly==='function'&&s6rBusOnly(r.stand,r.ac);
  const modes=[['default',r.turn,nb?'bus':null]];if(nb&&!bo)modes.push(['bridge',r.turnB,'bridge']);
  for(const [name,t,exp] of modes){out.total++;if(!t){out.fails.push(r.stand+':'+r.ac.slice(3,5)+'/'+name+' not run');continue}out.tested++;const why=[];
   if(!t.ok)why.push(...(t.issues||[]).slice(0,2));
   if(exp&&t.mode!==exp)why.push('mode '+t.mode+' ≠ '+exp);
   if(t.catQ&&t.catQ.jobs>0&&!t.catQ.ok)why.push('catering miss '+t.catQ.maxMiss);
   if(sdx.tpl==='bridge'&&t.mode==='bridge'&&typeof s6rBeltAc==='function'&&s6rBeltAc(sdx,r.ac)&&!(t.roles&&t.roles.belt))why.push('no belt');
   if(t.mode==='remote'&&S6A_BELT[r.ac]&&!(t.roles&&t.roles.belt))why.push('no belt (remote)');   
   if(why.length)out.fails.push(r.stand+':'+r.ac.slice(3,5)+'/'+name+' '+why.join('; '));else out.pass++}}
 for(const sd of APL.stands){if(sd.tpl!=='bridge')continue;const p=s6rPit(sd,null);out.pits[sd.id]=!!p;out.total++;out.tested++;if(p)out.pass++;else out.fails.push(sd.id+' no power pit')}
 out.text='נבדקו '+out.tested+' / '+out.total;out.ok=out.total>0&&out.tested===out.total&&out.pass===out.total;return out}

function g77Capacity(seed,SEC){const t0w=performance.now();const r=aoSandbox(()=>{
      if (!APTT_SPEC) { APTT_SPEC = aptBuildSpec(); APTT_C = aptBuildC() }
      AO.keep = true; aoInit(0, seed); for (let t = 0; t <= SEC; t += 1) aoStep(t);
      const all = AO.hist.concat(AO.flights).filter(f => !f.never && f.tOB != null && f.tOB <= SEC);
      const fx = all.filter(f => !f.heli), he = all.filter(f => f.heli);
      const by = (arr, k) => { const m = {}; for (const x of arr) { const key = k(x); m[key] = (m[key] || 0) + 1 } return m };
      const mean = a => a.length ? +(a.reduce((p, q) => p + q, 0) / a.length).toFixed(1) : null, mx = a => a.length ? +Math.max(...a).toFixed(1) : null;
      
      const types = by(fx, f => f.ac), stands = by(fx, f => f.stand), dwell = {};
      for (const f of fx) { const d = (f.tPush ?? f.t1) - f.tOB; (dwell[f.ac] || (dwell[f.ac] = [])).push(d) }
      const dwellM = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(dwell).map(([k, a]) => [k, [mean(a), mx(a)]]));
      
      const svc = {};
      for (const f of fx) for (const q of f.svcQ || []) { const s = svc[q.svc] || (svc[q.svc] = { n: 0, wait: [], hold: [], byAc: {} }); s.n++; s.wait.push(Math.max(0, q.at - q.nom)); s.hold.push(q.done - q.at); s.byAc[f.ac] = (s.byAc[f.ac] || 0) + 1 }
      
      for (const f of fx) for (const x of f.vt || []) { const r = x.role || (x.task && x.task.role); if (!r) continue; const k = 'vt:' + r, s = svc[k] || (svc[k] = { n: 0, wait: [], hold: [], byAc: {} }); s.n++; s.byAc[f.ac] = (s.byAc[f.ac] || 0) + 1;
        if (r === 'fuel' && x.at != null) { const nom = f.tOB + AO.cfg.fuel + G77_CHOCK + g77ChockExtra(f.ac); s.wait.push(Math.max(0, x.at - nom)); if (x.done != null) s.hold.push(x.done - x.at) } }
      
      const bus = { remote: 0, nb: 0, waitArr: [], waitDep: [], pax: 0, trips: 0 };
      for (const f of fx) { for (const [k, r] of [['remote', f.g2], ['nb', f.nb]]) { if (!r) continue; bus[k]++; bus.trips += 2; bus.pax += (r.arr ? r.arr.n : 0) + (r.dep ? r.dep.n : 0); if (r.arr) bus.waitArr.push(Math.max(0, r.arr.at - (f.tOB + G77_CHOCK + 5))) } }
      const svcOut = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(svc).map(([k, s]) => [k, { n: s.n, perH: +(s.n * 3600 / SEC).toFixed(1), waitMean: mean(s.wait), waitMax: mx(s.wait), holdMean: mean(s.hold), byAc: s.byAc }]));
      
      const fleet = {};
      for (const v of AO.fleet) {
        const F = fleet[v.type] || (fleet[v.type] = { n: 0, tasks: 0, busy: 0, work: 0, drive: 0, ev: [], roles: {} }); F.n++;
        for (const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks)) { if (k.t0 > SEC) continue; const t1 = Math.min(k.t1, SEC); F.tasks++; F.busy += t1 - k.t0; F.ev.push([k.t0, 1], [t1, -1]); F.roles[k.role] = (F.roles[k.role] || 0) + 1;
          const L = k.tr && k.tr.seq ? k.tr.seq.legs : []; for (const l of L) { const atAc = l.kind === 'svc' || (l.kind === 'hold' && (l.label === 'svc' || l.at === 'ac' || (l.g2 && l.g2.at === 'ac'))); if (atAc) F.work += l.dur; else if (l.kind !== 'hold' && l.kind !== 'absent') F.drive += l.dur } }
      }
      const fleetOut = {};
      for (const [k, F] of Object.entries(fleet)) { F.ev.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || a[1] - b[1]); let c = 0, pk = 0; for (const e of F.ev) { c += e[1]; pk = Math.max(pk, c) }
        fleetOut[k] = { n: F.n, tasks: F.tasks, perH: +(F.tasks * 3600 / SEC).toFixed(1), util: +(F.busy / (F.n * SEC)).toFixed(2), peak: pk, workShare: F.busy ? +(F.work / F.busy).toFixed(2) : 0, driveShare: F.busy ? +(F.drive / F.busy).toFixed(2) : 0, roles: F.roles } }
      return { seed, sec: SEC, flights: fx.length, perH: +(fx.length * 3600 / SEC).toFixed(1), heli: he.length, types, stands, dwell: dwellM,
        failed: AO.stats.failed, why: AO.stats.why, queued: AO.stats.queued, maxQueue: AO.stats.maxQueue && +AO.stats.maxQueue.toFixed(1),
        services: svcOut, bus: { remote: bus.remote, nb: bus.nb, trips: bus.trips, pax: bus.pax, waitArrMean: mean(bus.waitArr), waitArrMax: mx(bus.waitArr) },
        fleet: fleetOut, nb: s6rNbStats(all, SEC), ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0w) };
    });
 const over=[];for(const [k,q] of Object.entries(r.services||{})){if(q.waitMean==null)continue;if(q.waitMean>30||q.waitMax>120)over.push(k+' '+q.waitMean+' / '+q.waitMax)}
 r.air58={over,ok:!over.length};return r}

var G77_MARS=null;const G77_MARS_NONE=new Set();
function g77MarsCalc(){const M={lock:new Map(),lane:new Set(),locked:new Set(),gap:{},ok:false,ms:0},t0=performance.now(),fz=G77_LC_FORCE;G77_MARS=M;
 try{G77_LC_FORCE=false;aptReady();const R=G73_REQ,S=APL.stands.filter(s=>!s.indoor),env=(s,ac)=>{const v=g77StandView(s,ac);return aplEnv(ac,v.ngx,v.ngy,v.th)};
  const legs=(s,ac)=>{let a=null,D=null;try{a=aoArrLeg(s,ac);D=aoDepLegs(s,ac)}catch(e){return[]}return[['arr',a,a?Math.max(0,a.dur-45):0],['push',D&&D.push,0],['taxi',D&&D.taxi,0]]};
  const sweep=(s,ac,kinds,o,E)=>{let m=1e9;for(const [k,leg,ts] of legs(s,ac)){if(!leg||!kinds.includes(k))continue;for(let t=ts;t<=leg.dur;t+=.5){const p=leg.pose(t);if(!p||p[3]>2||Math.abs(o.ngx-p[0])>600||Math.abs(o.ngy-p[1])>600)continue;const me=aplEnv(ac,p[0],p[1],p[2]);for(const e of E){const g=g73EnvGap(me,e);if(g<m)m=g}}}return m};
  for(const L of S){if(!L.large)continue;for(const p of L.accepts){const key=L.id+'|'+p,eL=env(L,p),set=new Set();
   for(const b of S){if(b===L)continue;const dx=Math.abs(b.ngx-L.ngx),dy=Math.abs(b.ngy-L.ngy);if((dx>700||dy>700)&&Math.hypot(dx,dy)>=900)continue;
    const eb=b.accepts.map(q=>env(b,q)),need=L.tpl==='bridge'&&b.tpl==='bridge'?R.bridgeWing:R.margin,sw=b.tpl==='apronSW';
    let park=1e9;for(const e of eb){const g=g73EnvGap(eL,e);if(g<park)park=g}
    let path=1e9;if(b.live)for(const q of b.accepts)path=Math.min(path,sweep(b,q,sw?['arr','push']:['arr','push','taxi'],L,[eL]));
    if(L.live)path=Math.min(path,sweep(L,p,['arr','push','taxi'],b,eb));
    if(park<need||path<R.margin){set.add(b.id);M.locked.add(b.id);M.gap[key+'>'+b.id]=[+(park/A34_PXM).toFixed(1),+(path/A34_PXM).toFixed(1)]}
    if(sw&&b.live){let tx=1e9;for(const q of b.accepts)tx=Math.min(tx,sweep(b,q,['taxi'],L,[eL]));if(tx<R.margin){M.lane.add(key);M.gap[key+'>L']=M.gap[key+'>L']||[b.id,+(tx/A34_PXM).toFixed(1)]}}}
   M.lock.set(key,set)}}M.ok=true}
 catch(e){M.err=String(e&&e.message||e).slice(0,160);   
  M.lock.clear();M.lane.clear();M.locked.clear();for(const ac of ['AC-LG-01','AC-MW-01']){M.lock.set('P4|'+ac,new Set(['P3']));M.lane.add('P4|'+ac)}M.locked.add('P3')}
 finally{G77_LC_FORCE=fz}M.ms=Math.round(performance.now()-t0);return M}

 const S=APL.stands.filter(s=>!s.indoor),iss=[],rows=[];

function g77Linger1(w,t1,face,mustHome,goTo){

function g77Hold(w,t1,face){if(!w.legs.length){w.t=Math.max(w.t,t1);return w.t}

function g77DrawBox(kind,id,p,noSh){const s=aptSpr(id),x=p[0],y=p[1],th=p[2],z=p[3]||0,c=Math.cos(th),n=Math.sin(th);let k,cs,sh;
 if(kind==='heli'){k=1+z/300;cs=[[-s.w/2,-s.h/2],[s.w/2,-s.h/2],[s.w/2,s.h/2],[-s.w/2,s.h/2]];sh=z>3?[x+z*.4,y+z*.5,s.w*.32]:null}
 else{k=1+z/420;cs=[[-s.ax,-s.ay],[s.w-s.ax,-s.ay],[s.w-s.ax,s.h-s.ay],[-s.ax,s.h-s.ay]];sh=z>3?[x+z*.32-s.w*.1*c,y+z*.42-s.w*.1*n,s.w*.36]:null}

 if(sh&&!noSh){x0=Math.min(x0,sh[0]-sh[2]);x1=Math.max(x1,sh[0]+sh[2]);y0=Math.min(y0,sh[1]-sh[2]);y1=Math.max(y1,sh[1]+sh[2])}return[x0,y0,x1,y1]}
function g77EdgeAudit(fl,t0,t1){const R=[g77ViewR()],    hit=b=>R.some(r=>b[0]<r.x1&&b[2]>r.x0&&b[1]<r.y1&&b[3]>r.y0),r={flights:0,samples:0,fade:0,appear:0,vanish:0,issues:[]},ev=[];
 for(const f of fl){if(f.never||!f.tracks||!f.tracks.length)continue;let first=null,last=null,n=0;
  for(const q of f.tracks){const tr=q.tr;if(!tr||!tr.seq||(tr.kind!=='ac'&&tr.kind!=='heli'))continue;n++;const kind=tr.kind==='heli'?'heli':'ac',e=q.t0+tr.seq.dur;
   if(!first||q.t0<first.t)first={t:q.t0,q,kind};if(!last||e>last.t)last={t:e,q,kind};
   for(let t=Math.max(t0,q.t0);t<=Math.min(t1,e);t+=.5){const p=tr.seq.at(t-q.t0);if(!p)continue;r.samples++;if(p[4]>=.999)continue;
    if(hit(g77DrawBox(kind,tr.id,p))){r.fade++;if(r.issues.length<8)r.issues.push('FADE '+f.code+' al '+p[4].toFixed(2)+' @'+t.toFixed(1)+' x '+Math.round(p[0]))}}}
  if(!n)continue;r.flights++;
  const at=(o,t)=>o.q.tr.seq.at(Math.min(o.q.tr.seq.dur-1e-3,Math.max(0,t-o.q.t0)));   
  if(first&&first.t>t0+1e-6&&first.t<=t1){const p=at(first,first.t);if(p&&p[4]>.001&&hit(g77DrawBox(first.kind,first.q.tr.id,p)))ev.push({k:'appear',f,t:first.t,p})}
  if(last&&last.t<=t1-1){const p=at(last,last.t);if(p&&p[4]>.001&&hit(g77DrawBox(last.kind,last.q.tr.id,p)))ev.push({k:'vanish',f,t:last.t,p})}}
 for(const e of ev){const o=e.k==='appear'?'vanish':'appear';
  const chain=fl.some(g=>g!==e.f&&g.stand===e.f.stand&&g.tracks&&g.tracks.some(q=>{const tr=q.tr;if(!tr||!tr.seq)return false;const lt=e.t-q.t0;if(lt<-1||lt>tr.seq.dur+1)return false;const p=tr.seq.at(Math.min(tr.seq.dur-1e-3,Math.max(0,lt)));return p&&Math.hypot(p[0]-e.p[0],p[1]-e.p[1])<3}));
  if(chain||(e.k==='appear'&&e.f.init&&e.t<=t0+1))continue;r[e.k]++;if(r.issues.length<8)r.issues.push(e.k.toUpperCase()+' '+e.f.code+' @'+e.t.toFixed(1)+' ('+Math.round(e.p[0])+','+Math.round(e.p[1])+')')}
 {const V=g77ViewR();let lastI=-1e9;r.overlap=0;r.heliOverlap=0;r.airPairs=0;   
  for(let t=t0;t<=t1;t+=.5){const A=[];
   for(const f of fl){if(f.never||!f.tracks||t<(f.tDraw??f.t0)||t>=f.t1)continue;for(const q of f.tracks){const tr=q.tr;if(!tr||!tr.seq||(tr.kind!=='ac'&&tr.kind!=='heli'))continue;const p=tr.seq.at(t-q.t0);if(!p||!((p[3]||0)>8))continue;
    const kind=tr.kind==='heli'?'heli':'ac',b=g77DrawBox(kind,tr.id,p,1);if(b[2]<V.x0||b[0]>V.x1||b[3]<V.y0||b[1]>V.y1)continue;A.push({f,z:p[3],b})}}
   for(let i=0;i<A.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<A.length;j++){const a=A[i],c=A[j];if(a.f===c.f)continue;r.airPairs++;if(Math.abs(a.z-c.z)>=20)continue;
    if(a.b[0]<c.b[2]-2&&a.b[2]>c.b[0]+2&&a.b[1]<c.b[3]-2&&a.b[3]>c.b[1]+2){const hh=a.f.heli&&c.f.heli;if(hh)r.heliOverlap++;else r.overlap++;   
     if(t-lastI>3&&r.issues.length<12){r.issues.push((hh?'HELI-OVERLAP ':'OVERLAP ')+a.f.code+' × '+c.f.code+' @'+t.toFixed(1)+' ('+Math.round((a.b[0]+a.b[2])/2)+','+Math.round((a.b[1]+a.b[3])/2)+') z '+Math.round(a.z)+' / '+Math.round(c.z));lastI=t}}}}}
 r.view=g77ViewR();
 r.ok=!r.fade&&!r.appear&&!r.vanish&&!r.overlap;return r}
function g77PaxVehAudit(fl,t0,t1){const keep=G77_VTC;G77_VTC=new Map();const r={samples:0,pax:0,hits:0,issues:[]};
