function g77CrewAudit(fl,t0,t1){G77_VTC=new Map();
 fl=fl||AO.hist.concat(AO.flights);const r={flights:0,walkers:0,issues:[],samples:0,items:0};
 const moving=(f,t)=>{const q=f.tracks.find(q=>q.main);if(!q)return null;const a=q.tr.seq.at(t-q.t0),b=q.tr.seq.at(t-q.t0+.25);if(!a||!b)return null;return Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])>.01||Math.abs(a[2]-b[2])>.001?a:null};
 const act=fl.filter(f=>!f.heli&&f.tracks&&f.tracks.length);
 for(const f of fl){const C=f.crew;if(!C)continue;r.flights++;
  for(const w of C.walkers){r.walkers++;const L=w.legs;if(!L.length)continue;const a=L[0].a,b=L[L.length-1].follow?null:L[L.length-1].b;
   if(Math.hypot(a[0]-C.post[0],a[1]-C.post[1])>1)r.issues.push('POST-OUT '+f.code);if(b&&Math.hypot(b[0]-C.post[0],b[1]-C.post[1])>1)r.issues.push('POST-IN '+f.code);
   for(let t=Math.max(t0,L[0].t0);t<=Math.min(t1,L[L.length-1].t1);t+=.5){const p=g77WalkerAt(w,t);if(!p)continue;r.samples++;
    if(p.y<APT_Y.TS+4&&p.x>4800&&p.x<8400){r.issues.push('TAXIWAY '+f.code+' @'+t.toFixed(1));break}
    if(p.y>APT_Y.LN-2&&p.y<APT_Y.LS+2&&p.x>G73_L.x0-10&&p.x<G73_L.x1+10){r.issues.push('TAXILANE '+f.code+' crew#'+C.walkers.indexOf(w)+' @'+t.toFixed(1));break}
    const me={x0:p.x-1.5,x1:p.x+1.5,y0:p.y-1.5,y1:p.y+1.5},box=apttObb(p.x,p.y,0,[-1.5,1.5,-1.5,1.5],'P','crew');
    let hit=null;for(const g of act){if(t<g.t0||t>=g.t1)continue;const pose=moving(g,t);if(!pose)continue;const sh=[];apttShapes(g.tracks.find(q=>q.main).tr,pose,sh);for(const s of sh){if(s.L!=='F'&&s.L!=='W')continue;if(me.x0<=s.x1+4&&me.x1>=s.x0-4&&me.y0<=s.y1+4&&me.y1>=s.y0-4&&apttObbHit(box,s,4)){hit=g.code;break}}if(hit)break}
    if(hit){r.issues.push('SWEEP '+f.code+' crew#'+C.walkers.indexOf(w)+' ✕ '+hit+' @'+t.toFixed(1));break}
    for(const h of APL.helis){if(Math.hypot(p.x-h.x,p.y-h.y)<h.r+4){hit=h.id;break}}if(hit){r.issues.push('PAD '+f.code+' @'+hit+' '+t.toFixed(1));break}
    for(const v of AO.fleet){let k=null;for(const q of g77VT(v))if(t>=q.t0&&t<q.t1){k=q;break}if(!k)continue;const a=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0);if(!a||Math.abs(a[0]-p.x)>60||Math.abs(a[1]-p.y)>60)continue;
     const b=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0+.25);if(!b||(Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])<.01&&Math.abs(a[2]-b[2])<.001))continue;const sh=[];apttShapes(k.tr,a,sh,t-k.t0);
     for(const s of sh){if(s.L!=='V')continue;if(me.x0<=s.x1+2&&me.x1>=s.x0-2&&me.y0<=s.y1+2&&me.y1>=s.y0-2&&apttObbHit(box,s,2)){hit=v.id;break}}if(hit)break}
    if(hit){r.veh=(r.veh||0)+1;r.issues.push('VEH '+f.code+' crew#'+C.walkers.indexOf(w)+' ✕ '+hit+' @'+t.toFixed(1));break}}}
  if(!C.heli&&!f.parked){const m=C.walkers[0],h=m&&m.legs.find(q=>q.hold&&q.face==='ac');if(!h||h.t0>C.tOB-5)r.issues.push('MARSHAL-LATE '+f.code)}

  for(const it of C.items){if(it.t1==null)continue;let run=null;for(let t=Math.max(t0,it.t0);t<=Math.min(t1,it.t1)&&!run;t+=1){const box=apttObb(it.p[0],it.p[1],0,[-1.5,1.5,-1.5,1.5],'P','i');
    for(const v of AO.fleet){let k=null;for(const q of g77VT(v))if(t>=q.t0&&t<q.t1){k=q;break}if(!k)continue;const a=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0);if(!a||Math.abs(a[0]-it.p[0])>60||Math.abs(a[1]-it.p[1])>60)continue;const sh=[];apttShapes(k.tr,a,sh,t-k.t0);for(const q of sh)if(q.L==='V'&&apttObbHit(box,q,1)){run=v.id+' @'+t;break}if(run)break}}
   if(run)r.issues.push('ITEM-RUN '+f.code+' '+it.k+' ✕ '+run)}
  for(const it of C.items){r.items++;if(!f.parked&&it.t0<C.tOB-1e-6)r.issues.push('CHOCK-EARLY '+f.code);if(it.t1==null||it.t1>C.tPush+1e-6)r.issues.push('ITEM-LATE '+f.code+' '+it.k)}
  if(C.chockMain!=null)for(const x of f.vt||[]){if(x.at==null)continue;const at=x.at;if(x.role==='tug'||(x.task&&(x.task.role==='tug'||x.task.role==='fm')))continue;if(at<C.chockMain-.5){r.issues.push('BEFORE-CHOCKS '+f.code+' '+(x.role||(x.task&&x.task.role)));break}}}
 r.ok=!r.issues.length;r.issues=r.issues.slice(0,12);return r}
function aoFinish(P,mark,t0w){
 if(P.sd?.bridge&&P.bridgeAt)P.pax=f2PaxPlan(P);
 if(G77_STAGE>=3)P.crew=g77CrewPlan(P);   
 
 AO.flights.push(P);AO.stats.planned++;AO.stats.planMs+=((typeof performance!=='undefined'?performance.now():Date.now())-t0w);

}




function aoHeliLegs(sd){
 const X=APTT_X,pad=sd.pad,pk=[pad.x,pad.y,0,0,1],ZC=65+25*g77HeliK(sd);

 const out=apttMove({kind:'heli',path:outP,prof:apttProf(outP.len,apttVfn(outP.len,{vmax:110,v0:12,v1:110,acc:30,dec:30})),mode:'tan',th0:0,blend:30,z:s=>45+(ZC-45)*apttSm(Math.min(1,s/300)),al:()=>1});out.t300=apttTof(out.prof,Math.min(300,outP.len));
 const inP=apttPath([[XH,pad.y-60],[Math.min(pad.x+140,XH-60),pad.y-18],[pad.x,pad.y]],[60]);
 const inn=apttMove({kind:'heli',path:inP,prof:apttProf(inP.len,apttVfn(inP.len,{vmax:100,v0:100,v1:8,acc:30,dec:30})),mode:'tan',th0:Math.PI,z:s=>45+(ZC-45)*(1-apttSm(Math.max(0,(s-(inP.len-300))/300))),al:()=>1});inn.t300=inn.dur-apttTof(inn.prof,Math.max(0,inP.len-300));
 const ie=inn.endPose();
 const yaw={kind:'yaw',dur:3,pose:t=>[pad.x,pad.y,apttAng(ie[2],0,apttSm(t/3)),45,1]};
 const land={kind:'land',dur:4,pose:t=>[pad.x,pad.y,0,45*(1-apttSm(t/4)),1]};
 return{pk,lift,out,inn,yaw,land,extra};
}


function g77HeliK(sd){const i=(typeof APL!=='undefined'&&APL.helis)?APL.helis.findIndex(h=>h.id===sd.id):-1;return Math.max(0,i)}
function g77HeliWins(t0,dwell,away,L){const tl=t0+dwell,wo=[tl-1,tl+L.lift.dur+(L.out.t300||4.5)+1],ti=tl+L.lift.dur+L.out.dur+Math.max(5,away-(L.extra||0)),te=ti+L.inn.dur,wi=[te-(L.inn.t300||4.5)-1,te+L.yaw.dur+L.land.dur+1];return[wo,wi]}
function aoPlanHeli(sd,t0,dwell,away){
 const L=aoHeliLegs(sd),code=aoCode(sd);AO.nid++;
 for(let it=0;it<60;it++){const w=g77HeliWins(t0,dwell,away,L);let c=0;   
  for(const f of AO.flights){if(!f.heli||!f.hw||f.stand===sd.id)continue;for(const a of f.hw){if(a[0]<w[0][1]&&w[0][0]<a[1]){dwell+=a[1]-w[0][0]+.5;c=1;break}if(a[0]<w[1][1]&&w[1][0]<a[1]){away+=a[1]-w[1][0]+.5;c=1;break}}if(c)break}
  if(!c)break}
 const legs=[{kind:'hold',dur:dwell,pose:()=>L.pk},L.lift,L.out,apttGap(Math.max(5,away-(L.extra||0))),L.inn,L.yaw,L.land];   
 const seq=apttSeq(legs),tr={kind:'heli',id:sd.first,nm:code,seq};
 const P={code,ac:sd.first,sd,kind:'heli',stand:sd.id,tracks:[{t0,tr,main:true}],t0,t1:t0+seq.dur,states:[[t0,'ON_BLOCK'],[t0+dwell,'TAXI_OUT'],[t0+dwell+L.lift.dur,'DEPARTED']],tFree:t0+seq.dur,heli:true,init:true,hw:g77HeliWins(t0,dwell,away,L)};
 if(G77_STAGE>=3)P.crew=g77HeliCrew(P);AO.flights.push(P);AO.stats.planned++;aoDbg('plan',{code,stand:sd.id,kind:'heli',t0:+t0.toFixed(1),t1:+P.t1.toFixed(1)});return P;
}




function aoInit(now,seed){
 AO.seed=seed||1;AO.rng=aoRng(AO.seed);AO.t0i=now;AO.pt=null;AO.stepDone=null;AO.mlv=null; AO.job=null;AO.chJob=null;AO.workLimit=Infinity;AO.B.clear();AO.ST.length=0;AO.LOG.length=0;AO.flights.length=0;AO.dbg.length=0;AO.nid=1;AO.codeBump=0;G77_SH.ok=G77_SH.skip=G77_SH.noWin=0;G77_FM.ok=G77_FM.skip=G77_FM.noRoom=G77_FM.late=0;G77_FM.why={};G77_AMB.ok=G77_AMB.skip=G77_AMB.noWin=0;AO.t=now;AO.last=now;
 AO.stats={planned:0,failed:0,recovered:0,queued:0,maxQueue:0,pruned:0,planMs:0,why:{}};AO.g77Deck=[];AO.g77DeckR=[];AO.g77PoolOfs=0;AO.hist.length=0;
 AO.stands=aoMakeStands();AO.TK=null;AO.RBX=null;afInit();
 
 for(const sd of AO.stands){
  sd.next=null;sd.busy=false;
  if(sd.indoor||sd.live||sd.empty)continue;                       
  if(sd.kind==='heli'){aoStaticHeli(sd,now);continue}
  aoPlanVisit(sd,now,{parked:true,tPark:now,ac:sd.first,never:true});
 }
 for(const sd of AO.stands){
  if(!sd.live||sd.indoor)continue;
  if(sd.kind==='heli'){const dw=aoR(...AO.cfg.heliDwell);const P=aoPlanHeli(sd,now,dw,aoR(...AO.cfg.heliAway));sd.next=P.t1;continue}
  if(AO.rng()<(sd.kind==='pax'?.92:.6)*Math.min(1,(sd.rate||1)+.1)){
   const dwell=sd.kind==='pax'?aoR(25,190):sd.kind==='cargo'?aoR(20,120):aoR(40,260);
   sd.init={dwell};sd.next=now;                      
  }else sd.next=now+aoR(10,70);
 }
}
const aoGap=sd=>aoR(...(sd.kind==='ga'||sd.kind==='ovf'?AO.cfg.gaGap:sd.kind==='cargo'?AO.cfg.cgGap:AO.cfg.gap))/((sd.rate||1)*AO.cfg.demand);
function aoStaticHeli(sd,now){
 const pk=[sd.pad.x,sd.pad.y,0,0,1],tr={kind:'heli',id:sd.first,nm:aoCode(sd),seq:apttSeq([{kind:'hold',dur:1e7,pose:()=>pk}])};AO.nid++;

}
function aoPrune(now){
 const cut=aoSl(now)-12;for(const k of AO.B.keys())if(k<cut)AO.B.delete(k);
 for(let i=AO.flights.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(AO.flights[i].t1<now-2){if(AO.keep)AO.hist.push(AO.flights[i]);AO.flights.splice(i,1);AO.stats.pruned++}
 afPrune(now);
}
function aoStep(now){
 if(!AO.rng)aoInit(now,1);
 if(now-AO.last>40||now<AO.last-1){aoDbg('time-jump',{from:AO.last,to:now});aoInit(now,AO.seed+1);return}  
 g76XSync();
 AO.t=now;AO.last=now;
 if(!AO.job)AO.LOG.length=0;
 aoPrune(now);if(typeof G77_MLV!=='undefined'&&G77_MLV.on&&!AO.job)g77MlvStep(now);   
 
 AO.workLimit=AO.sliced?AO.work+AO.budget:Infinity;
 if(AO.useClock&&typeof performance!=='undefined')AO.deadline=performance.now()+AO.cfg.ms;
 if(AO.sliced&&typeof SIM_LOOP!=='undefined'&&SIM_LOOP.aoEnd!=null){if(SIM_LOOP.aoWork==null)SIM_LOOP.aoWork=AO.workLimit;else AO.workLimit=SIM_LOOP.aoWork;if(AO.useClock&&SIM_LOOP.aoEnd<AO.deadline)AO.deadline=SIM_LOOP.aoEnd;if(AO.useClock&&SIM_LOOP.sysT0){const c=SIM_LOOP.sysT0+AO.stepCapMs;if(c<AO.deadline)AO.deadline=c}}if(AO.sliced&&AO.useClock&&typeof g77AoFloor==='function')g77AoFloor();    
 if(AO.chJob){if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())return;if(!AO.chJob.next().done)return;AO.chJob=null;AO.LOG.length=0}   
 for(let guard=0;guard<40;guard++){
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())return;                        
  if(!AO.job){
   const sd=aoDue(now);if(!sd)break;
   if(sd.kind==='heli'){const P=aoPlanHeli(sd,sd.next,aoR(...AO.cfg.heliDwell),aoR(...AO.cfg.heliAway));sd.next=P.t1;continue}
   const ini=sd.init;
   let acB=null;if(!ini){acB=sd.bring&&sd.accepts.includes(sd.bring)?sd.bring:sd.lgWant?g77LgPick(sd,now):sd.wideWant?'AC-MW-01':g77Choose(sd,now);if(acB==='AC-LG-01')sd.lgWant=true;if(acB==='AC-MW-01')sd.wideWant=true;if(acB&&sd.large&&g77MarsHas(sd.id,acB))sd.marsWant=acB;    if(!acB){sd.next=now+aoR(18,55);AO.stats.bfSkip=(AO.stats.bfSkip||0)+1;continue}}
   AO.job={sd,tReq:Math.max(sd.next,now+AO.lead),g:null};AO.job.g=ini?aoPlanG(sd,now,{parked:true,tPark:now,ac:sd.first,dwell:ini.dwell}):aoPlanG(sd,AO.job.tReq,{ac:acB,bfC:AO.bfLast&&AO.bfLast.c,bfAt:now});sd.busy=true;sd.init=null;AO.job.ini=!!ini;
  }
  const r=AO.job.g.next();
  if(!r.done)return;                                  
  const {sd}=AO.job,P=r.value;AO.job0=AO.job;AO.job=null;sd.busy=false;
  if(P&&P.ac==='AC-LG-01'){sd.lgWant=false;sd.lgUntil=P.tFree+2}
  if(sd.bring&&P&&P.ac===sd.bring)sd.bring=null;   
  if(sd.wideWant&&P){sd.wideWant=false;if(P.ac==='AC-MW-01')sd.wideUntil=P.tFree+2}if(P&&sd.large){const H=sd.held||(sd.held={});H[P.ac]=Math.max(H[P.ac]||-1,P.tFree+2)}if(P)sd.marsWant=null;       
  if(P)sd.next=P.tFree+aoGap(sd)-20;
  else if(AO.job0&&AO.job0.ini)sd.next=now+10;
  else{sd.next=now+AO.H+12;AO.stats.recovered++;aoDbg('recovery',{stand:sd.id,action:'retry-later'})}
  AO.LOG.length=0;
  if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())return;
 }
 if(AO.sliced){if(!AO.chJob)AO.chJob=afChoresG(now);if(!AO.chJob.next().done)return;AO.chJob=null}else afChores(now);AO.LOG.length=0;AO.stepDone=now;    
}

function aoDue(now){
 let best=null;
 for(const sd of AO.stands){
  if(!sd.live||sd.next==null||sd.busy)continue;
  if(sd.id==='P2'&&g77P2Blocked(now))continue;   
  if(g77MarsBy(sd,now))continue;       
  if(now+AO.H<sd.next)continue;
  if(!best||sd.next<best.next)best=sd;
 }
 return best;
}

function aoActors(now,out=[]){
 for(const f of AO.flights){
  if(now<(f.tDraw??f.t0)||now>=f.t1)continue;    
  for(const q of f.tracks){
   const p=q.tr.seq.at(now-q.t0);if(!p)continue;
   out.push({kind:q.tr.kind==='heli'?'heli':'ac',id:q.tr.id,nm:q.tr.nm,pose:p,tr:q.tr,f});
  }
 }
 return afActors(now,out);
}

function aoVerify(t0,t1,o={}){
 const dt=AO.DT,issues=[],bld=apttBldShapes(),seen=new Set(),add=(m,t)=>{if(!seen.has(m)){seen.add(m);issues.push(m+' @'+t.toFixed(1))}};
 const fl=AO.hist.concat(AO.flights).filter(f=>f.t1>=t0&&f.t0<=t1);
 let nSlices=0,maxSimul=0;
 
 {const idle=[];for(const v of AO.fleet){apttShapes(v.tr0,v.home,idle)}
  for(let i=0;i<idle.length;i++){for(const b of bld)if(apttConflict(idle[i],b))add('IDLE '+idle[i].t+' ✕ '+b.t,t0);for(let j=i+1;j<idle.length;j++)if(aoC(idle[i],idle[j]))add('IDLE '+idle[i].t+' ✕ '+idle[j].t,t0)}}
 for(let t=t0;t<=t1;t+=dt){
  const sh=[],idl=[];let simul=0;
  for(const f of fl){
   if(t<f.t0||t>=f.t1)continue;
   for(const q of f.tracks){
    const p=q.tr.seq.at(t-q.t0);if(!p)continue;
    if(q.tr.kind==='ac'){const la=q.tr.seq.legAt(t-q.t0);if(la&&(la.leg.kind==='inbound'||la.leg.kind==='outbound'))continue}    
    const out=[];apttShapes(q.tr,p,out);
    if(q.tr.kind==='ac'){
     simul++;
     const ks=new Set();let onR=false;
     for(const s of out){if(s.L==='F'){for(const k of aoTokensOf(s))ks.add(k);if(s.y0<APT_Y.RS+12&&s.y1>APT_Y.RN-12&&s.x1>4000&&s.x0<8500)onR=true}else if(s.L==='A')onR=true}
     for(const k of ks)out.push({L:'S',k,t:q.tr.nm});
     if(onR)out.push(Object.assign({},aoRB(),{t:q.tr.nm+'-R',rwy:q.tr.nm}));
    }
    for(const s of out)sh.push(s);
   }
  }
  afShapes(t,sh,idl);
  for(const s of AO.ST)sh.push(s);
  maxSimul=Math.max(maxSimul,simul);
  for(let i=0;i<sh.length;i++){
   const a=sh[i];
   if(a.L==='F'||a.L==='V')for(const b of bld)if(apttConflict(a,b)&&!g77MlvBldOk(a,b,t))add(a.t+' ✕ '+b.t,t);    
   for(let j=i+1;j<sh.length;j++){const b=sh[j];
    if(a.L==='R'&&b.L==='R'&&a.t!==b.t){add('RUNWAY: '+a.t+' ✕ '+b.t,t);continue}
    if(aoC(a,b)){if(a.L==='S')add('TOKEN '+a.k+': '+a.t+' ✕ '+b.t,t);else add(a.t+'['+a.L+'] ✕ '+b.t+'['+b.L+']',t)}}
  }
  for(const a of idl)for(const b of sh)if(b.L!=='S'&&b.L!=='R'&&b.L!=='A'&&aoC(a,b))add('IDLE '+a.t+' ✕ '+b.t+'['+b.L+'] ('+Math.round(a.x)+','+Math.round(a.y)+')/('+Math.round(b.x)+','+Math.round(b.y)+')',t);
  nSlices++;
 }
 
 for(const f of fl){
  for(const q of f.tracks){
   const L=q.tr.seq.legs;
   for(let i=0;i+1<L.length;i++){
    const a=L[i].pose(L[i].dur),b=L[i+1].pose(0);
    if(!a||!b)continue;
    if(Math.hypot(a[0]-b[0],a[1]-b[1])>1.5||Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(a[2]-b[2]),Math.cos(a[2]-b[2])))>.05)add('TELEPORT '+q.tr.nm+' leg '+i+'→'+(i+1)+' ('+L[i].kind+'→'+L[i+1].kind+')',f.t0);
   }
   
   if(q.tr.kind==='ac'&&!f.never){let prev=null;const T0=q.t0;for(let t=Math.max(t0,f.t0);t<Math.min(t1,f.t1);t+=dt){const p=q.tr.seq.at(t-T0);if(p&&prev){const sp=Math.hypot(p[0]-prev[0],p[1]-prev[1])/dt;if(sp>600)add('SPEED '+q.tr.nm+' '+sp.toFixed(0)+'px/s',t)}prev=p}}
  }
  if(!f.init){for(let i=1;i<f.states.length;i++){const a=f.states[i-1][1],b=f.states[i][1];if(!(AO_STATES[a]||[]).includes(b))add('STATE '+f.code+' '+a+'→'+b,f.states[i][0]);if(f.states[i][0]<f.states[i-1][0]-1e-6)add('STATE-TIME '+f.code,f.states[i][0])}}
 }
 afCheck(add,t0,t1);
 return{ok:issues.length===0,issues,slices:nSlices,flights:fl.length,maxSimul};
}
function aoHoldWhy(sh,from,cap){
 for(const a of sh)for(const b of AO.ST)if(aoC(a,b))return{s:from,a:a.t+a.L,b:b.t+b.L+(b.k||'')};
 for(let s=from;s<cap;s++){const bk=AO.B.get(s);if(!bk)continue;for(const a of sh)for(const b of bk)if(aoC(a,b))return{s,a:a.t+a.L+(a.k||''),b:b.t+b.L+(b.k||''),bx:+b.x?.toFixed(0),by:+b.y?.toFixed(0)}}
 return null}

function g77BeaconSet(){return g77BeaconSet.s||(g77BeaconSet.s=new Set(['PT','BT','FT','SH','SVC','MX','AB','MS','BL','CT','GP','LV','WT','PW','GC','HL','CU','FW','CS']))}   

function g77Lights(g,a,now){
 const v=a.v;if(!v||a.lt==null||!g77BeaconSet().has(v.type))return;
 if(Math.floor(now/420+(v.id.charCodeAt(v.id.length-1)%3)*.33)%2)return;
 const [x,y,th,,al]=a.pose,c=Math.cos(th),s=Math.sin(th),fx=(a.tr&&a.tr.hx?a.tr.hx:10)*.35;
 g.save();g.globalAlpha=al;g.fillStyle='rgba(255,170,30,.28)';g.beginPath();g.arc(x+c*fx,y+s*fx,3.6,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();
 g.fillStyle='#ffb12a';g.beginPath();g.arc(x+c*fx,y+s*fx,1.5,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();g.restore();
}


function g77S2Audit(){
 aptReady();const issues=[],want={BL:4,CT:2,GP:G77_FP.on?3:2,LV:G77_FP.on?2:1,WT:1,SVC:G77_FP.on?3:2},n={};
 for(const f of APL.fleet){n[f.type]=(n[f.type]||0)+1;const b=APL.bays.find(q=>q.id===f.bay);if(!b)issues.push('FLEET '+f.id+' no bay');else if(b.kind!==f.type&&!(b.cs&&f.type==='CS'))issues.push('FLEET '+f.id+' in a '+b.kind+' bay')}   

 for(const k in want)if(n[k]!==want[k])issues.push('FLEET '+k+' '+(n[k]||0)+'/'+want[k]);
 
 const st=AO.fleet&&AO.fleet.length&&AO.stands&&AO.stands.length?AO.stands:[];let rows=0,ok=0;
 for(const sd of st){if(!sd.live)continue;for(const ac of sd.accepts){const m=g77Match(sd,ac);if(!m.ok)continue;for(const k of ['catering','cleaning','water','lavatory','gpu','belt']){const v=m.svc[k];if(!v)continue;rows++;
  if(v==='ok')ok++;else if(!(sd.kind==='cargo'&&v==='S4'))issues.push('SVC '+sd.id+'/'+ac.slice(3,5)+' '+k+' '+v)}}}
 if(g77BeaconSet().has('ARFF')||g77BeaconSet().has('EMS')||g77BeaconSet().has('POL'))issues.push('LIGHTS emergency fleet with a service beacon');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,fleet:n,rows,working:ok,routes:st.length?'checked':'QA-54'}}

function s6rHoseEnd(p0,p1,u){const dx=p1[0]-p0[0],dy=p1[1]-p0[1],len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,nx=-dy/len,ny=dx/len,sg=Math.min(9,len*.16),cx=(p0[0]+p1[0])/2+nx*sg,cy=(p0[1]+p1[1])/2+ny*sg,a=(1-u)*(1-u),b=2*(1-u)*u,c=u*u;return[a*p0[0]+b*cx+c*p1[0],a*p0[1]+b*cy+c*p1[1]]}

function s6rWalkers(t=APT_OPS.clk){const out=[];for(const f of AO.flights){const R=f.walk;if(!R||t<R.open||t>R.close)continue;
  for(const [w,inbound] of [[R.arr,true],[R.dep,false]]){if(t<w.at||t>w.done+1)continue;const P=inbound?R.path:R.path.slice().reverse(),travel=R.len/S6R_NB.v;
   for(let i=0;i<w.n;i++){const lt=t-w.at-S6R_NB.pre-i*S6R_NB.gap;if(lt<0||lt>=travel)continue;let d=lt*S6R_NB.v,k=1;while(k<P.length-1&&d>Math.hypot(P[k][0]-P[k-1][0],P[k][1]-P[k-1][1])){d-=Math.hypot(P[k][0]-P[k-1][0],P[k][1]-P[k-1][1]);k++}
    const a=P[k-1],b=P[k],L=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])||1,u=Math.min(1,d/L),x=a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*u,y=a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*u,dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];
    const face=Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx>0?'east':'west'):(dy>0?'south':'north'),edge=Math.min(1,lt/.8,(travel-lt)/.8);out.push({x,y,face,asset:G2_PAX_ASSETS[(g2Hash(f.code)+i*3)%G2_PAX_ASSETS.length],alpha:Math.max(0,edge),walkTime:lt})}}}return out}

function s6rNbBuild(v,sd,ac,L,kind,hold,meta){

 if(W.row2){rev([[GLN,b.yc+16],[GLN,b.yc,16],[b.x,b.yc]],.45,'out');fwd([[GLN,b.yc+16,0],[GLN,Ly,r],[GLN-40,Ly,0]]);x0=GLN-40}

function* s6rNbServeG(kind,sd,ac,L,win,hold,meta,extra){let best=null;
 for(const v of afCands('AB',6).filter(q=>{const W=s6rNbBayWays(q.bay);return W.outWest||(W.row2&&W.outS&&W.inS)})){ if(AO.sliced&&aoOver())yield 0;
  const B=s6rNbBuild(v,sd,ac,L,kind,hold,meta),sm=(yield* aoSampG(B.trk,aoSeqLeg(B.trk.seq)));
  const sLo=Math.max(aoSlUp(win.at0-B.dOut),afSEarliest());let sHi=aoSl(win.at1-B.dOut);if(best)sHi=Math.min(sHi,best.s-1);
  const s=sHi>=sLo?(yield* afSearchG(v,B.trk,sm,sLo,sHi,extra,Math.round((B.dOut+hold+16)/AO.DT))):-1;
  if(s<0){const w=aoWhy(sm,sLo);const k='nb-'+kind+':'+(w?w.b.replace(/\d+/g,'#'):'busy/none');AF.fails[k]=(AF.fails[k]||0)+1;AF.nbWhy=k;continue}
  if(!best||s<best.s)best={v,B,sm,s}}
 if(!best){AF.stats.fail++;return null}
 const at=aoT(best.s)+best.B.dOut,task=afCommit(best.v,best.B.trk,best.sm,best.s,'nb-'+kind,{code:meta&&meta.code,stand:sd.id,at});

function s6rNbPassengers(t=APT_OPS.clk,flights=AO.flights){const out=[];
 for(const f of flights){const r=f.nb;if(!r)continue;const tA=Math.min(r.open,r.gateDep.at),tB=Math.max(r.close,r.gateArr.done);if(t<tA-1||t>tB+1)continue;
  for(const ph of['arr','dep','gateArr','gateDep']){const w=r[ph];if(!w||t<w.at||t>w.done)continue;const gate=ph==='gateArr'||ph==='gateDep';
   const P=gate?g2GatePath(APL.bays.find(b=>b.id===w.bay)):r.path,L=g2PathLen(P),pts=(ph==='arr'||ph==='gateArr')?P:P.slice().reverse(),travel=L/G2_WALK.v;
   for(let i=0;i<w.n;i++){const lt=t-w.at-G2_WALK.pre-i*G2_WALK.gap;if(lt<0||lt>=travel)continue;let d=lt*G2_WALK.v,k=1;
    while(k<pts.length-1&&d>Math.hypot(pts[k][0]-pts[k-1][0],pts[k][1]-pts[k-1][1])){d-=Math.hypot(pts[k][0]-pts[k-1][0],pts[k][1]-pts[k-1][1]);k++}
    const a=pts[k-1],b=pts[k],sl=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])||1,u=Math.min(1,d/sl),dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];
    out.push({id:f.code+'-nb-'+ph+'-'+i,flight:f.code,stand:f.stand,phase:ph,gate,asset:G2_PAX_ASSETS[(i+g2Hash(f.code))%G2_PAX_ASSETS.length],x:a[0]+dx*u,y:a[1]+dy*u,face:Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx>0?2:6):(dy>0?4:0),walkTime:lt+i*.21,alpha:Math.min(1,lt*3,(travel-lt)*3)})}}}
 return out}
function s6rNbDraw(now,v){if(WTC_LP===1||!APT_OPS.ready)return;const t=APT_OPS.clk;
 for(const f of AO.flights){const R=f.nb;if(!R||t<R.open-2||t>R.close+2)continue;const d=R.door;if(!portVis(v,d[0]-40,d[1]-40,80,80))continue;s6rDrawAirstair(ctx,d[0],d[1],R.dir,Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(t-R.open)/2,(R.close-t)/2)))}
 for(const p of s6rNbPassengers(t)){if(!portVis(v,p.x-12,p.y-20,24,30))continue;const I=TurboCity.info(p.asset,{scale:G77_PE.sc,direction:p.face,pose:'walking'}),feet=I.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Feet')||['Feet',I.w/2,I.h*.55];
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=p.alpha;P34G.k=p.id??null;TurboCity.draw(ctx,p.asset,p.x-feet[1],p.y-feet[2],{mode:'runtime',scale:G77_PE.sc,direction:p.face,pose:'walking',time:p.walkTime});ctx.restore()}}

function s6rNbStats(all,T){const issues=[],why={},vis=[];let elig=0,bus=0,bridge=0,tp=0,qj=0,pax=0,shuttles=0;
 for(const f of all){if(f.never||f.heli||!S6R_NB.stands.includes(f.stand)||!S6R_NB.ac[f.ac])continue;if(f.tOB==null||f.tOB>T)continue;elig++;
  const r=f.nb;if(!r){bridge++;const w=f.nbWhy||(f.bridge?'bridge':'none');why[w]=(why[w]||0)+1;if(!f.bridge)issues.push(f.code+':no-bus-no-bridge');continue}
  bus++;if(f.ac==='AC-TP-01')tp++;else qj++;pax+=r.arr.n+r.dep.n;shuttles+=2;
  if(!(r.arr.at>=f.tOB&&r.arr.done<r.dep.at))issues.push(f.code+':bus-order');{const sv=(f.svcQ||[]).filter(q=>q.svc==='cleaning'||q.svc==='catering');for(const q of sv)if(q.done>r.dep.at+.5)issues.push(f.code+':boarding-before-'+q.svc)}vis.push([f.code,f.ac.slice(3,5),f.stand,Math.round(f.tOB),Math.round(r.arr.at-f.tOB),Math.round(r.arr.done-f.tOB),Math.round(r.dep.at-f.tOB),Math.round(r.dep.done-f.tOB),Math.round((f.tPush??f.t1)-f.tOB)]);if(f.tPush!=null&&r.close>f.tPush+.5)issues.push(f.code+':airstair-at-push');
  for(const p of r.path)if(p[1]>AF.L-14)issues.push(f.code+':walk-on-lane-L');
  const [xc,yc]=r.bus,pz=(v,t)=>{for(const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks))if(t>=k.t0&&t<k.t1&&k.tr&&k.tr.seq){const p=k.tr.seq.at(t-k.t0);if(p)return p}return v.home};
  for(const w of[r.arr,r.dep])for(let t=w.at;t<=w.done;t+=2)for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.id===w.v)continue;const p=pz(v,t);if(!p)continue;
   if(Math.abs(p[0]-xc)<45+8&&Math.abs(p[1]-yc)<10+8){issues.push(f.code+':'+v.id+' in the bus slot @'+t.toFixed(0));break}}
  {const pb=w=>{const v=AO.fleet.find(q=>q.id===w.v);const p=v&&pz(v,(w.at+w.done)/2);return p&&Math.hypot(p[0]-xc,p[1]-yc)<2};if(!pb(r.arr)||!pb(r.dep))issues.push(f.code+':bus-not-in-slot')}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,elig,bus,bridge,tp,qj,pax,shuttles,why,notAdmitted:((AO.stats.why||{})['no-nb-bus']||0)+((AO.stats.why||{})['no-nb-bus-dep']||0),visits:vis.slice(0,8),issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,10)}}

function f2BridgeGeometry(s,f,ext=1){
 const ac=f?.ac||s.aircraft,S=APTT_SPEC.ac[ac],ng=S.an['Nose Gear'],d=S.an.Door,ngy=f?.sd?.ngy??s.ng;
 {const v=f&&f.sd&&f.sd.viewFor===ac?f.sd:null;if(v&&(v.cx!==s.cx||v.door!==s.door))s=Object.assign({},s,{cx:v.cx,door:v.door,svcSide:v.svcSide})}   
 const th=f?.sd?.th??Math.PI/2,c=Math.cos(th),sn=Math.sin(th),dx=d[0]-ng[0],dy=g73DoorDy(s,ac,th,ngy,dx,d[1]-ng[1]),ey=dy+(Math.sign(dy)||1)*APT_JB_CAB;   
 
 const terminal=[s.gateX,APT_BRIDGE_Y],door=[s.cx+dx*c-dy*sn,ngy+dx*sn+dy*c],dock=[s.cx+dx*c-ey*sn,ngy+dx*sn+ey*c],vx=dock[0]-terminal[0],vy=dock[1]-terminal[1],length=Math.hypot(vx,vy);
 const nat=APTT_SPEC.jb.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Terminal End')[2]-APTT_SPEC.jb.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Door End')[2],reach=length*nat/(nat+APT_JB_CABC),u=(18+(reach-18)*ext)/length;
 return{terminal,door,dock,end:[terminal[0]+vx*u,terminal[1]+vy*u],length,reach,ac};
}


const G77_SM=x=>{x=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x));return x*x*(3-2*x)},G77_ANG=(a,b)=>Math.atan2(Math.sin(b-a),Math.cos(b-a));
function g77BridgePoseOld(s,f,ext){
 const B=f2BridgeGeometry(s,f,1),T=B.terminal,R=[T[0],T[1]-14],cd=[B.door[0]-B.dock[0],B.door[1]-B.dock[1]],cl=Math.hypot(cd[0],cd[1])||1,cu=[cd[0]/cl,cd[1]/cl];
 const ce=[B.dock[0]-cu[0]*9,B.dock[1]-cu[1]*9],Ld=Math.hypot(ce[0]-R[0],ce[1]-R[1]),thd=Math.atan2(ce[1]-R[1],ce[0]-R[0]),thc=Math.atan2(cu[1],cu[0]);
 
 const B0=f2BridgeGeometry(s,null,1),thr=Math.atan2(B0.dock[1]-R[1],B0.dock[0]-R[0]),Lr=Math.max(30,Ld*.55);   
 let L,th,ca;const e=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,ext));
 if(e<=.45){L=Lr+(Ld*.9-Lr)*G77_SM(e/.45);th=thr;ca=th}                                       
 else if(e<=.75){L=Ld*.9;th=thr+G77_ANG(thr,thd)*G77_SM((e-.45)/.3);ca=th}                      
 else if(e<=.9){L=Ld*.9;th=thd;ca=th+G77_ANG(th,thc)*G77_SM((e-.75)/.15)}                       
 else{th=thd;ca=thc;L=Ld*(.9+.1*G77_SM((e-.9)/.1))}                                            
 const end=[R[0]+Math.cos(th)*L,R[1]+Math.sin(th)*L],cab=[end[0]+Math.cos(ca)*9,end[1]+Math.sin(ca)*9];
 return{T,R,th,L,end,ca,cab,docked:e>.98,B}}

function g77BridgePose(s,f,ext){
 const K=G77_K72,S=g77K72Stand(s);if(!S)return g77BridgePoseOld(s,f,ext);
 const R=S.R,T=S.T,d1=K.rr+K.dj,dk=f?g77K72Dock(s,f,R):null,e=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,f?ext:0)),sm=G77_SM;

  if(e<=.35){Lt=S.LA+(Lp-S.LA)*sm(e/.35);ph='extend'}                                                   
  else{
  const thA=dk.th+Math.sign(G77_ANG(dk.th,-Math.PI/2))*K.away;   
  if(e<=.65){Lt=Lp;th=S.thRest+G77_ANG(S.thRest,thA)*sm((e-.35)/.3);ca=th;ph='rotate'}                  
  else if(e<=.85){Lt=Lp;th=thA;ca=th+G77_ANG(th,dk.ca)*sm((e-.65)/.2);ph='cab'}                         
  else{const k=sm((e-.85)/.15);th=thA+G77_ANG(thA,dk.th)*k;ca=dk.ca;Lt=Lp+(Ld-Lp)*k;ph=e>.98?'dock':'docking'}}}

 const uc=[Math.cos(ca),Math.sin(ca)],front=[C0[0]+uc[0]*K.cabD,C0[1]+uc[1]*K.cabD],cab=[C0[0]+uc[0]*K.cabD/2,C0[1]+uc[1]*K.cabD/2],W=[R[0]+u[0]*(bE-K.wb),R[1]+u[1]*(bE-K.wb)];

function g77K72Parts(P){const K=G77_K72,S=P.S,{T,R,u,n,C0,uc}=P,nc=[-uc[1],uc[0]],u0=[Math.cos(S.phi),Math.sin(S.phi)],n0=[-u0[1],u0[0]];

 return{fixed:box(T,uf,nf,0,fl-fe,K.hwF),
  bel1:[[R[0]+u0[0]*de+n0[0]*K.hwA,R[1]+u0[1]*de+n0[1]*K.hwA],[R[0]+u[0]*P.aS+n[0]*K.hwA,R[1]+u[1]*P.aS+n[1]*K.hwA],[R[0]+u[0]*P.aS-n[0]*K.hwA,R[1]+u[1]*P.aS-n[1]*K.hwA],[R[0]+u0[0]*de-n0[0]*K.hwA,R[1]+u0[1]*de-n0[1]*K.hwA]],
  A:box(R,u,n,P.aS,P.aE,K.hwA),Bt:box(R,u,n,P.bS,P.bE,K.hwB),
  bel2:[[E[0]+n[0]*K.hwB,E[1]+n[1]*K.hwB],[C0[0]+nc[0]*K.hwB,C0[1]+nc[1]*K.hwB],[C0[0]-nc[0]*K.hwB,C0[1]-nc[1]*K.hwB],[E[0]-n[0]*K.hwB,E[1]-n[1]*K.hwB]],
  cab:box(C0,uc,nc,0,K.cabD,K.cabHW),canopy:box(C0,uc,nc,K.cabD-K.can,K.cabD,K.cabHW-1.5),
  leg:box(W,u,n,-2.5,2.5,2),wheels:[box([W[0]+n[0]*(K.hwB+1.6),W[1]+n[1]*(K.hwB+1.6)],u,n,-3,3,1.5),box([W[0]-n[0]*(K.hwB+1.6),W[1]-n[1]*(K.hwB+1.6)],u,n,-3,3,1.5)],
  drum:{c:R,r:K.rr}}}
const g77PolyArea=p=>{let a=0;for(let i=0;i<p.length;i++){const q=p[i],r=p[(i+1)%p.length];a+=q[0]*r[1]-r[0]*q[1]}return a/2};
function g77PolyPath(g,p){const q=g77PolyArea(p)<0?p.slice().reverse():p;g.moveTo(q[0][0],q[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<q.length;i++)g.lineTo(q[i][0],q[i][1]);g.closePath()}

function g77K72ShadowOff(s,P){const ac=(P.dk&&P.dk.ac)||s.aircraft,g=apttAcGeom(ac),L=g.F[1]-g.F[0],th=Math.PI/2;return[L*.02*Math.cos(th)-L*.03*Math.sin(th),L*.02*Math.sin(th)+L*.03*Math.cos(th)]}
function g77DrawBridge(g,P){if(!P.S)return g77DrawBridgeOld(g,P);

 {const {C0,uc}=P,nc=[-uc[1],uc[0]];g.fillStyle='#8fc3d6';for(const sd of[-1,1]){const c=[C0[0]+uc[0]*6+nc[0]*sd*(K.cabHW-2),C0[1]+uc[1]*6+nc[1]*sd*(K.cabHW-2)];g.beginPath();g77PolyPath(g,[[c[0]-uc[0]*3-nc[0]*.9,c[1]-uc[1]*3-nc[1]*.9],[c[0]+uc[0]*3-nc[0]*.9,c[1]+uc[1]*3-nc[1]*.9],[c[0]+uc[0]*3+nc[0]*.9,c[1]+uc[1]*3+nc[1]*.9],[c[0]-uc[0]*3+nc[0]*.9,c[1]-uc[1]*3+nc[1]*.9]]);g.fill()}}

function g77K72PaxLine(s,f){const P=g77BridgePose(s,f,1);if(!P.S)return null;return[P.T,P.R,P.C0,P.front]}

function g77K72PaintRest(g){for(const s of APT_STANDS){if(s.cargo)continue;const S=g77K72Stand(s);if(!S)continue;const [x,y]=S.Wr,a=S.thRest;

const g77SegX=(a,b,c,d)=>{const o=(p,q,r)=>(q[0]-p[0])*(r[1]-p[1])-(q[1]-p[1])*(r[0]-p[0]);const d1=o(c,d,a),d2=o(c,d,b),d3=o(a,b,c),d4=o(a,b,d);return d1*d2<0&&d3*d4<0};
function g77PolyOverlap(p,q,m=.05){   
 for(const P of[p,q])for(let i=0;i<P.length;i++){const a=P[i],b=P[(i+1)%P.length],nx=-(b[1]-a[1]),ny=b[0]-a[0],l=Math.hypot(nx,ny)||1;let a0=1e9,a1=-1e9,b0=1e9,b1=-1e9;
  for(const v of p){const d=(v[0]*nx+v[1]*ny)/l;a0=Math.min(a0,d);a1=Math.max(a1,d)}for(const v of q){const d=(v[0]*nx+v[1]*ny)/l;b0=Math.min(b0,d);b1=Math.max(b1,d)}
  if(a1<=b0+m||b1<=a0+m)return false}return true}
const g77Obb2Poly=o=>{const ux=o.c,uy=o.s,vx=-o.s,vy=o.c;return[[o.x-ux*o.hx-vx*o.hy,o.y-uy*o.hx-vy*o.hy],[o.x+ux*o.hx-vx*o.hy,o.y+uy*o.hx-vy*o.hy],[o.x+ux*o.hx+vx*o.hy,o.y+uy*o.hx+vy*o.hy],[o.x-ux*o.hx+vx*o.hy,o.y-uy*o.hx+vy*o.hy]]};
function g77PolyGap(p,q){if(g77PolyOverlap(p,q,0))return 0;let m=1e9;const sd=(c,a,b)=>{const dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],l=dx*dx+dy*dy||1,t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((c[0]-a[0])*dx+(c[1]-a[1])*dy)/l));return Math.hypot(a[0]+dx*t-c[0],a[1]+dy*t-c[1])};
 for(const [A,B] of[[p,q],[q,p]])for(const v of A)for(let i=0;i<B.length;i++)m=Math.min(m,sd(v,B[i],B[(i+1)%B.length]));return m}
const G77_K72_EXT=[0,.1,.2,.3,.35,.42,.5,.58,.65,.7,.75,.8,.85,.9,.95,.98,1];
function g77BridgeAudit(){const A=aptReady(),K=G77_K72,issues=[],rows=[],road=[AF.L-15,AF.L+9];let n=0,poses=0;
 const bays=APL.bays.filter(b=>b.zone==='F2'&&(b.kind==='BT'||b.kind==='AB')).map(b=>({id:b.id,p:[[b.x0,b.y0],[b.x1,b.y0],[b.x1,b.y1],[b.x0,b.y1]]}));
 for(const s of APT_STANDS){if(s.cargo)continue;const sp=A.stands.find(q=>q.id===s.id);if(!sp||!sp.bridge)continue;const S=g77K72Stand(s);if(!S){issues.push(s.id+':no-K72');continue}
  if(Math.abs(s.gateX-S.rx)>.01)issues.push(s.id+':base≠rotunda');
  for(const ac of sp.accepts){if(s6rBusOnly(s.id,ac))continue;const vw=g77StandView(sp,ac),f={ac,sd:vw.viewFor?vw:{th:sp.th,ngy:sp.ngy}},env=aplEnv(ac,vw.viewFor?vw.cx:s.cx,vw.ngy??sp.ngy,sp.th),fus=g77Obb2Poly(env[0]),wing=env.slice(1).map(g77Obb2Poly);n++;
   const row={stand:s.id,ac,acc:S.acc,LA:S.LA,LB:S.LB,poses:0,minBel:1e9,maxBel:0,minFus:1e9,minRoad:1e9,minBay:1e9,minWing:1e9,restGap:1e9,issues:0};
   for(const e of G77_K72_EXT){const P=g77BridgePose(s,f,e),Q=g77K72Parts(P),bad=k=>{row.issues++;if(row.issues<=4)issues.push(s.id+' '+ac.slice(3,5)+' e'+e+' '+k)};poses++;row.poses++;
    
    for(const v of Q.fixed.slice(1,3))if(Math.hypot(v[0]-P.R[0],v[1]-P.R[1])>K.rr+.01)bad('fixed-gap');
    for(const v of [Q.bel1[0],Q.bel1[3]])if(Math.hypot(v[0]-P.R[0],v[1]-P.R[1])>K.rr+.01)bad('drum-gap');
    if(Math.hypot(Q.bel1[1][0]-Q.A[0][0],Q.bel1[1][1]-Q.A[0][1])>.01||Math.hypot(Q.bel1[2][0]-Q.A[3][0],Q.bel1[2][1]-Q.A[3][1])>.01)bad('bel1-A');
    if(Math.hypot(Q.bel2[0][0]-Q.Bt[1][0],Q.bel2[0][1]-Q.Bt[1][1])>.01||Math.hypot(Q.bel2[3][0]-Q.Bt[2][0],Q.bel2[3][1]-Q.Bt[2][1])>.01)bad('B-bel2');
    {const cA=[(Q.A[0][0]+Q.A[3][0])/2,(Q.A[0][1]+Q.A[3][1])/2],cB=[(Q.Bt[0][0]+Q.Bt[3][0])/2,(Q.Bt[0][1]+Q.Bt[3][1])/2],off=Math.abs((cB[0]-cA[0])*P.n[0]+(cB[1]-cA[1])*P.n[1]);if(off>.01)bad('telescope-off-centre '+off.toFixed(2))}
    if(P.bS<P.aS-.01)bad('B-out-of-A');if(P.aE-P.bS<K.ovl-.01)bad('telescope-overlap '+(P.aE-P.bS).toFixed(1));if(P.bE<P.aE-.01)bad('B-end-inside-A');
    
    for(const [k,p] of[['bel1',Q.bel1],['bel2',Q.bel2]]){if(g77SegX(p[0],p[1],p[3],p[2]))bad(k+'-crossed');const a=Math.hypot(p[1][0]-p[0][0],p[1][1]-p[0][1]),b=Math.hypot(p[2][0]-p[3][0],p[2][1]-p[3][1]);row.minBel=Math.min(row.minBel,a,b);row.maxBel=Math.max(row.maxBel,a,b);if(Math.min(a,b)<1.5)bad(k+'-closed '+Math.min(a,b).toFixed(1))}
    
    if(g77PolyOverlap(Q.cab,Q.Bt,.3)||g77PolyOverlap(Q.cab,Q.A,.3))bad('cab-into-tunnel');
    if(Math.hypot(Q.A[0][0]-P.R[0],Q.A[0][1]-P.R[1])<K.rr)bad('A-into-drum');
    
    {const wd=(P.W[0]-P.R[0])*P.u[0]+(P.W[1]-P.R[1])*P.u[1],wo=Math.abs((P.W[0]-P.R[0])*P.n[0]+(P.W[1]-P.R[1])*P.n[1]);if(wd<P.bS+2||wd>P.bE-2||wo>.01)bad('wheels-detached');
     for(const w of Q.wheels.concat([Q.leg])){const y0=Math.min(...w.map(v=>v[1])),y1=Math.max(...w.map(v=>v[1]));row.minRoad=Math.min(row.minRoad,Math.max(road[0]-y1,y0-road[1]));if(y1>road[0]&&y0<road[1])bad('wheels-on-road');
      for(const q of wing){const gp=g77PolyGap(w,q);row.minWing=Math.min(row.minWing,gp);if(gp<1)bad('wheels-under-wing')}
      for(const b of bays){const gp=g77PolyGap(w,b.p);row.minBay=Math.min(row.minBay,gp);if(gp<2)bad('wheels-in-bay '+b.id)}}}
    
    {const gT=Math.min(g77PolyGap(Q.A,fus),g77PolyGap(Q.Bt,fus),g77PolyGap(Q.bel2,fus)),gC=g77PolyGap(Q.cab,fus);row.minFus=Math.min(row.minFus,gT,P.docked||P.ph==='docking'?1e9:gC);if(gT<1)bad('tunnel-on-fuselage');if(P.ph==='docking'||P.docked){if(g77PolyOverlap(Q.cab,fus,.3))bad('cab-into-fuselage')}else if(gC<1.5)bad('cab-hits-fuselage '+gC.toFixed(1))}   
    if(e===0){for(const p of [Q.A,Q.Bt,Q.bel2,Q.cab]){for(const q of env.map(g77Obb2Poly))row.restGap=Math.min(row.restGap,g77PolyGap(p,q));for(const b of bays)if(g77PolyGap(p,b.p)<1)bad('rest-over-bay '+b.id)}if(row.restGap<6)bad('rest-in-the-way '+row.restGap.toFixed(1))}
    if(e===1){const gap=Math.hypot(P.front[0]-P.dk.door[0],P.front[1]-P.dk.door[1]),par=Math.abs(G77_ANG(P.ca,P.dk.ca))*180/Math.PI,ang=Math.abs(P.dk.al)*180/Math.PI;
     row.door=+gap.toFixed(2);row.parallel=+par.toFixed(2);row.deg=+ang.toFixed(1);row.reach=Math.round(P.dk.D+K.cabD);row.Lt=+P.Lt.toFixed(1);if(gap>1)bad('cab-off-door '+gap.toFixed(2));if(par>.5)bad('cab-not-parallel '+par.toFixed(2));if(ang<25||ang>70)bad('angle '+ang.toFixed(0)+'°');
     if(P.Lt<S.LA-.01||P.Lt>S.LA+S.LB-K.ovl+.01)bad('telescope-range '+P.Lt.toFixed(1));
     
     const pl=g77K72PaxLine(s,f);row.pax=pl?pl.length:0;if(!pl||Math.hypot(pl[1][0]-P.R[0],pl[1][1]-P.R[1])>.01||Math.hypot(pl[3][0]-P.dk.door[0],pl[3][1]-P.dk.door[1])>1)bad('pax-line')}}
   for(const k of['minBel','maxBel','minFus','minRoad','minBay','minWing','restGap'])row[k]=+(+row[k]).toFixed(1);
   const an=g77Anchors(ac)||{},th=sp.th!=null?sp.th:Math.PI/2,c=Math.cos(th),sn=Math.sin(th),dB=f2BridgeGeometry(s,f,1).door,dx=dB[0]-(vw.viewFor?vw.cx:s.cx),dy=dB[1]-(vw.ngy??sp.ngy??s.ng),rel=[dx*c+dy*sn,-dx*sn+dy*c];
   const cand=['Door L1','Door R1'].filter(k=>an[k]).map(k=>({k,d:Math.hypot(an[k][0]-rel[0],an[k][1]-rel[1])})).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d)[0];row.doorK=cand?cand.k:'?';if(!cand||cand.d>1.5)issues.push(s.id+' '+ac+' bridge door ≠ the drawn door');
   rows.push(row)}
  
  {const R=S.R,c=[[R[0]-K.rr,R[1]-K.rr],[R[0]+K.rr,R[1]-K.rr],[R[0]+K.rr,R[1]+K.rr],[R[0]-K.rr,R[1]+K.rr]];if(R[1]+K.rr>AF.L-12)issues.push(s.id+':rotunda-on-road');for(const b of bays)if(g77PolyGap(c,b.p)<2)issues.push(s.id+':rotunda-in-bay '+b.id)}}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:issues.slice(0,40),pairs:n,poses,rows}}

function aptZoneAudit(){
 aptReady();
 const issues=[],Z=APL.zones,roads=aptRoadRects(),aptIds=new Set(APT_BUILDINGS.map(b=>b.id));
 const zs=[['west apron',Z.wApron],['east block',Z.eBlock],['perimeter',Z.perim],['yard',Z.yard],['heliport',Z.heli]];
 const regs=[E0_REGION,F0_REGION,G0_REGION,E1_REGION,F1_REGION,G1_REGION,E2_REGION,F2_REGION,G2_REGION];
 const inReg=(r)=>[[r.x,r.y],[r.x+r.w,r.y],[r.x,r.y+r.h],[r.x+r.w,r.y+r.h]].every(([px,py])=>regs.some(g=>px>=g.x&&px<=g.x+g.w&&py>=g.y&&py<=g.y+g.h));
 for(const [n,z] of zs){
  if(!inReg(z))issues.push(n+': outside the live regions');
  for(const r of roads)if(aptOver(z,r))issues.push(n+': on road '+r.id);
  for(const b of C4_BUILDINGS){if(aptIds.has(b.id))continue;const f=b.info?aptFp(b):null;if(f&&aptOver(z,f))issues.push(n+': on building '+b.id)}
  for(const c of PARKED_CARS){if(c.x>=z.x&&c.x<=z.x+z.w&&c.y>=z.y&&c.y<=z.y+z.h)issues.push(n+': parked car '+c.id)}
 }
 return{ok:issues.length===0,issues};
}
function aptLayoutQa(){
 aptReady();const a=aplAudit(APL),z=aptZoneAudit();
 const fixed=APL.stands.length,paxBridge=APL.stands.filter(s=>s.tpl==='bridge').length,unique=new Set(APL.stands.map(s=>s.id)).size===APL.stands.length;
 return{ok:a.ok&&z.ok&&fixed>=18&&APL.helis.length>=6&&APL.bays.length>=24&&APL.fleet.length>=20&&paxBridge===4&&unique,stands:fixed,bridges:paxBridge,helis:APL.helis.length,bays:APL.bays.length,fleet:APL.fleet.length,issues:a.issues.concat(z.issues)};
}
function aoSandbox(fn){
 const keys=['B','ST','LOG','flights','hist','dbg','evt','stands','stats','nid','t','last','seed','rng','TK','RBX','keep','diag','fleet','job','job0','chJob','work','workLimit','sliced','useClock','mlv','t0i','pt','stepDone'],sv={},svAPL=APL,svAF={stats:AF.stats,fails:AF.fails,rj:AF.rj};
 for(const k of keys)sv[k]=AO[k];
 AO.B=new Map();AO.ST=[];AO.LOG=[];AO.flights=[];AO.hist=[];AO.mlv=null;AO.dbg=[];AO.evt=[];AO.job=null;AO.job0=null;AO.chJob=null;AO.sliced=false;AO.useClock=false;AO.workLimit=Infinity;
 const gx=typeof G76X!=='undefined'?G76X:null,svX=gx?{ofs:gx.ofs,ofs0:gx.ofs0,ovr:gx.ovr,remap:gx.stats?gx.stats.remap:0}:null;if(gx){gx.ovr=0;gx.ofs0=0}
 try{return fn()}finally{for(const k of keys)AO[k]=sv[k];APL=svAPL;AF.stats=svAF.stats;AF.fails=svAF.fails;AF.rj=svAF.rj;if(gx){gx.ofs=svX.ofs;gx.ofs0=svX.ofs0;gx.ovr=svX.ovr;if(gx.stats)gx.stats.remap=svX.remap}}
}

  for(let t=0;t<=T;t+=1)aoStep(t);
  const r=aoVerify(0,T),ms=performance.now()-t0;
  const all=AO.hist.concat(AO.flights),dep=all.filter(f=>f.states.some(s=>s[1]==='DEPARTED')&&!f.init).length,arr=all.filter(f=>f.states.some(s=>s[1]==='ON_BLOCK')&&f.states[0][1]==='INBOUND').length;

  return{ok:r.ok&&fleetOk&&dep>=3&&arr>=3&&bag.ok,bag,issues:r.issues,planned:AO.stats.planned,failed:AO.stats.failed,dep,arr,maxSimul:r.maxSimul,maxQueue:AO.stats.maxQueue,ms:Math.round(ms),fleet:AO.fleet.length,fleetTasks:tasks,fleetOk,fleetIssues:fleetIssues.length};
 });
}

function f1Snapshot(time=APT_OPS.clk){
 const slice=aoSl(time);if(F1_MONITOR.cache?.slice===slice&&F1_MONITOR.cache.bucket===AO.B.get(slice))return F1_MONITOR.cache.value;
 const bucket=AO.B.get(slice)||[],owners=[...new Set(bucket.filter(s=>s.L==='R').map(s=>String(s.t).replace(/-R$/,'')))];
 const tokens=Object.fromEntries(['TW1','TW2','J2','LNK2','TW3'].map(k=>[k,[...new Set(bucket.filter(s=>s.L==='S'&&s.k===k).map(s=>s.t))]]));
 const aircraft=[];for(const f of AO.flights){if(f.heli||f.never||time<f.t0||time>=f.t1)continue;for(const q of f.tracks){const p=q.tr.seq.at(time-q.t0);if(q.tr.kind==='ac'&&p)aircraft.push({code:f.code,stand:f.stand,asset:q.tr.id,state:aoStateOf(f,time),x:p[0],y:p[1],heading:p[2],height:p[3]});}}
 const ownerFlight=AO.flights.find(f=>owners.includes(f.code)),stage=ownerFlight?aoStateOf(ownerFlight,time):null;
 const phase=!owners.length?'free':['APPROACH','LANDING_RESERVED','LANDING_ROLL','VACATE_RUNWAY'].includes(stage)?'arrival':['RUNWAY_RESERVED','LINE_UP','TAKEOFF_ROLL'].includes(stage)?'departure':'reserved';
 const conflict=owners.length>1||Object.values(tokens).some(a=>a.length>1);
 const a2Plane=aircraft.find(a=>owners.length===1&&a.code===owners[0]&&a.height<.01&&Math.abs(a.x-6600)<125&&a.y>=APT_Y.RY&&a.y<=APT_Y.TY+6&&['RUNWAY_RESERVED','LINE_UP','TAKEOFF_ROLL'].includes(a.state));
 const value={time:+time.toFixed(2),owners,owner:owners[0]||null,stage,phase,tokens,conflict,stopBarRed:conflict||!a2Plane,clearanceCode:!conflict&&a2Plane?a2Plane.code:null,aircraft:aircraft.filter(a=>a.x>=6000&&a.x<7200&&a.y<850&&a.y>-850),waiting:aircraft.filter(a=>['HOLD_SHORT','INBOUND'].includes(a.state)).length};
 F1_MONITOR.cache={slice,bucket:AO.B.get(slice),value};return value;
}
function f1Watch(time){
 if(time-F1_MONITOR.lastAt<.5)return;F1_MONITOR.lastAt=time;F1_MONITOR.cache=null;
 const s=f1Snapshot(time),key=[s.owner,s.phase,s.stopBarRed,s.conflict].join('|');if(key===F1_MONITOR.key)return;
 F1_MONITOR.key=key;F1_MONITOR.changes++;if(s.conflict)F1_MONITOR.conflicts++;Dbg.event('airport-f1','a2-clearance',{owner:s.owner,phase:s.phase,stopBarRed:s.stopBarRed,clearanceCode:s.clearanceCode,conflict:s.conflict});
}

function f1NearTower(){const p=APT_INTERACTIONS['APT-TOWER'];return PlayerProfile.mode==='walk'&&Math.hypot(PlayerPed.x-p.x,PlayerPed.y-p.y)<=75}
function f1StartMission(d){
 if(!f1NearTower())return toast('גש ברגל למגדל הפיקוח ולחץ F');
 PlayerProfile.activeMission={id:d.id,stage:'runway-observation',reward:d.reward,timeRemaining:d.timeLimit,startedAt:iso(),startCollisions:PlayerCar.collisions||0,returnVehicle:null,f1:{index:0,errors:0,lastCapture:null,pending:null,observations:[]}};
 setNavigationTarget('APT-TOWER',{mission:true,silent:true});SaveManager.save('mission-start',{backup:true,silent:true});openPoiPhone('business','APT-TOWER');toast('צלם שלוש תצפיות וקרא את אישורי המסלול');return true;
}
function f1Capture(){
 const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(m?.id!=='M-F1-WATCH'||!f1NearTower())return false;const a=m.f1,s=f1Snapshot();
 if(!APT_OPS.ready||!AO.flights.some(f=>!f.heli&&!f.never))return toast('התנועה מתכוננת · צלם תצפית בעוד כמה רגעים');
 if(a.pending)return false;if(a.lastCapture!=null&&s.time-a.lastCapture<8)return toast('המתן לתצפית הבאה · '+Math.ceil(8-s.time+a.lastCapture)+' שנ׳');
 let prompt,options,expected;if(a.index===0){prompt='למי המסלול שמור בתצפית הזו?';expected=s.owner||'none';const codes=[...new Set([s.owner,...AO.flights.filter(f=>!f.heli&&!f.never).map(f=>f.code)].filter(Boolean))].slice(0,3);options=[{value:'none',label:'המסלול פנוי'},...codes.map(value=>({value,label:value}))];}
 else if(a.index===1){prompt='מהו מצב כניסת A2 בתצפית?';expected=s.stopBarRed?'hold':'clear';options=[{value:'hold',label:'עצור — הכניסה חסומה'},{value:'clear',label:'אישור למטוס בכניסה בלבד'}];}
 else{prompt='איזה שימוש במסלול משתקף בתצפית?';expected=s.phase;options=Object.entries(F1_PHASE_LABELS).map(([value,label])=>({value,label}));}
 a.pending={time:s.time,prompt,options,expected,owner:s.owner,stopBarRed:s.stopBarRed,phase:s.phase};a.lastCapture=s.time;renderPhone();return true;
}
function f1Answer(value){
 const m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(m?.id!=='M-F1-WATCH'||!f1NearTower())return false;const a=m.f1,q=a.pending;if(!q||!q.options.some(o=>o.value===value))return false;
 a.pending=null;if(value!==q.expected){a.errors++;m.timeRemaining=Math.max(0,m.timeRemaining-12);toast('הקריאה לא תאמה לתצפית · צלם שוב');renderPhone();return false;}
 a.observations.push({time:q.time,owner:q.owner,phase:q.phase,stopBarRed:q.stopBarRed});a.index++;
 if(a.index===3)return missionComplete();SaveManager.save('f1-observation',{backup:false,silent:true});renderPhone();toast('התצפית אושרה · '+a.index+'/3');return true;
}
function f1UpdateMission(dt,m,d){m.timeRemaining=Math.max(0,m.timeRemaining-dt);if(m.timeRemaining<=0)return missionFail('timeout')}
function f1ResumeMission(m){m.f1||={index:0,errors:0,observations:[]};m.f1.pending=null;m.f1.lastCapture=null;setNavigationTarget('APT-TOWER',{mission:true,silent:true})}
function f1OnComplete(m,d){
 if(d.id!=='M-F1-WATCH')return;const p=PlayerProfile.worldPersistent.runwayObservations||={runs:0,bestSeconds:null,last:null},seconds=+(d.timeLimit-m.timeRemaining).toFixed(2);
 p.runs++;p.last={at:iso(),seconds,errors:m.f1.errors,observations:m.f1.observations};if(!m.f1.errors&&(p.bestSeconds==null||seconds<p.bestSeconds))p.bestSeconds=seconds;
}

function g1ExitInfo(f){
 if(!f||f.heli||f.never||f.states?.[0]?.[1]!=='INBOUND')return null;
 const n=(f.tracks||[]).length,c=G1_EXIT.get(f);if(c&&c.n===n)return c.info;let info=null;
 for(const q of f.tracks||[]){if(q.tr.kind!=='ac')continue;const d=q.tr.seq.dur||0;let ex=null;
  for(let t=0;t<=d;t+=.5){const p=q.tr.seq.at(t);if(!p||p[3]>.01)continue;
   if(!ex){if(p[1]>APT_Y.RS+8&&p[1]<APT_Y.TN-4)for(const l of APT_LINKS)if(Math.abs(p[0]-l.x)<l.w/2){ex=l;break}continue}
   if(p[1]>=APT_TWY.cy-2){info={exit:ex.id,turn:p[0]<ex.x-30?'west':p[0]>ex.x+30?'east':'straight'};break}}
  if(ex&&!info)info={exit:ex.id,turn:'west'};if(info)break}
 G1_EXIT.set(f,{n,info});return info;
}
function g1ExitOf(f){return g1ExitInfo(f)?.exit||null}
function g1Snapshot(time=APT_OPS.clk){
 const slice=aoSl(time);if(G1_MONITOR.cache?.slice===slice&&G1_MONITOR.cache.bucket===AO.B.get(slice)&&G1_MONITOR.cache.flights===AO.flights)return G1_MONITOR.cache.value;
 const bucket=AO.B.get(slice)||[],owners=[...new Set(bucket.filter(s=>s.L==='R').map(s=>String(s.t).replace(/-R$/,'')))];
 const tokens=Object.fromEntries(['TW4','LNK3','J3','TW5','JG','GL'].map(k=>[k,[...new Set(bucket.filter(s=>s.L==='S'&&s.k===k).map(s=>s.t))]]));
 const aircraft=[];let vacating=null;
 for(const f of AO.flights){if(f.heli||f.never||time<f.t0||time>=f.t1)continue;const st=aoStateOf(f,time);
  for(const q of f.tracks){const p=q.tr.seq.at(time-q.t0);if(q.tr.kind==='ac'&&p&&p[0]>=7200&&p[0]<8400&&p[1]<850&&p[1]>-850)aircraft.push({code:f.code,stand:f.stand,asset:q.tr.id,state:st,x:p[0],y:p[1],heading:p[2],height:p[3]})}
  if(!vacating&&['LANDING_ROLL','VACATE_RUNWAY'].includes(st)&&g1ExitOf(f)==='A3'){let pos=null;for(const q of f.tracks){const p=q.tr.seq.at(time-q.t0);if(q.tr.kind==='ac'&&p){pos=[p[0],p[1],p[3]];break}}
   
   if(pos&&pos[1]<=APT_TWY.cy+8)vacating={code:f.code,state:st,stand:f.stand,key:f.code+'@'+f.t0,pos,turn:g1ExitInfo(f).turn}}
 }
 const ownerFlight=AO.flights.find(f=>owners.includes(f.code)),stage=ownerFlight?aoStateOf(ownerFlight,time):null;
 const phase=!owners.length?'free':['APPROACH','LANDING_RESERVED','LANDING_ROLL','VACATE_RUNWAY'].includes(stage)?'arrival':['RUNWAY_RESERVED','LINE_UP','TAKEOFF_ROLL'].includes(stage)?'departure':'reserved';
 const conflict=owners.length>1||Object.values(tokens).some(a=>a.length>1);
 
 const a3Plane=aircraft.find(a=>owners.length===1&&a.code===owners[0]&&a.height<.01&&Math.abs(a.x-7950)<125&&a.y>=APT_Y.RY&&a.y<=APT_Y.TY+6&&['RUNWAY_RESERVED','LINE_UP'].includes(a.state));    
 const value={time:+time.toFixed(2),owners,owner:owners[0]||null,stage,phase,tokens,conflict,stopBarRed:conflict||!a3Plane,clearanceCode:!conflict&&a3Plane?a3Plane.code:null,leadOff:!!vacating&&!conflict,vacating,aircraft,
  onRunwayEnd:aircraft.filter(a=>a.y>=APT_Y.RN&&a.y<=APT_Y.RS&&a.height<.01).length};
 G1_MONITOR.cache={slice,bucket:AO.B.get(slice),flights:AO.flights,value};return value;
}
function g1Watch(time){
 if(time-G1_MONITOR.lastAt<.5)return;G1_MONITOR.lastAt=time;G1_MONITOR.cache=null;
 const s=g1Snapshot(time);
 if(s.vacating&&!G1_MONITOR.seen.has(s.vacating.key)){if(G1_MONITOR.seen.size>500)G1_MONITOR.seen.clear();G1_MONITOR.seen.add(s.vacating.key);G1_MONITOR.a3Vacates++;G1_MONITOR.lastVacate={code:s.vacating.code,stand:s.vacating.stand,at:+time.toFixed(1)};Dbg.event('airport-g1','a3-vacate',{code:s.vacating.code,stand:s.vacating.stand})}
 const key=[s.owner,s.phase,s.stopBarRed,s.leadOff,s.conflict].join('|');if(key===G1_MONITOR.key)return;
 G1_MONITOR.key=key;G1_MONITOR.changes++;if(s.conflict)G1_MONITOR.conflicts++;Dbg.event('airport-g1','runway-end',{owner:s.owner,phase:s.phase,stopBarRed:s.stopBarRed,leadOff:s.leadOff,conflict:s.conflict});
}
function g1Reset(){Object.assign(G1_MONITOR,{lastAt:-1,key:null,changes:0,conflicts:0,a3Vacates:0,lastVacate:null,seen:new Set(),cache:null})}

}

function g1DrawFixtures(now,v){

 if(s.stopBarRed&&portVis(v,7892,Y.RS-3,116,32))portCached('g1-a3-stop',7892,Y.RS-3,116,32,g=>{for(const o of G1_FIXTURES.filter(l=>l.role==='stop-bar'))e1DrawAsset(g,o,0)},2);
 if(Math.floor(now/350)%2!==0&&portVis(v,7865,Y.SS-23,170,36))portCached('g1-a3-guards',7865,Y.SS-23,170,36,g=>{for(const o of G1_FIXTURES.filter(l=>l.role==='runway-guard'))e1DrawAsset(g,o,0)},2);
 if(s.leadOff&&portVis(v,7830,Y.RY-18,140,Y.TY+20-(Y.RY-18))){const west=s.vacating.turn==='west';portCached('g1-a3-leadoff-'+(west?'w':'s'),7830,Y.RY-18,140,Y.TY+20-(Y.RY-18),g=>{for(const o of G1_LEADOFF)if(west||o.role!=='lead-off-fillet')e1DrawAsset(g,o,0)},2)}
 if(portVis(v,G1_WINDSOCK.x-60,G1_WINDSOCK.y-60,120,120))e1DrawAsset(ctx,G1_WINDSOCK,now);

 Targets.add({id:'G1-RWY-EAST',label:'G0 · סף 27 וקצה המסלול · '+G1_PHASE_LABELS[s.phase],category:'airport',x:7775,y:Y.RY,w:1150,h:240});
 Targets.add({id:'G1-LINK-A3',label:'A3 · יציאה בלבד · '+(s.leadOff?'מפנה '+s.vacating.code:'פנויה'),category:'airport',x:7950,y:(Y.RS+Y.TN)/2,w:110,h:Y.TN-Y.RS});
 Targets.add({id:'G1-ARFF',label:'ARFF · גישה לקצה המסלול · עצירה בקצה הרצועה',category:'airport',x:8375,y:(G1_ARFF.y0+G1_ARFF.y1)/2,w:46,h:G1_ARFF.y1-G1_ARFF.y0});
}

function g1Box(o){const I=TurboCity.info(o.asset,{scale:o.scale,rot:o.rot||0,variant:o.v||0});return{x:o.x-I.w/2+I.fp[0],y:o.y-I.h/2+I.fp[1],w:I.fp[2],h:I.fp[3]}}
function g1GeometryAudit(){
 const issues=[],r=G1_SCOPE,R=APT_RWY,T=APT_TWY,A3=APT_LINKS[2];
 if(R.x0!==4950||R.x1!==8250||R.cy!==-430||R.w!==240)issues.push('runway-lock');if(T.cy!==-68||T.w!==120||T.x1!==8030)issues.push('taxi-lock');
 if(A3?.id!=='A3'||A3.x!==7950||A3.w!==110)issues.push('a3-lock');
 const inG1=p=>p.x>=r.x&&p.x<r.x+r.w&&p.y>=-850&&p.y<r.h;
 for(const p of [...G1_FIXTURES,...G1_LEADOFF,...G1_SIGNS,G1_PAPI,G1_WINDSOCK,G1_ARFF.sign])if(!inG1(p)||!p.frangible||p.height>1||!TurboCity.get(p.asset))issues.push(p.id+':bounds-or-asset');
 for(const p of G1_SIGNS)if(p.y<APT_Y.SS||Math.abs(p.x-A3.x)<A3.w/2+20)issues.push(p.id+':sign-clearance');
 const link={x:A3.x-A3.w/2,y:A3.y0-2,w:A3.w,h:A3.y1-A3.y0+6},twy={x:T.x0-40,y:T.cy-T.w/2,w:T.x1-T.x0+80,h:T.w},rwy={x:R.x0,y:R.cy-R.w/2,w:R.x1-R.x0,h:R.w},blast={x:R.x1,y:R.cy-R.w/2,w:90,h:R.w};
 const papi=g1Box(G1_PAPI);if(aptOver(papi,link)||aptOver(papi,twy)||aptOver(papi,rwy))issues.push('papi-on-pavement');
 if(G1_PAPI.x<R.x1-460||G1_PAPI.x>R.x1-400)issues.push('papi-not-abeam-aiming-point-27');
 const ws=g1Box(G1_WINDSOCK);if(aptOver(ws,link)||aptOver(ws,rwy)||aptOver(ws,twy))issues.push('windsock-on-pavement');
 const loc={x:G1_LOC.pad.x,y:G1_LOC.pad.y,w:G1_LOC.pad.w,h:G1_LOC.pad.h};if(aptOver(loc,rwy)||aptOver(loc,blast)||loc.x+loc.w>8400||Math.abs((G1_LOC.y0+G1_LOC.y1)/2-R.cy)>1)issues.push('loc-placement');
 const road={x:G1_ARFF.x,y:G1_ARFF.y0,w:G1_ARFF.w,h:G1_ARFF.y1-G1_ARFF.y0},P=APL.zones.perim;
 if(aptOver(road,rwy)||aptOver(road,blast)||aptOver(road,loc))issues.push('arff-road-on-runway');if(road.x<P.x-1||road.x+road.w>P.x+P.w+1)issues.push('arff-road-off-perimeter-zone');
 if(G1_ARFF.stopY<APT_Y.SS||G1_ARFF.stopY>APT_Y.SS+20)issues.push('arff-stop-line');
 const vault=g1Box(G1_AFL);const heliApron={x:8060,y:640,w:300,h:100};
 if(vault.y<APT_Y.SS||aptOver(vault,twy)||aptOver(vault,heliApron)||aptOver(vault,road)||aptOver(vault,link))issues.push('afl-clearance');
 for(const h of APT_HELIPADS)if(Math.hypot(Math.max(vault.x-h.x,0,h.x-vault.x-vault.w),Math.max(vault.y-h.y,0,h.y-vault.y-vault.h))<h.r+10)issues.push('afl-near-helipad-'+h.id);
 if(vault.y+vault.h>APL.zones.eBlock.y)issues.push('afl-in-east-block');
 for(const o of G1_LEADOFF)if(Math.hypot(o.x-A3.x,0)>110||o.y<APT_Y.RY-5||o.y>APT_Y.TY+4)issues.push(o.id+':lead-off-corridor');

function e2InsideBay(car,bay){if(!car||!bay)return false;const g=vehicleCollisionShape(car.asset,car.ref||'Sedan',car.x,car.y,car.heading||0),spine=g.halfLength-g.radius,ex=g.radius+Math.abs(Math.cos(g.heading))*spine,ey=g.radius+Math.abs(Math.sin(g.heading))*spine;return Math.abs(car.x-(bay.x+bay.w/2))+ex<=bay.w/2-1&&Math.abs(car.y-(bay.y+bay.h/2))+ey<=bay.h/2-1}

function e2Action(action){

 if(action==='remember'&&id==='APT-PAX'){const bay=APT_STALLS.find(s=>s.group==='P-PAX'&&e2InsideBay(PlayerCar,s));if(!bay||carKmh()>1)return toast('כדי לשמור מיקום, עצור את הרכב באחת מחניות הנוסעים');e2Persistent().parkingLocation={x:PlayerCar.x,y:PlayerCar.y,asset:PlayerCar.asset,slot:bay.id,at:iso()};SaveManager.save('airport-parking-location',{backup:false,silent:true});toast('מקום החניה נשמר');renderPhone();return true}
 if(action==='forget'&&id==='APT-PAX'){e2Persistent().parkingLocation=null;if(State.navigation?.targetId==='APT-MY-PARK')clearNavigation();SaveManager.save('airport-parking-clear',{backup:false,silent:true});renderPhone();return true}
 if(action==='save'){SaveManager.save('airport-landside');renderPhone();return true}return false
}

function e2GeometryAudit(){
 const issues=[],over=aptOver,inside=q=>q.x>=5400&&q.y>=850&&q.x+q.w<=6000&&q.y+q.h<=1700,road={x:5400,y:1182,w:348,h:136};   
 for(const q of [...E2_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp),...E2_PROPS.map(e2SpriteBox)]){if(!inside(q))issues.push('outside-scope');if(over(q,road))issues.push('public-road')}
 for(const p of Object.values(APT_INTERACTIONS).filter(p=>p.chunk==='E2'&&!p.phoneOnly))if(personBlockedAt(p.x,p.y,5))issues.push(p.id+':blocked-poi');
 for(const p of E2_PATHS){const a=p.pts[0],b=p.pts[1],n=Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])/8);for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const x=a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*i/n,y=a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*i/n;if(staticPersonBlockedAt(x,y,7))issues.push(p.id+':blocked-path');}}
 const cross=CROSSWALKS.filter(c=>c.signalNode==='AIR-1');if(cross.length||!CROSSWALKS.some(c=>c.signalized&&Math.hypot(c.x-5180,c.y-1600)<900))issues.push('crosswalk');    
 if(APT_STALLS.some(s=>s.x+s.w>5400))issues.push('parking-left-east');
 const ra=raAudit();if(!ra.ok)issues.push(...ra.issues.map(s=>'rail-air:'+s));
 
 {const cor={x:5750,y:580,w:200,h:620},fps=[...E2_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp),...E2_PROPS.map(e2SpriteBox),E2_TRUCK_YARD,E2_GATE_LANE,E2_AIR_C,...E2_TRUCK_DOCKS,...E2_CARGO_BAYS,...PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-E2-DOCK/.test(c.id)).map(c=>c.slotRect)];for(const q of fps)if(over(q,cor))issues.push('rail-corridor:'+(q.id||'?'));
  for(const [x1,y1,x2,y2] of APT_FENCE_SEGS)if(y1===y2&&y1>=845&&y1<=1250&&Math.max(x1,x2)>5750&&Math.min(x1,x2)<5950&&!(y1===APT_FENCE_Y))issues.push('fence-in-corridor');
  const yd=E2_TRUCK_YARD;for(const q of [...E2_TRUCK_DOCKS,...E2_CARGO_BAYS,E2_GATE_LANE])if(!(q.x>=yd.x-1&&q.x+q.w<=yd.x+yd.w+1&&q.y>=yd.y-2&&q.y+q.h<=yd.y+yd.h+1))issues.push('outside-yard:'+q.id);
  for(let i=0;i<E2_TRUCK_DOCKS.length;i++)for(let j=0;j<E2_CARGO_BAYS.length;j++)if(over(E2_TRUCK_DOCKS[i],E2_CARGO_BAYS[j]))issues.push('dock-bay');
  if(!APT_FENCE_SEGS.some(f=>f[1]===APT_FENCE_Y&&f[2]===5684)||!APT_FENCE_SEGS.some(f=>f[1]===APT_FENCE_Y&&f[0]===5744))issues.push('cargo-gate');
  if(over(aptFp(aptB('APT-CARGO-GATEHOUSE')),E2_AIR_C)||over(aptFp(aptB('APT-CARGO-GATEHOUSE')),E2_GATE_LANE))issues.push('gatehouse-in-lane');
  const ac=E2_AIR_C;if(ac.y+ac.h<1204)issues.push('air-c-not-at-road');for(const l of STREET_LIGHTS)if(Math.abs(l.y-1192)<3&&l.x>ac.x-6&&l.x<ac.x+ac.w+6)issues.push('air-c-lamp:'+l.id);
  for(const c of PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-E2-DOCK/.test(c.id)))if(!e2InsideBay(c,c.slotRect))issues.push('truck-outside-dock:'+c.id)}
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)],scope:'E2 east · Rail–Air work site + air cargo · private lane',wholeChunkDone:false,rentalMovedTo:'P-WEST-N (GATE-74)',railAir:ra.ok,cargoSortingBays:E2_CARGO_BAYS.length,truckDocks:E2_TRUCK_DOCKS.length,truckYard:[E2_TRUCK_YARD.x,E2_TRUCK_YARD.y,E2_TRUCK_YARD.x+E2_TRUCK_YARD.w,E2_TRUCK_YARD.y+E2_TRUCK_YARD.h],cargoGate:[5684,5744],entrance:'AIR-C',paths:E2_PATHS.length,props:E2_PROPS.length,visitors:E2_VISITORS.length,next:'RAIL-AIR stage 2'}
}

function a6FerryPose(time=a6FerryPersistent().clock){
 const F=A6_FERRY,z=((time%F.cycle)+F.cycle)%F.cycle,di=F.dwell+F.travel;
 let phase,u,remaining;if(z<F.dwell){phase='A6';u=0;remaining=F.dwell-z}else if(z<di){phase='outbound';u=(z-F.dwell)/F.travel;remaining=di-z}else if(z<di+F.dwell){phase='G8';u=1;remaining=di+F.dwell-z}else{phase='inbound';u=1-(z-di-F.dwell)/F.travel;remaining=F.cycle-z}
 const p=apttAt(F.path,F.path.len*u);return{x:p[0],y:p[1],heading:p[2]+(phase==='inbound'?Math.PI*apttSm(clamp(Math.min((F.path.len*(1-u)-(F.flipB||260))/180,(F.path.len*u-260)/180),0,1)):0),phase,u,remaining,time};
}
function a6FerryWait(from,time=a6FerryPersistent().clock){const F=A6_FERRY,z=((time%F.cycle)+F.cycle)%F.cycle;if(from==='A6')return z<F.dwell?0:F.cycle-z;return z>=F.dwell+F.travel&&z<F.dwell*2+F.travel?0:(F.dwell+F.travel-z+F.cycle)%F.cycle}
function a6BoardFerry(from){

}
function a6Action(action,arg){

 if(action==='sell'&&id==='A6-MARKET'){const f=A6_FIELDS.find(f=>f.item===arg);if(!f||!(PlayerProfile.inventory[arg]>0))return false;PlayerProfile.inventory[arg]--;PlayerProfile.money+=f.price;a6FarmPersistent().sold=(a6FarmPersistent().sold||0)+1;recordTransaction('a6-produce',f.price,{item:arg});SaveManager.save('a6-sale',{backup:true,silent:true});renderPhone();return true}
 if(action==='save')return SaveManager.save('a6-manual');return false;
}

function a6GeometryAudit(){
 const issues=[],over=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y;
 const roads=EDGES.filter(e=>e.globalRoadId.startsWith('TC-A6-')).map(e=>{const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],half=roadType(e).width/2+20;return{id:e.id,x:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-half,y:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-half,w:Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+half*2,h:Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+half*2}});
 for(const b of A6_BUILDINGS){if(b.fp.x<0||b.fp.x+b.fp.w>1200||b.fp.y<4250||b.fp.y+b.fp.h>4990)issues.push(b.id+':bounds');for(const r of roads)if(over(b.fp,r))issues.push(b.id+':road '+r.id);if(a6CollisionAt(b.entrance.x,b.entrance.y,5,true))issues.push(b.id+':entrance')}
 for(let i=0;i<A6_BUILDINGS.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<A6_BUILDINGS.length;j++)if(over(A6_BUILDINGS[i].fp,A6_BUILDINGS[j].fp))issues.push('building-overlap');
 for(const L of A6_LOTS){if(!A6_ACCESS.some(q=>q.lot===L.id&&over(q,L)))issues.push(L.id+':no-access');for(const r of roads)if(over(L,r))issues.push(L.id+':road');for(const b of A6_BUILDINGS)if(over(L,b.fp))issues.push(L.id+':building')}
 for(const q of A6_ACCESS){const r=roads.find(r=>r.id===q.road);if(!r||!over(q,r))issues.push(q.id+':road-gap')}
 for(const p of Object.values(A6_POIS))if(a6CollisionAt(p.x,p.y,5,true))issues.push(p.id+':blocked');
 if(!a6OnPier(A6_POIS['A6-FERRY'].x,A6_POIS['A6-FERRY'].y,5)||!a6OnPier(G8_FERRY_POI.x,G8_FERRY_POI.y,5))issues.push('boarding-off-pier');
 if(PORT_BERTHS.some(b=>b.kind==='ferry'))issues.push('ferry-still-at-port');
 if(!MAP_ACTIVE_IDS.has('A6')||!ACTIVE_REGIONS.includes(A6_REGION))issues.push('inactive');
 for(const f of A6_FIELDS)for(const r of roads)if(over(f,r))issues.push(f.id+':road');
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,buildings:A6_BUILDINGS.length,fields:A6_FIELDS.length,parking:A6_STALLS.length,accessible:A6_STALLS.filter(s=>s.accessible).length,trees:A6_TREES.length,props:A6_PROPS.length,machines:A6_MACHINES.length,visitors:12,roads:roads.length,origin:'A6',destination:'G8',portFerries:PORT_BERTHS.filter(b=>b.kind==='ferry').length,ferryFare:A6_FERRY.fare};
}

 if(kind==='dep'){
  const out=afMv(LY&&LY.south&&home&&H.id==='D'?[[b.x,b.yc,0],[b.x,LY.yA,14],[LY.c1,LY.yA,16],[LY.c1,L,14],[P.muS,L,14],[P.muS,F2_BAG.stop,0]]:[...leaveHome,...toMU],vm,{th0:b.th,blend:30,v1:4});out.kind='out';tag(out,{...base,load:0});
  const e1=out.endPose(),mu=tag(apttHold(e1,muDur,'mu'),{...base,fill:'in',at:'mu'});
  const mid=afMv([...muLoop,[P.muN,L,18],...toStand],vm,{th0:e1[2],blend:28,v0:5,v1:4});mid.kind='mid';tag(mid,{...base,load:n});
  const e2=mid.endPose(),svc=tag(apttHold(e2,hold=g77BwHoldAt(v,sd,ac,hold,code,e2,kind),'svc'),{...base,fill:'out',at:'ac'});
  const back=afMv([...hairpin,...goHome],vm,{th0:e2[2],blend:34,v0:6});back.kind='back';tag(back,{...base,load:0});
  legs=[out,mu,mid,svc,back];dOut=out.dur+mu.dur+mid.dur;
 }else{
  const out=afMv(LY&&LY.south&&home&&H.id==='D'?[[b.x,b.yc,0],[b.x,LY.yA,14],...LY.toStand.slice(2)]:[...leaveHome,...(home?[[H.exitX,L,14]]:[]),...toStand],vm,{th0:b.th,blend:30,v1:5});out.kind='out';tag(out,{...base,load:0});
  const e1=out.endPose(),svc=tag(apttHold(e1,hold=g77BwHoldAt(v,sd,ac,hold,code,e1,kind),'svc'),{...base,fill:'in',at:'ac'});
  const mid=afMv([...hairpin,[P.muS,L,14],[P.muS,F2_BAG.stop,0]],vm,{th0:e1[2],blend:34,v0:6,v1:4});mid.kind='mid';tag(mid,{...base,load:n});
  const e2=mid.endPose(),mu=tag(apttHold(e2,muDur,'mu'),{...base,fill:'out',at:'mu'});
  
  const back=afMv(same?[...muLoop,[P.muN,756,10],[b.x,728,10],[b.x,b.yc,0]]:[...muLoop,[P.muN,L,18],...goHome],vm,{th0:e2[2],blend:28,v0:5});back.kind='back';tag(back,{...base,load:0});
  legs=[out,svc,mid,mu,back];dOut=out.dur;
 }
 const trk=afTrackOf(v,legs);trk.f2bag=kind;
 return{trk,dOut,hold,dur:trk.seq.dur};
}

function f2BagTimes(dur,n){const step=(dur-1.2)/n,fly=Math.min(1,step*.72);return{step,fly,t0:.6}}
function f2BagState(tr,lt){
 if(!tr||!tr.seq||lt==null)return null;const q=tr.seq.legAt(lt);if(!q||!q.leg.f2)return null;const f=q.leg.f2,n=f.n;
 if(f.fill==null)return{k:f.load||0,f,leg:q.leg,t:q.t,fly:null};
 const T=f2BagTimes(q.leg.dur,n),t=q.t;let done=0,fly=null;
 for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const s=T.t0+j*T.step,e=s+T.fly;if(t>=e)done++;else if(t>=s){fly={j,u:(t-s)/T.fly}}}
 if(f.fill==='in')return{k:done,f,leg:q.leg,t,fly};
 
 return{k:n-done-(fly?1:0),f,leg:q.leg,t,fly};
}
const F2_BAG_COLORS=['#e0583a','#2d7fd0','#f0b232','#3fa66a','#8e5bd6','#e86fa0','#39434f','#1fa3a8','#c9792f','#d9d4c6'];
function f2DrawBagsOnCart(g,k0,seed){

}
function f2DrawFlyBag(g,x,y,u,c){const h=Math.sin(Math.PI*u)*4.5;g.save();g.fillStyle='rgba(8,18,26,.3)';g.fillRect(x-1.6,y-1,4.2,3.6);g.fillStyle=c;g.fillRect(x-2.1,y-1.9-h,4.4,4);g.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.42)';g.fillRect(x-2.1,y-1.9-h,4.4,.9);g.fillStyle='#14181c';g.fillRect(x-.7,y-2.6-h,1.4,.8);g.restore()}

 if(G77_MUB.on&&st.f.at==='mu'&&st.f.fill!=null&&g77MubDraw(g,carts,al,st))return;

 for(let i=0;i<carts.length;i++){const c=carts[i],kk=i===carts.length-1?Math.max(0,k-i*F2_BAG.cap):Math.max(0,Math.min(F2_BAG.cap,k-i*F2_BAG.cap));if(!kk)continue;g.save();g.globalAlpha=al;g.translate(c[0],c[1]);g.rotate(c[2]);f2DrawBagsOnCart(g,kk,seed+i*F2_BAG.cap*3);g.restore()}
 if(st.fly){const j=st.fly.j,ci=Math.floor(j/F2_BAG.cap),c=carts[Math.min(ci,carts.length-1)],slot=j%F2_BAG.cap,lx=-6.2+(slot%3)*4.8,ly=-2.6+(slot/3|0)*5.2;
  const cs=Math.cos(c[2]),sn=Math.sin(c[2]),px=c[0]+lx*cs-ly*sn,py=c[1]+lx*sn+ly*cs;
  if(st.f.at==='ac'&&s6aBagFly(st,px,py,F2_BAG_COLORS[(seed+j*3)%F2_BAG_COLORS.length]))return;   
  const ox=st.f.at==='mu'?st.f.beltX-4:st.f.cx+13*(st.f.side||-1),oy=py;
  const from=st.f.fill==='in'?[ox,oy]:[px,py],to=st.f.fill==='in'?[px,py]:[ox,oy],u=st.fly.u;

}

const F2_PAX_ASSETS=['PE-43','PE-44','PE-09','PE-10','PE-19','PE-04'];
function f2PaxPlan(f){
 const s=APT_STANDS.find(s=>s.id===f.stand),P=f2PocketForStand(f.stand);if(!s||!P||!f.bridgeAt)return null;
 const B=f2BridgeGeometry(s,f),start=f.bridgeAt[0]+7.4,end=f.bridgeAt[1]-.8,inbound=f.states[0]?.[1]==='INBOUND',pl=g77K72PaxLine(s,f)||[B.terminal,B.dock],travel=g2PathLen(pl)/22,gap=.92,window=end-start;
 const wanted=f.q?Math.max(f.q.paxA,f.q.paxD):12+f2BagN(f.code)%7,room=inbound?(window-4)/2:window-2,count=Math.min(wanted,Math.floor((room-travel)/gap)+1);
 if(count<1)return null;const dur=travel+(count-1)*gap,arr=inbound?{start,end:start+dur}:null,dep={start:Math.max(arr?arr.end+4:start,end-dur),end};
 return{flight:f.code,stand:f.stand,terminal:P.terminal,door:P.door,pocket:P.id,count,travel,gap,arr,dep,points:pl};
}
function g77PolyAt(pts,d){for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++){const a=pts[i-1],b=pts[i],l=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);if(d<=l||i===pts.length-1){const u=l?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,d/l)):0;return{x:a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*u,y:a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*u,dx:b[0]-a[0],dy:b[1]-a[1]}}d-=l}return{x:pts[0][0],y:pts[0][1],dx:0,dy:1}}
function f2BridgePassengers(t=APT_OPS.clk,flights=AO.flights){
 const out=[];
 for(const f of flights){const p=f.pax;if(!p||!f.bridge||f.bridge(t)<.99||t<f.tOB||t>=f.tPush)continue;
  for(const phase of['arr','dep']){const w=p[phase];if(!w||t<w.start||t>w.end)continue;
   const pts=phase==='arr'?p.points.slice().reverse():p.points,tot=g2PathLen(pts);   
   for(let i=0;i<p.count;i++){const lt=t-w.start-i*p.gap;if(lt<0||lt>=p.travel)continue;const u=lt/p.travel,q=g77PolyAt(pts,u*tot),dx=q.dx,dy=q.dy;
    out.push({id:f.code+'-'+phase+'-'+i,flight:f.code,stand:f.stand,terminal:p.terminal,door:p.door,pocket:p.pocket,phase,asset:F2_PAX_ASSETS[i%F2_PAX_ASSETS.length],x:q.x,y:q.y,face:Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)?(dx>0?2:6):(dy>0?4:0),alpha:Math.min(1,u*14,(1-u)*14),walkTime:lt+i*.24,points:p.points})}
  }
 }
 return out;
}

const F2_BPAX={clip:new Map(),t:-1,n:{clip:0,none:0}};   
function f2BridgeClip(stand){const t=APT_OPS.clk;if(F2_BPAX.t!==t){F2_BPAX.clip.clear();F2_BPAX.t=t}let c=F2_BPAX.clip.get(stand);if(c!==undefined)return c;c=null;
 try{const s=APT_STANDS.find(q=>q.id===stand);if(s){const f=f2BridgeFlight(s.id,t),P=g77BridgePose(s,f,f?aoBridge(s.id,t):0);if(P&&P.S){const Q=g77K72Parts(P),pa=new Path2D();
  for(const q of [Q.fixed,Q.bel1,Q.A,Q.Bt,Q.bel2,Q.cab]){if(!q||q.length<3)continue;let ar=0;for(let i=0;i<q.length;i++){const a=q[i],b=q[(i+1)%q.length];ar+=a[0]*b[1]-b[0]*a[1]}const r=ar>=0?q:q.slice().reverse();   
   pa.moveTo(r[0][0],r[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<r.length;i++)pa.lineTo(r[i][0],r[i][1]);pa.closePath()}
  pa.moveTo(Q.drum.c[0]+Q.drum.r,Q.drum.c[1]);pa.arc(Q.drum.c[0],Q.drum.c[1],Q.drum.r,0,Math.PI*2);c=pa}}}catch(e){c=null}
 F2_BPAX.n[c?'clip':'none']++;F2_BPAX.clip.set(stand,c);return c}
function f2BridgeClipLine(g,P){g.beginPath();for(let k=1;k<P.length;k++){const a=P[k-1],b=P[k],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,w=k===P.length-1?8:6,nx=-dy/len*w,ny=dx/len*w;g77PolyPath(g,[[a[0]+nx,a[1]+ny],[b[0]+nx,b[1]+ny],[b[0]-nx,b[1]-ny],[a[0]-nx,a[1]-ny]])}g.clip()}   
function f2DrawBridgePassengers(now,v){if(WTC_LP===1)return;
 if(!APT_OPS.ready||!portVis(v,6000,580,1230,200))return;
 const sc=G77_PE.sc;
 for(const p of f2BridgePassengers()){
  const I=TurboCity.info(p.asset,{scale:sc,direction:p.face,pose:'walking'}),feet=I.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Feet')||['Feet',I.w/2,I.h*.55],cl=f2BridgeClip(p.stand);
  ctx.save();if(cl)ctx.clip(cl);else f2BridgeClipLine(ctx,p.points);ctx.globalAlpha=p.alpha;
  P34G.k=p.id??null;TurboCity.draw(ctx,p.asset,p.x-feet[1],p.y-feet[2],{mode:'runtime',scale:sc,direction:p.face,pose:'walking',time:p.walkTime});ctx.restore();
 }
 g77BcDraw(now);    
}




const F2_DOORS={T1:[6220,947],T2:[6580,947],T3:[6940,947]};   
let F2_XW=null; 
function f2Crosswalks(){if(F2_XW)return F2_XW;const cs=CROSSWALKS.filter(c=>c.signalNode==='AIR-2');const W=cs.find(c=>c.roadId==='F2-AIR-W'),E=cs.find(c=>c.roadId==='F2-AIR-E'),S=cs.find(c=>c.roadId==='F2-AIR-S');
 return F2_XW={W,E,S,all:cs,wx:W?Math.round(W.x):6675,ex:E?Math.round(E.x):6825,sy:S?Math.round(S.y):1165}}
function f2Routes(){
 
 
 const X=f2Crosswalks(),wx=X.wx,ex=X.ex,sy=X.sy,F=968,KC=F2_CURB_WALK,PS=1149,BP=1612,N=F2_RD.swN+10,S=F2_RD.swS-8;
 const toT=(door)=>{const d=F2_DOORS[door];return[[d[0],F],[d[0],d[1],'door']]};

const F2_PEOPLE=[];
function f2InitPeople(){
 if(F2_PEOPLE.length)return;
 
 f2Routes().forEach((r,i)=>{const segs=[];let tot=0;for(let k=1;k<r.pts.length;k++){const a=r.pts[k-1],b=r.pts[k],l=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);segs.push({a,b,l});tot+=l}
  F2_PEOPLE.push({...r,segs,tot,seg:0,s:((i*97)%Math.max(1,Math.floor(tot*.8))),dir:i%2?-1:1,state:'walk',wait:0,dwell:0,hidden:false,x:r.pts[0][0],y:r.pts[0][1],face:4,crossing:false})});
 for(const p of F2_PEOPLE){let s=p.s;for(let k=0;k<p.segs.length;k++){if(s<=p.segs[k].l||k===p.segs.length-1){p.seg=k;p.s=Math.min(s,p.segs[k].l);break}s-=p.segs[k].l}
  const g=p.segs[p.seg];if(g.a[2]==='xw'||g.a[2]==='xs')p.s=p.dir>0?0:g.l;   
  f2PlacePerson(p)}
}
function f2PlacePerson(p){const sg=p.segs[p.seg];if(!sg)return;const u=sg.l?p.s/sg.l:0;p.x=sg.a[0]+(sg.b[0]-sg.a[0])*u;p.y=sg.a[1]+(sg.b[1]-sg.a[1])*u;const dx=(sg.b[0]-sg.a[0])*p.dir,dy=(sg.b[1]-sg.a[1])*p.dir;p.face=Math.abs(dx)>=Math.abs(dy)?(dx>=0?2:6):(dy>=0?4:0)}
function f2WalkPhase(){try{const st=TrafficSignalController.ensure('AIR-2'),ph=TrafficSignalController.currentFor('AIR-2'),rem=Math.max(0,st.phaseDuration-(performance.now()-st.phaseStart))/1000;return{walk:r76WalkOk(ph,'horizontal'),rem,phase:ph.id}}catch{return{walk:false,rem:0,phase:'?'}}}
function f2PedDemand(){let n=0;for(const p of F2_PEOPLE)if(p.state==='wait-walk')n++;if(F2_PICKUP.walker&&F2_PICKUP.walker.state==='wait-walk')n++;return n}
function f2CrossingOccupied(){for(const p of F2_PEOPLE)if(p.crossing)return true;return!!(F2_PICKUP.walker&&F2_PICKUP.walker.crossing)}
function f2StepWalker(p,dt){
 if(p.dwell>0){p.dwell-=dt;if(p.dwell<=0){p.dwell=0;p.hidden=false}return}
 const sg=p.segs[p.seg];if(!sg)return;
 const atStart=p.dir>0?p.s<=0.001:p.s>=sg.l-0.001,isCross=sg.a[2]==='xw'||sg.a[2]==='xs';
 if(isCross&&atStart&&!p.crossing){const w=f2WalkPhase(),need=sg.l/p.speed+.4;if(!(w.walk&&w.rem>=need)){p.state='wait-walk';p.wait+=dt;return}p.crossing=true}
 p.state='walk';
 let mv=p.speed*dt;
 while(mv>0){const g=p.segs[p.seg];const rem=p.dir>0?g.l-p.s:p.s;if(mv<rem){p.s+=p.dir*mv;mv=0;break}
  mv-=rem;p.s=p.dir>0?g.l:0;p.crossing=false;
  const nk=p.seg+p.dir;
  if(nk<0||nk>=p.segs.length){ 
   const end=p.dir>0?g.b:g.a;p.dir=-p.dir;p.dwell=end[2]==='door'?14+((p.id.length*7)%12):5+((p.id.length*5)%7);p.hidden=end[2]==='door';p.state='dwell';mv=0;break}
  p.seg=nk;p.s=p.dir>0?0:p.segs[nk].l;
  const ng=p.segs[nk];if(ng.a[2]==='xw'||ng.a[2]==='xs')break;   
 }
 f2PlacePerson(p);
}
function f2UpdatePeople(dt){if(typeof State!=='undefined'&&State.paused)return;f2InitPeople();dt=Math.min(.1,Math.max(0,dt||0));for(const p of F2_PEOPLE)f2StepWalker(p,dt);if(F2_PICKUP.walker)f2StepPickupWalker(dt)}
function f2DrawPerson(p,now){if(p.hidden)return;const moving=p.state==='walk',I=TurboCity.info(p.asset,{scale:1,direction:p.face,pose:moving?'walking':'idle'}),f=I.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Feet')||['Feet',I.w/2,I.h*.55];ctx.save();ctx.lineWidth=1;P34G.k=p.id??null;TurboCity.draw(ctx,p.asset,p.x-f[1],p.y-f[2],{mode:'runtime',scale:1,direction:p.face,pose:moving?'walking':'idle',time:moving?now/1000:0});ctx.restore()}

function f2Board(now=APT_OPS.clk){

 for(const f of AO.flights){if(f.heli||f.never||!f.states?.length)continue;const pax=/^P[1-5]$/.test(f.stand||'');if(!pax)continue;
  const inbound=f.states[0][1]==='INBOUND',tOB=f2StateTime(f,'ON_BLOCK'),tTO=f2StateTime(f,'TAKEOFF_ROLL')??f2StateTime(f,'PUSHBACK'),state=aoStateOf(f,now)||f.states[0][1];
  if(inbound&&tOB!=null&&tOB>=now-150)arr.push({code:f.code,ac:f.ac,stand:f.stand,city:f2City(f.code+'A'),t:tOB,state,landed:now>=tOB,f});
  if(tTO!=null&&tTO>=now-25&&!(inbound&&now<tOB))dep.push({code:f.code,ac:f.ac,stand:f.stand,city:f2City(f.code+'D'),t:tTO,state,f});
 }
 arr.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t);dep.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t);return{arr:arr.slice(0,6),dep:dep.slice(0,6),ready:true,now};
}

function f2SpawnPickupWalker(m){

}
function f2StepPickupWalker(dt){
 const w=F2_PICKUP.walker,m=PlayerProfile.activeMission;if(!w)return;
 if(!m||m.id!=='M-F2-PICKUP'||m.stage==='drive'){F2_PICKUP.walker=null;return}
 if(w.arrived){w.state='idle';return}
 const sg=w.segs[w.seg],isCross=sg.a[2]==='xw';
 if(isCross&&w.s<=0.001&&!w.crossing){const ph=f2WalkPhase(),need=sg.l/w.speed+.4;if(!(ph.walk&&ph.rem>=need)){w.state='wait-walk';return}w.crossing=true}
 w.state='walk';let mv=w.speed*dt;
 while(mv>0){const g=w.segs[w.seg],rem=g.l-w.s;if(mv<rem){w.s+=mv;mv=0;break}mv-=rem;w.s=g.l;w.crossing=false;if(w.seg>=w.segs.length-1){w.arrived=true;w.state='idle';break}w.seg++;w.s=0;if(w.segs[w.seg].a[2]==='xw')break}
 f2PlacePerson(w);
}
function f2RetargetWalker(spaceId){const w=F2_PICKUP.walker;if(!w)return;const sp=F2_DROP_SPACES.find(s=>s.id===spaceId);if(!sp||w.space===spaceId)return;
 
 const n=w.segs.length,cx=sp.x+sp.w/2,PL=F2_CURB_WALK,F=968;w.segs[n-3]={a:w.segs[n-3].a,b:[cx,F],l:Math.max(.01,Math.hypot(cx-w.segs[n-3].a[0],F-w.segs[n-3].a[1]))};w.segs[n-2]={a:[cx,F],b:[cx,PL],l:PL-F};w.segs[n-1]={a:[cx,PL],b:[cx,sp.y-2],l:Math.max(.01,sp.y-2-PL)};if(w.seg>=n-3){w.seg=Math.min(w.seg,n-3);w.s=0;w.arrived=false}w.space=spaceId;f2PlacePerson(w)}

function f2GeometryAudit(){
 aptReady();
 const issues=[],over=(a,b)=>a.x<b.x+b.w&&a.x+a.w>b.x&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&a.y+a.h>b.y,inside=q=>q.x>=6000-.01&&q.y>=850-.01&&q.x+q.w<=7200+.01&&q.y+q.h<=1700+.01;
 const roads=aptRoadRects(),fps=APT_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp),X=f2Crosswalks();
 
 for(const q of [...F2_STALLS,...F2_TAXI_HOLD,...F2_BUS_BAYS,...F2_DROP_SPACES,...F2_TAXI_PICK,...F2_PROPS.map(f2SpriteBox),...F2_BUILDINGS.map(aptFp)])if(!inside(q))issues.push('outside-F2:'+(q.id||q.x));
 
 const lotRects=[{id:'lot',x:6088,y:1376,w:538,h:316},...F2_PLAZA_LOTS.map(L=>({id:L.id,x:L.x,y:L.y,w:L.w,h:L.h})),{id:'taxi',x:6818,y:1376,w:324,h:66},{id:'A3',...F2_A3},{id:'bus',x:6846,y:1512,w:280,h:94}];
 for(const L of lotRects){for(const r of roads)if(over(L,r))issues.push('lot-on-road:'+L.id+'/'+r.id);for(const f of fps)if(over(L,f))issues.push('lot-under-building:'+L.id+'/'+f.id)}
 const stalls=[...F2_STALLS,...F2_TAXI_HOLD,...F2_BUS_BAYS];for(let i=0;i<stalls.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<stalls.length;j++)if(over(stalls[i],stalls[j]))issues.push('stall-overlap:'+stalls[i].id+'/'+stalls[j].id);
 for(const s of F2_STALLS)for(const a of F2_AISLES)if(over(s,a))issues.push('stall-in-aisle:'+s.id);
 for(const s of F2_STALLS)if(over(s,{x:F2_WALK.x,y:F2_WALK.y,w:F2_WALK.w,h:F2_WALK.y1-F2_WALK.y}))issues.push('stall-on-walkway:'+s.id);
 for(const s of F2_STALLS)for(const W of F2_PLAZA_WALKS)if(over(s,W))issues.push('stall-on-plaza-walk:'+s.id);for(const s of F2_STALLS.filter(q=>q.plaza)){const a=F2_AISLES.find(q=>q.id===(s.lot==='P-PLAZA-W'?'PA-W':'PA-E'));if(!(s.y+s.h===a.y||s.y===a.y+a.h))issues.push('plaza-access:'+s.id)}   
 
 for(const c of PARKED_CARS.filter(c=>/^PC-F2-/.test(c.id))){const I=TurboCity.info(c.asset,{scale:roadVehicleScaleFor(c.asset,c.ref)}),r=c.slotRect,vert=Math.abs(Math.sin(c.heading||0))>.5,len=I.w-4,wid=I.h-4;if(vert?(wid>r.w+1||len>r.h+1):(len>r.w+1||wid>r.h+1))issues.push('car-clearance:'+c.id)}
 
 for(const L of[F2_DROP,F2_TAXI_LAYBY]){if(L.y1!==F2_RD.yN||L.y0<F2_RD.yN-46||L.y0>F2_RD.swN)issues.push(L.id+':band');if(L.y0<APT_FENCE_Y+40)issues.push(L.id+':forecourt-too-narrow');for(const c of X.all){if(c.roadId!=='F2-AIR-S'&&over({x:L.x0,y:L.y0,w:L.x1-L.x0,h:L.y1-L.y0},{x:c.x-15,y:F2_RD.yN-46,w:30,h:48}))issues.push(L.id+':crossing')}}   
 if(F2_DROP.x1>X.wx-15-50)issues.push('drop-exit-too-close-to-stop-line');if(F2_TAXI_LAYBY.x0<X.ex+15)issues.push('taxi-entry-on-crossing');
 
 if(X.all.length!==3||!X.all.every(c=>c.signalized))issues.push('air2-crossings');if(!SIGNALS.some(s=>s.node==='AIR-2'))issues.push('air2-signal');
 
 for(const r of f2Routes())for(let k=1;k<r.pts.length;k++){const a=r.pts[k-1],b=r.pts[k],n=Math.ceil(Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])/8),cross=a[2]==='xw'||a[2]==='xs';if(cross)continue;for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const x=a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*i/n,y=a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*i/n;if(y>=1157&&staticPersonBlockedAt(x,y,PLAYER_PERSON_RADIUS+.5))issues.push(r.id+':blocked@'+Math.round(x)+','+Math.round(y)+' '+staticPersonBlockedAt(x,y,PLAYER_PERSON_RADIUS+.5))}}

function f2BagStats(T){
 const issues=[];let tasks=0,dep=0,arr=0,bags=0,f2home=0,g2home=0,remote=0;const mu={'MU-A':0,'MU-B':0,'MU-C':0};const byTerminal={T1:{arr:0,dep:0},T2:{arr:0,dep:0},T3:{arr:0,dep:0}};
 for(const v of AO.fleet){if(v.type!=='BT')continue;for(const k of v.hist.concat(v.tasks)){if(k.role!=='bag')continue;tasks++;const L=k.tr.seq.legs,kinds=L.map(l=>l.kind).join(',');
  if(k.tr.f2bag==='dep'){dep++;if(kinds!=='out,mu,mid,svc,back')issues.push('dep-legs '+v.id+' '+kinds)}else if(k.tr.f2bag==='arr'){arr++;if(kinds!=='out,svc,mid,mu,back')issues.push('arr-legs '+v.id+' '+kinds)}else issues.push('legacy-bag-task '+v.id);
  const m=L.find(l=>l.kind==='mu');if(m?.f2){mu[m.f2.mu]=(mu[m.f2.mu]||0)+1;bags+=m.f2.n;if(m.f2.remote)remote++;const P=f2PocketForStand(m.f2.sd);if(!P||P.mu!==m.f2.mu||P.terminal!==m.f2.terminal||P.door!==m.f2.door)issues.push('wrong-terminal '+v.id+' '+m.f2.sd);else byTerminal[P.door][k.tr.f2bag]++}if(v.bay.zone==='F2')f2home++;else g2home++;
  for(const l of L)if((l.kind==='mu'||l.kind==='svc')&&!(l.f2&&l.f2.fill))issues.push('no-visible-transfer '+v.id)}}
 return{ok:!issues.length&&tasks>0&&dep>0&&arr>0&&Object.values(mu).every(n=>n>0),tasks,dep,arr,bags,remote,mu,byTerminal,f2home,g2home,issues:issues.slice(0,8)};
}

function g77ShAt(P,u){let tot=0;const seg=[];for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const l=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);seg.push(l);tot+=l}let d=u*tot;

 return[P[P.length-1][0],P[P.length-1][1],0]}
function g77ShLen(P){let t=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++)t+=Math.hypot(P[i][0]-P[i-1][0],P[i][1]-P[i-1][1]);return t}

var G77_FM={on:true,ids:['V-MX2'],st:{P5:1,P6:1},a:28,gap:14,out:8,pre:30,wMin:150,hMin:3,hMax:40,step:5,tries:4,cuts:[0,45,90,135],yLY:86,dt:.05,ok:0,skip:0,noRoom:0,late:0,why:{},diag:false,dl:[]};
function g77FmHx(){const D=s6aDimOf('MX');return D?D[0]/2:11}

function g77FmLead(sd,ac,arr,tA,cut){const F=G77_FM,g=apttAcGeom(ac),th=sd.th,u=[Math.cos(th),Math.sin(th)],dt=F.dt,n=Math.ceil(arr.dur/dt),hx=g77FmHx();
 const X=new Float64Array(n+1),Y=new Float64Array(n+1),R=new Float64Array(n+1);
 for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const p=arr.pose(Math.min(i*dt,arr.dur));X[i]=p[0];Y[i]=p[1]}
 for(let i=n-1;i>=0;i--)R[i]=R[i+1]+Math.hypot(X[i+1]-X[i],Y[i+1]-Y[i]);
 const sx=X[n],sy=Y[n];let i0=n;
 for(let i=n;i>=0;i--){const dx=X[i]-sx,dy=Y[i]-sy,lat=Math.abs(-dx*u[1]+dy*u[0]),al=dx*u[0]+dy*u[1];if(lat>.8||al>1)break;i0=i}   
 const lead=g.F[1]+F.gap+hx,dN=u[1]>.9?sy-(APTT_X.LY+F.yLY):Infinity,dW=Math.min(R[i0]-lead-F.pre,dN)-(cut||0);if(dW<F.wMin)return null;   
 const W=[sx-u[0]*dW,sy-u[1]*dW],xa=i=>dW-R[i],vA=i=>i<n?(R[i]-R[i+1])/dt:0,xEnd=dW+g.F[1]+F.out+hx;
 let iS=-1;for(let i=0;i<=n;i++)if(xa(i)+lead>=0){iS=i;break}if(iS<0)return null;
 for(let k=iS;k>=Math.max(0,iS-Math.round(10/dt));k--){let xf=0,vf=0,G=null,ok=true,iP=-1;const xs=[0];
  for(let i=k+1;i<=n;i++){if(G==null){vf+=F.a*dt;xf+=vf*dt;if(vf>=vA(i))G=xf-xa(i)}else xf=xa(i)+G;
   if(xf-xa(i)<lead-1e-6){ok=false;break}xs.push(xf);if(xf>=xEnd){iP=i;break}}
  if(!ok)continue;if(iP<0)return null;
  const dur=(iP-k)*dt,v1=Math.max(4,(xs[xs.length-1]-xs[xs.length-2])/dt);
  const pose=t=>{const j=Math.max(0,Math.min(xs.length-1.000001,t/dt)),j0=Math.floor(j),x=xs[j0]+(xs[Math.min(xs.length-1,j0+1)]-xs[j0])*(j-j0);return[W[0]+u[0]*x,W[1]+u[1]*x,th,0,1]};
  return{W,th,lead,dW,tL:tA+k*dt,tP:tA+iP*dt,dur,pose,v1}}
 return null}

function* g77FmServeG(sd,ac,arr,tA,meta,extra){const F=G77_FM;let late=true,room=false;
 for(const cut of F.cuts){const L=g77FmLead(sd,ac,arr,tA,cut);if(!L)continue;room=true;
  for(const D of g77FmDests(sd,ac,L))for(const v of AO.fleet){if(!F.ids.includes(v.id))continue;const B0=afBuild(v,D,F.hMin,{lead:L}),sHi=Math.floor((L.tL-B0.dOut-F.hMin)/AO.DT+1e-9),sLo=Math.max(afSEarliest(),Math.ceil((L.tL-B0.dOut-F.hMax)/AO.DT-1e-9));

function g77FidsRows(now=APT_OPS.clk,flights=AO.flights){const arr=[],dep=[];if(!flights)return{arr,dep,now,ready:false};
 for(const f of flights){if(f.heli||f.never||!(f.states&&f.states.length)||!/^P[1-6]$/.test(f.stand||''))continue;
  const inbound=f.states[0][1]==='INBOUND',ob=g77FidsT(f,'ON_BLOCK'),push=g77FidsT(f,'PUSHBACK')??g77FidsT(f,'TAXI_OUT'),to=g77FidsT(f,'TAKEOFF_ROLL');
  const base={code:f.code,ac:f.ac,stand:f.stand,airline:g77FidsAirline(f),f};
  if(inbound&&ob!=null&&ob>=now-120)arr.push(Object.assign({kind:'arr',city:f2City(f.code+'A'),t:ob,ts:g77FwSchedA(f,ob),st:g77FidsStatus(f,'arr',now)},base));
  if(push!=null&&to!=null&&to>=now-60&&!(inbound&&ob!=null&&now<ob))dep.push(Object.assign({kind:'dep',city:f2City(f.code+'D'),t:push,ts:g77FwSchedD(f,push),st:g77FidsStatus(f,'dep',now)},base))}
 arr.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t||(a.code<b.code?-1:1));dep.sort((a,b)=>a.t-b.t||(a.code<b.code?-1:1));
 return{arr:arr.slice(0,G77_FIDS.rows),dep:dep.slice(0,G77_FIDS.rows),now,ready:!!(typeof APT_OPS==='undefined'||APT_OPS.ready)}}
function g77FidsWhen(t,now){const d=Math.round(t-now),a=Math.abs(d),m=Math.floor(a/60),s=a%60,ms=m+':'+String(s).padStart(2,'0');return d>2?'בעוד '+ms:d>=-2?'עכשיו':'לפני '+ms}
